// ==============================================================================
// TASK 1: HTML STRUCTURE AND BASIC SERVER INTERACTION
// Cognifyz Full Stack Development Internship - Level 1 (Beginner)
// File: server.js
// Description: Express server setup, route handlers, and SSR with EJS
// ==============================================================================

// 1. IMPORT REQUIRED MODULES
// 'express' is a fast, minimalist web framework for Node.js
const express = require('express');
// 'path' is a built-in Node.js module used to handle and transform file paths safely
const path = require('path');

// 2. INITIALIZE EXPRESS APPLICATION
const app = express();

// Set the port to an environment variable or default to 3000
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;

// 3. CONFIGURE VIEW ENGINE (EJS)
// Tell Express to use EJS as the templating / view engine
app.set('view engine', 'ejs');
// Specify the directory where the template files (views) are located
app.set('views', path.join(__dirname, 'views'));

// 4. CONFIGURE MIDDLEWARE
// Middleware functions run between receiving a request and sending a response.

// Serve static assets (CSS, images, client scripts) from the "public" folder
app.use(express.static(path.join(__dirname, 'public')));

// Parse URL-encoded bodies sent by HTML forms (application/x-www-form-urlencoded)
// 'extended: true' allows parsing rich objects and arrays encoded in the URL-encoded format
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true }));

// ==============================================================================
// 5. APPLICATION ROUTES
// ==============================================================================

/**
 * Route: GET /
 * Purpose: Render the Home page with introductory information and links.
 */
app.get('/', (req, res) => {
  res.render('index', {
    title: 'Home | Task 1 Basic Server'
  });
});

/**
 * Route: GET /contact
 * Purpose: Render the form page where users can input information.
 */
app.get('/contact', (req, res) => {
  res.render('contact', {
    title: 'Contact Form | Task 1 Basic Server',
    error: null,
    formData: {} // Keep empty default so fields don't throw undefined errors
  });
});

/**
 * Route: POST /submit
 * Purpose: Handle the form submission, perform validation, and render the result.
 */
app.post('/submit', (req, res) => {
  // Extract submitted form data from req.body
  const { name, email, age, gender, country, interests, message } = req.body;

  // Basic Validation: Check if required fields (name and email) are provided and not just whitespace
  if (!name || !name.trim() || !email || !email.trim()) {
    // Return status 400 (Bad Request) and re-render contact page with an error message and existing input
    return res.status(400).render('contact', {
      title: 'Contact Form | Task 1 Basic Server',
      error: 'Please fill in all required fields (Full Name and Email Address).',
      formData: { name, email, age, gender, country, interests, message }
    });
  }

  // Normalize 'interests':
  // When an HTML form with checkboxes is submitted:
  // - 0 checkboxes checked => interests is undefined
  // - 1 checkbox checked   => interests is a string (e.g. "Web Development")
  // - 2+ checkboxes checked => interests is an Array of strings (e.g. ["Web Development", "AI/ML"])
  let normalizedInterests = [];
  if (Array.isArray(interests)) {
    normalizedInterests = interests;
  } else if (typeof interests === 'string' && interests.trim().length > 0) {
    normalizedInterests = [interests];
  }

  // Generate server-side submission timestamp
  const submittedAt = new Date().toLocaleString('en-US', {
    dateStyle: 'full',
    timeStyle: 'medium'
  });

  // Render result.ejs with the submitted and sanitized data
  res.render('result', {
    title: 'Submission Result | Task 1 Basic Server',
    user: {
      name: name.trim(),
      email: email.trim(),
      age: age ? age.trim() : 'Not provided',
      gender: gender || 'Not specified',
      country: country || 'Not selected',
      interests: normalizedInterests,
      message: message ? message.trim() : 'No message provided'
    },
    submittedAt: submittedAt
  });
});

// ==============================================================================
// 6. 404 NOT FOUND HANDLER (CATCH-ALL)
// ==============================================================================
// If none of the routes above match the incoming request URL, this middleware will run.
app.use((req, res) => {
  res.status(404).render('404', {
    title: '404 - Page Not Found | Task 1 Basic Server',
    requestedUrl: req.originalUrl
  });
});

// ==============================================================================
// 7. START THE SERVER
// ==============================================================================
app.listen(PORT, () => {
  console.log(`====================================================`);
  console.log(`🚀 Server successfully started!`);
  console.log(`📡 Access the application at: http://localhost:${PORT}`);
  console.log(`📝 Environment: ${process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development'}`);
  console.log(`====================================================`);
});

# Task 1: Basic Server (Level 1: Beginner)

**Cognifyz Technologies Full Stack Development Internship**  
*Objective: HTML Structure and Basic Server Interaction*

---

## 📖 Project Overview

This project is an introduction to the fundamentals of full-stack web development. It demonstrates how a web client (browser) interacts with a backend server using **Node.js** and **Express**, how data submitted via an **HTML5 form** is processed on the server, and how dynamic web pages are generated and served back using **Server-Side Rendering (SSR)** with the **EJS** template engine.

### Core Learning Concepts
1. **Semantic HTML5:** Structuring forms with accessible labels, input validation, and semantic group containers (`<fieldset>`, `<legend>`).
2. **Express Server Lifecycle:** Setting up an HTTP server, routing, and static file serving.
3. **HTTP Request/Response Cycle:** Handling `GET` and `POST` methods and accessing URL-encoded form data via `req.body`.
4. **Server-Side Rendering (SSR):** Injecting server variables into HTML templates using EJS tags (`<%= %>`, `<%- %>`, and `<% %>`).
5. **Defensive Data Handling:** Safely processing varied data types (such as checkbox arrays, single strings, or undefined values).

---

## 📂 Folder Structure

```text
task-1-basic-server/
│

├── package.json           # Project metadata, dependencies (Express, EJS), and npm scripts
├── README.md              # Project documentation and setup guide
│
├── views/                 # EJS template views
│   ├── partials/          # Reusable layout partials
│   │   ├── header.ejs     # Document doctype, meta tags, head, and navigation bar
│   │   └── footer.ejs     # Main closing tag, footer content, and closing HTML tags
│   ├── index.ejs          # Home landing page with overview and navigation
│   ├── contact.ejs        # Comprehensive HTML form with various input types
│   ├── result.ejs         # SSR results page displaying submitted form data
│   └── 404.ejs            # 404 Not Found error page
│
└── public/                # Static assets served directly to the browser
    └── style.css          # Clean, modern, responsive CSS stylesheet
```

---

## 🚀 Setup & Installation

### Prerequisites
- Node.js installed on your machine (v14 or higher recommended).
- npm (Node Package Manager) installed.

### Step-by-Step Instructions

1. **Navigate to the project folder:**
   ```bash
   cd task-1-basic-server
   ```

2. **Install project dependencies:**
   ```bash
   npm install
   ```
   *This installs `express` and `ejs`, plus `nodemon` as a development dependency.*

3. **Start the server:**
   - **Production / Standard mode:**
     ```bash
     npm start
     ```
   - **Development mode (with auto-restart on changes):**
     ```bash
     npm run dev
     ```

4. **Open in your browser:**
   Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) to view the application.

---

## 🛣️ Routes Table

| HTTP Method | Route URL   | View Rendered | Description |
| :---        | :---        | :---          | :---        |
| **GET**     | `/`         | `index.ejs`   | Displays the home page with an introduction to the internship task and quick links. |
| **GET**     | `/contact`  | `contact.ejs` | Displays the user contact form with validation indicators and styled inputs. |
| **POST**    | `/submit`   | `result.ejs` / `contact.ejs` | Receives and validates form data from `req.body`. Re-renders `contact.ejs` with status `400` if `name` or `email` are missing; otherwise renders `result.ejs` with the sanitized data and timestamp. |
| **ALL**     | `*` (Any unknown) | `404.ejs` | Catches any unmatched route, returning HTTP status `404` and a friendly error message. |

---

## ⚙️ How Server-Side Rendering (SSR) Works in This Project

In traditional static sites, HTML files are pre-written and sent as-is to the browser. In Single Page Applications (SPAs), raw JSON is sent to the client and rendered via client-side JavaScript.

In **Server-Side Rendering (SSR)** with EJS:
1. **The Request:** When a user submits the form at `/contact`, the browser packages all form inputs into the HTTP request body and sends a `POST` request to `/submit`.
2. **Server Processing:** `express.urlencoded({ extended: true })` parses the URL-encoded payload into a JavaScript object (`req.body`).
3. **Validation & Normalization:** `server.js` verifies that required fields exist, safely converts checkbox data into a clean array, and generates a formatted server timestamp.
4. **Template Interpolation:** Express calls `res.render('result', { user, submittedAt })`. The EJS engine reads `result.ejs`, inserts the variables into the placeholders (`<%= user.name %>`, etc.), executes loops (`list.forEach(...)`), and includes modular partials (`header.ejs`, `footer.ejs`).
5. **The Response:** A fully-formed HTML document containing the personalized data is generated entirely on the server and sent back to the browser.
6. **Security & Escaping:** EJS tags using `<%= %>` automatically escape HTML characters (such as `<` and `>`), protecting the application against cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks.

---

## 🧪 Testing and Verification Checklist

- [x] **Home Page:** Access `http://localhost:3000/` and verify layout and navigation links.
- [x] **Form Submission (Complete):** Fill in all fields on `/contact` and verify that `/submit` displays every field accurately.
- [x] **Checkbox Handling:**
  - Submit with *zero* checkboxes selected &rarr; Displays "No interests selected" without server crash.
  - Submit with *one* checkbox selected &rarr; Normalized into an array and displayed as a single badge.
  - Submit with *multiple* checkboxes selected &rarr; Iterated with `forEach` and displayed as badges.
- [x] **Validation Error:** Leave name or email empty &rarr; Re-renders `/contact` with status 400 and an error alert.
- [x] **404 Handling:** Visit a non-existent URL (e.g. `http://localhost:3000/invalid-page`) &rarr; 404 page renders with HTTP status 404.

<%- include('partials/header') %>

<section class="card">
  <h1>Contact &amp; Registration Form</h1>
  <p class="lead">Fill out the form below to test basic server-side form handling and validation.</p>

  <!-- Error Alert Display (Rendered dynamically if validation fails on the server) -->
  <% if (typeof error !== 'undefined' && error) { %>
    <div class="alert alert-error" role="alert">
      <span>&#9888; <strong>Validation Error:</strong> <%= error %></span>
    </div>
  <% } %>

  <!-- Form configured with POST method targeting the /submit endpoint -->
  <form action="/submit" method="POST" novalidate>
    
    <!-- 1. Full Name (Text, Required) -->
    <div class="form-group">
      <label for="name">
        Full Name <span class="required-badge">*</span>
      </label>
      <input 
        type="text" 
        id="name" 
        name="name" 
        placeholder="e.g. Jane Doe" 
        value="<%= (typeof formData !== 'undefined' && formData.name) ? formData.name : '' %>"
        required
      >
    </div>

    <!-- 2. Email Address (Email, Required) -->
    <div class="form-group">
      <label for="email">
        Email Address <span class="required-badge">*</span>
      </label>
      <input 
        type="email" 
        id="email" 
        name="email" 
        placeholder="e.g. jane@example.com" 
        value="<%= (typeof formData !== 'undefined' && formData.email) ? formData.email : '' %>"
        required
      >
    </div>

    <!-- 3. Age (Number, Min 1, Max 120) -->
    <div class="form-group">
      <label for="age">Age</label>
      <input 
        type="number" 
        id="age" 
        name="age" 
        min="1" 
        max="120" 
        placeholder="e.g. 21" 
        value="<%= (typeof formData !== 'undefined' && formData.age) ? formData.age : '' %>"
      >
    </div>

    <!-- 4. Gender (Radio buttons grouped in a semantic fieldset) -->
    <fieldset>
      <legend>Gender</legend>
      <div class="options-group">
        <div class="option-item">
          <input 
            type="radio"

/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Task 2: Inline Styles, Basic Interaction, and Server-Side Validation
 * Cognifyz Technologies Full Stack Internship - Level 1 (Beginner)
 * ============================================================================
 *
 * File: server.js
 * Description: Express server implementing server-side validation, in-memory
 *              user storage, secure bcryptjs password hashing, and EJS rendering.
 */

const express = require('express');
const path = require('path');
const bcrypt = require('bcryptjs');

// Initialize Express app
const app = express();
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;

// Set EJS as templating engine
app.set('view engine', 'ejs');
app.set('views', path.join(__dirname, 'views'));

// Middleware for parsing form bodies and JSON data
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true }));
app.use(express.json());

// ============================================================================
// TEMPORARY STORAGE (In-Memory JavaScript Array)
// ============================================================================
// As per task instructions, an in-memory array acts as our temporary storage.
// It persists records during the server's lifecycle without requiring a database.
const users = [];

// ============================================================================
// SERVER-SIDE VALIDATION HELPER
// ============================================================================
/**
 * WHY SERVER-SIDE VALIDATION MATTERS:
 * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Client-side validation in the browser improves user experience by offering
 * instantaneous visual feedback (e.g., dynamic red/green borders, error spans).
 * However, client-side validation CAN NEVER BE TRUSTED as a security measure:
 *   1. A user can disable JavaScript in their browser settings.
 *   2. An attacker can alter HTML attributes (such as removing required/pattern)
 *      or bypass event handlers using browser DevTools.
 *   3. Automated HTTP clients (curl, Postman, custom scripts) can send POST
 *      requests directly to /register, bypassing browser execution entirely.
 *
 * Server-side validation is our true perimeter defense. It guarantees that
 * every incoming data payload is sanitized, strictly conforms to business rules,
 * and maintains data integrity before being accepted into storage.
 * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 */

/**
 * Validates registration form inputs.
 * @param {Object} data - Raw form body submitted by client.
 * @param {Array} existingUsers - Array of currently stored users for uniqueness check.
 * @returns {Object} errors - Map of field names to error messages (empty if valid).
 */
function validateRegistration(data, existingUsers = users) {
  const errors = {};

  // 1. Sanitize string inputs (trim leading/trailing whitespace)
  const firstName = (data.firstName || '').trim();
  const lastName = (data.lastName || '').trim();
  const email = (data.email || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const phone = (data.phone || '').trim();
  const dob = (data.dob || '').trim();
  const password = data.password || '';
  const confirmPassword = data.confirmPassword || '';
  const gender = (data.gender || '').trim();
  const country = (data.country || '').trim();
  const bio = (data.bio || '').trim();
  const terms = data.terms;

  // 2. Normalize skills field (could be undefined, a single string, or an array)
  let skills = [];
  if (Array.isArray(data.skills)) {
    skills = data.skills;
  } else if (typeof data.skills === 'string' && data.skills.trim().length > 0) {
    skills = [data.skills.trim()];
  }

  // --- Rule 1: First Name ---
  // Required, at least 2 characters, letters only
  const nameRegex = /^[A-Za-z\s]{2,}$/;
  if (!firstName) {
    errors.firstName = 'First name is required.';
  } else if (firstName.length < 2) {
    errors.firstName = 'First name must be at least 2 characters.';
  } else if (!nameRegex.test(firstName)) {
    errors.firstName = 'First name must contain letters only.';
  }

  // --- Rule 2: Last Name ---
  // Required, at least 2 characters, letters only
  if (!lastName) {
    errors.lastName = 'Last name is required.';
  } else if (lastName.length < 2) {
    errors.lastName = 'Last name must be at least 2 characters.';
  } else if (!nameRegex.test(lastName)) {
    errors.lastName = 'Last name must contain letters only.';
  }

  // --- Rule 3: Email & Server-Only Duplicate Check ---
  // Required, valid email format regex, case-insensitive duplicate check
  const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
  if (!email) {
    errors.email = 'Email address is required.';
  } else if (!emailRegex.test(email)) {
    errors.email = 'Please provide a valid email address (e.g. name@example.com).';
  } else {
    // Additional server-only check: Reject duplicate email against stored users
    const emailExists = existingUsers.some(
      (u) => u.email.toLowerCase() === email
    );
    if (emailExists) {
      errors.email = 'This email is already registered.';
    }
  }

  // --- Rule 4: Phone ---
  // Required, exactly 10 digits
  const phoneRegex = /^\d{10}$/;
  if (!phone) {
    errors.phone = 'Phone number is required.';
  } else if (!phoneRegex.test(phone)) {
    errors.phone = 'Phone number must be exactly 10 digits.';
  }

  // --- Rule 5: Date of Birth & Minimum Age (13 Years) ---
  if (!dob) {
    errors.dob = 'Date of birth is required.';
  } else {
    const dobDate = new Date(dob);
    if (isNaN(dobDate.getTime())) {
      errors.dob = 'Please provide a valid date.';
    } else {
      const today = new Date();
      let age = today.getFullYear() - dobDate.getFullYear();
      const monthDiff = today.getMonth() - dobDate.getMonth();
      if (monthDiff < 0 || (monthDiff === 0 && today.getDate() < dobDate.getDate())) {
        age--;
      }
      if (age < 13) {
        errors.dob = 'You must be at least 13 years old to register.';
      }
    }
  }

  // --- Rule 6: Password ---
  // At least 8 characters, at least one letter and one number
  const passwordRegex = /^(?=.*[A-Za-z])(?=.*\d).{8,}$/;
  if (!password) {
    errors.password = 'Password is required.';
  } else if (password.length < 8) {
    errors.password = 'Password must be at least 8 characters long.';
  } else if (!passwordRegex.test(password)) {
    errors.password = 'Password must contain at least one letter and one number.';
  }

  // --- Rule 7: Confirm Password ---
  // Must match password
  if (!confirmPassword) {
    errors.confirmPassword = 'Confirmation password is required.';
  } else if (password !== confirmPassword) {
    errors.confirmPassword = 'Passwords do not match.';
  }

  // --- Rule 8: Gender ---
  // One radio must be chosen from allowed options
  const allowedGenders = ['Male', 'Female', 'Other', 'Prefer not to say'];
  if (!gender || !allowedGenders.includes(gender)) {
    errors.gender = 'Please select a gender option.';
  }

  // --- Rule 9: Country ---
  // Non-empty selection from dropdown
  if (!country) {
    errors.country = 'Please select your country.';
  }

  // --- Rule 10: Skills ---
  // At least one skill checkbox selected
  if (skills.length === 0) {
    errors.skills = 'Please select at least one skill.';
  }

  // --- Rule 11: Bio ---
  // Optional, but cannot exceed 200 characters
  if (bio && bio.length > 200) {
    errors.bio = 'Bio cannot exceed 200 characters.';
  }

  // --- Rule 12: Terms and Conditions ---
  // Must be checked
  if (terms !== 'on' && terms !== 'true' && terms !== true) {
    errors.terms = 'You must agree to the Terms and Conditions to proceed.';
  }

  return errors;
}

// ============================================================================
// APPLICATION ROUTES
// ============================================================================

 * Home page with overview of validation concepts and quick links.
 */
app.get('/', (req, res) => {
  res.render('index', {
    title: 'Home - Task 2 Validation & Inline Styles',
    activePage: 'home',
    userCount: users.length
  });
});

/**
 * GET /register
 * Renders registration form with empty values and no errors.
 */
app.get('/register', (req, res) => {
  res.render('register', {
    title: 'Register - Interactive Validation Form',
    activePage: 'register',
    formData: {},
    errors: {}
  });
});

/**
 * POST /register
 * Validates submitted data on the server.
 * - If errors exist: responds with status 400 and re-renders register.ejs,
 *   preserving previously entered values (passwords are strictly redacted).
 * - If valid: hashes password with bcryptjs, saves to users array, and redirects to /success.
 */
app.post('/register', async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const rawData = req.body;
    const errors = validateRegistration(rawData, users);

    // If validation fails, return status 400 and preserve user input (NEVER passwords)
    if (Object.keys(errors).length > 0) {
      const safeFormData = { ...rawData };
      delete safeFormData.password;
      delete safeFormData.confirmPassword;

      if (!Array.isArray(safeFormData.skills)) {
        safeFormData.skills = safeFormData.skills ? [safeFormData.skills] : [];
      }

      return res.status(400).render('register', {
        title: 'Register - Fix Errors',
        activePage: 'register',
        formData: safeFormData,
        errors: errors
      });
    }

    // --- Data is valid ---
    // Security: Hash password using bcryptjs with 10 salt rounds
    // Passwords are never stored, logged, or exposed in plain text.
    const saltRounds = 10;
    const passwordHash = await bcrypt.hash(rawData.password, saltRounds);

    let normalizedSkills = [];
    if (Array.isArray(rawData.skills)) {
      normalizedSkills = rawData.skills;
    } else if (rawData.skills) {
      normalizedSkills = [rawData.skills];
    }

    const newUser = {
      id: users.length + 1,
      firstName: rawData.firstName.trim(),
      lastName: rawData.lastName.trim(),
      email: rawData.email.trim().toLowerCase(),
      phone: rawData.phone.trim(),
      dob: rawData.dob.trim(),
      gender: rawData.gender,
      country: rawData.country,
      skills: normalizedSkills,
      bio: (rawData.bio || '').trim(),
      passwordHash: passwordHash,
      createdAt: new Date().toLocaleString('en-US', {
        dateStyle: 'medium',
        timeStyle: 'short'
      })
    };

    // Store in temporary in-memory array
    users.push(newUser);

    // Post-Redirect-Get pattern: Redirect to /success
    res.redirect(`/success?name=${encodeURIComponent(newUser.firstName)}`);
  } catch (err) {
    next(err);
  }
});

/**
 * GET /success
 * Registration confirmation page showing congratulatory message.
 */
app.get('/success', (req, res) => {
  const name = req.query.name || 'Friend';
  res.render('success', {
    title: 'Registration Successful',
    activePage: 'register',
    name: name,
    totalUsers: users.length
  });
});

/**
 * GET /users
 * Displays all stored users in a styled table.
 * Strictly excludes passwords and password hashes. Shows empty state if none exist.
 */
app.get('/users', (req, res) => {
  const safeUsers = users.map((u) => ({
    id: u.id,
    name: `${u.firstName} ${u.lastName}`,
    email: u.email,
    phone: u.phone,
    country: u.country,
    skills: u.skills,
    createdAt: u.createdAt
  }));

  res.render('users', {
    title: 'Registered Users - In-Memory Store',
    activePage: 'users',
    users: safeUsers,
    totalCount: users.length
  });
});

// ============================================================================
// 404 NOT FOUND HANDLER
// ============================================================================
app.use((req, res) => {
  res.status(404).render('404', {
    title: '404 - Page Not Found',
    activePage: '',
    path: req.originalUrl
  });
});

// ============================================================================
// GLOBAL ERROR HANDLER (4 Arguments)
// ============================================================================
app.use((err, req, res, next) => {
  console.error('[SERVER ERROR]:', err);
  res.status(500).render('error', {
    title: '500 - Server Error',
    activePage: '',
    message: err.message || 'An unexpected internal server error occurred.'
  });
});

// ============================================================================
// SERVER INITIALIZATION

if (require.main === module) {
  app.listen(PORT, () => {
    console.log('================================================================');

    console.log(`👥 Users Table:    http://localhost:${PORT}/users`);
    console.log('================================================================');
  });
}

/**
 * Automated Verification Script for Task 2
 * Tests all 9 requirements from the prompt specification.
 */

const http = require('http');
const { app, users } = require('./server');

const PORT = 3999;
let server;

function request(method, path, data = null, headers = {}) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    let postData = '';
    const reqHeaders = { ...headers };

    if (data) {
      if (typeof data === 'object') {
        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(data)) {
          if (Array.isArray(val)) {
            val.forEach(v => params.append(key, v));
          } else if (val !== undefined && val !== null) {
            params.append(key, val);
          }
        }
        postData = params.toString();
        reqHeaders['Content-Type'] = 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded';
        reqHeaders['Content-Length'] = Buffer.byteLength(postData);
      } else {
        postData = data;
      }
    }

    const options = {
      hostname: '127.0.0.1',
      port: PORT,
      path: path,
      method: method,
      headers: reqHeaders
    };

    const req = http.request(options, (res) => {
      let body = '';
      res.on('data', (chunk) => body += chunk);
      res.on('end', () => {
        resolve({
          statusCode: res.statusCode,
          headers: res.headers,
          body: body
        });
      });
    });

    req.on('error', (err) => reject(err));

    if (postData) {
      req.write(postData);
    }
    req.end();
  });
}

async function runTests() {
  console.log('====================================================');
  console.log('🧪 RUNNING TASK 2 VERIFICATION TEST SUITE');
  console.log('====================================================\n');

  let passed = 0;
  let total = 9;

  users.length = 0;

  // Test 1: GET / and GET /register return 200
  console.log('Test 1: Verify GET / and GET /register return status 200...');
  const resHome = await request('GET', '/');
  const resRegister = await request('GET', '/register');
  if (resHome.statusCode === 200 && resRegister.statusCode === 200) {
    console.log('  ✅ Passed: GET / returned 200, GET /register returned 200.');
    passed++;
  } else {
    console.error(`  ❌ Failed: GET / (${resHome.statusCode}), GET /register (${resRegister.statusCode})`);
  }

  // Test 7 (Part A): GET /users with zero users shows empty state
  console.log('\nTest 7 (Part A): Verify GET /users with zero users shows empty state...');
  const resUsersEmpty = await request('GET', '/users');
  if (resUsersEmpty.statusCode === 200 && resUsersEmpty.body.includes('No Registered Users Yet')) {
    console.log('  ✅ Passed: Empty state properly displayed when users array is empty.');
  } else {
    console.error('  ❌ Failed: Empty state not found in /users response.');
  }

  // Test 2: POST /register with fully valid data: succeeds, user stored, and /users shows them
  console.log('\nTest 2: Verify POST /register with fully valid data...');
  const validData = {
    firstName: 'Jane',
    lastName: 'Doe',
    email: 'jane.doe@example.com',
    phone: '9876543210',
    dob: '2000-01-15',
    password: 'Password123',
    confirmPassword: 'Password123',
    gender: 'Female',
    country: 'United States',
    skills: ['HTML/CSS', 'JavaScript'],
    bio: 'Aspiring full stack engineer.',
    terms: 'on'
  };
  const resPostValid = await request('POST', '/register', validData);
  const isRedirect = resPostValid.statusCode === 302 && resPostValid.headers.location.includes('/success');
  const userStored = users.length === 1 && users[0].email === 'jane.doe@example.com';
  const passwordHashed = users[0].passwordHash && users[0].passwordHash.startsWith('$2') && !users[0].password;

  const resUsersAfterValid = await request('GET', '/users');
  const showsUserInTable = resUsersAfterValid.body.includes('Jane Doe') && 
                           resUsersAfterValid.body.includes('jane.doe@example.com') && 
                           !resUsersAfterValid.body.includes('Password123') &&
                           !resUsersAfterValid.body.includes(users[0].passwordHash);

  if (isRedirect && userStored && passwordHashed && showsUserInTable) {
    console.log('  ✅ Passed: User saved, password hashed with bcrypt, redirected to /success, and user appears in /users without password.');
    passed++;
  } else {
    console.error('  ❌ Failed: Valid user registration failed or password was exposed.');
  }

  // Test 3: POST /register with every field empty: returns 400 and shows error for each field
  console.log('\nTest 3: Verify POST /register with empty fields returns 400 with errors for each field...');
  const emptyData = {};
  const resEmpty = await request('POST', '/register', emptyData);
  const has400 = resEmpty.statusCode === 400;
  const hasFirstNameErr = resEmpty.body.includes('First name is required');
  const hasLastNameErr = resEmpty.body.includes('Last name is required');
  const hasEmailErr = resEmpty.body.includes('Email address is required');
  const hasPhoneErr = resEmpty.body.includes('Phone number is required');
  const hasDobErr = resEmpty.body.includes('Date of birth is required');
  const hasPassErr = resEmpty.body.includes('Password is required');
  const hasGenderErr = resEmpty.body.includes('Please select a gender option');
  const hasCountryErr = resEmpty.body.includes('Please select your country');
  const hasSkillsErr = resEmpty.body.includes('Please select at least one skill');
  const hasTermsErr = resEmpty.body.includes('You must agree to the Terms and Conditions');

  const allErrorsPresent = hasFirstNameErr && hasLastNameErr && hasEmailErr && 
                           hasPhoneErr && hasDobErr && hasPassErr && 
                           hasGenderErr && hasCountryErr && hasSkillsErr && hasTermsErr;

  if (has400 && allErrorsPresent) {
    console.log('  ✅ Passed: Server returned status 400 with validation errors for all required fields.');
    passed++;
  } else {
    console.error('  ❌ Failed: Missing errors or status not 400 for empty form submission.');
  }

  // Test 4: POST /register with invalid email, 9-digit phone, short password, mismatched password
  console.log('\nTest 4: Verify invalid email, 9-digit phone, short password & mismatched password...');
  const invalidFieldsData = {
    firstName: 'Mark',
    lastName: 'Twain',
    email: 'not-an-email',
    phone: '123456789',
    dob: '2005-05-10',
    password: 'pass',
    confirmPassword: 'otherPassword',
    gender: 'Male',
    country: 'Canada',
    skills: ['Python'],
    terms: 'on'
  };
  const resInvalidFields = await request('POST', '/register', invalidFieldsData);
  const hasEmailFormatErr = resInvalidFields.body.includes('Please provide a valid email');
  const hasPhoneLengthErr = resInvalidFields.body.includes('Phone number must be exactly 10 digits');
  const hasPassShortErr = resInvalidFields.body.includes('Password must be at least 8 characters');
  const hasPassMismatchErr = resInvalidFields.body.includes('Passwords do not match');
  const preservesMark = resInvalidFields.body.includes('value="Mark"');
  const preservesTwain = resInvalidFields.body.includes('value="Twain"');
  const noPasswordPreserved = !resInvalidFields.body.includes('value="pass"');

  if (resInvalidFields.statusCode === 400 && hasEmailFormatErr && hasPhoneLengthErr && 
      (hasPassShortErr || hasPassMismatchErr) && preservesMark && preservesTwain && noPasswordPreserved) {
    console.log('  ✅ Passed: Field-specific errors displayed, input values preserved, passwords cleared.');
    passed++;
  } else {
    console.error('  ❌ Failed: Validation errors not properly returned or password not cleared.');
  }

  // Test 5: POST /register twice with same email -> second rejected as duplicate
  console.log('\nTest 5: Verify duplicate email rejection on server...');
  const duplicateData = {
    firstName: 'Second',
    lastName: 'User',
    email: 'JANE.DOE@example.com',
    phone: '1122334455',
    dob: '1995-10-10',
    password: 'Password123',
    confirmPassword: 'Password123',
    gender: 'Female',
    country: 'India',
    skills: ['Node.js'],
    terms: 'on'
  };
  const resDuplicate = await request('POST', '/register', duplicateData);
  if (resDuplicate.statusCode === 400 && resDuplicate.body.includes('This email is already registered.')) {
    console.log('  ✅ Passed: Duplicate email (case-insensitive) rejected with status 400 and error message.');
    passed++;
  } else {
    console.error('  ❌ Failed: Duplicate email was not properly detected/rejected.');
  }

  // Test 6: Skills submitted as none, one, and many: no crashes
  console.log('\nTest 6: Verify skills handling as none, one, and many without crashes...');
  const baseUser = {
    firstName: 'Skill',
    lastName: 'Tester',
    email: 'skill1@test.com',
    phone: '5556667777',
    dob: '1990-01-01',
    password: 'Password999',
    confirmPassword: 'Password999',
    gender: 'Male',
    country: 'Germany',
    terms: 'on'
  };

  const resNoSkills = await request('POST', '/register', { ...baseUser, skills: undefined });
  const noSkillsHandled = resNoSkills.statusCode === 400 && resNoSkills.body.includes('Please select at least one skill');

  const resOneSkill = await request('POST', '/register', { ...baseUser, email: 'skill2@test.com', skills: 'Express' });
  const oneSkillHandled = resOneSkill.statusCode === 302;

  const resManySkills = await request('POST', '/register', { ...baseUser, email: 'skill3@test.com', skills: ['Node.js', 'Express', 'Databases'] });
  const manySkillsHandled = resManySkills.statusCode === 302;

  if (noSkillsHandled && oneSkillHandled && manySkillsHandled) {
    console.log('  ✅ Passed: None (400 error caught), one skill (stored), and many skills (stored) handled safely.');
    passed++;
  } else {
    console.error('  ❌ Failed: Skills normalization caused an error or crash.');
  }

  // Test 7 (Part B): GET /users shows table when populated
  console.log('\nTest 7 (Part B): Verify GET /users shows table when users exist...');
  const resUsersPopulated = await request('GET', '/users');
  const tableRendered = resUsersPopulated.statusCode === 200 && 
                        resUsersPopulated.body.includes('<table') &&
                        resUsersPopulated.body.includes('Total: 3 Users');
  if (tableRendered) {
    console.log('  ✅ Passed: Users table rendered correctly with populated user count.');
    passed++;
  } else {
    console.error('  ❌ Failed: Users table failed to render populated count.');
  }

  // Test 8: Nonexistent URL returns 404 page
  console.log('\nTest 8: Verify nonexistent URL returns 404 page...');
  const res404 = await request('GET', '/nonexistent-random-route-xyz');
  if (res404.statusCode === 404 && res404.body.includes('Page Not Found') && res404.body.includes('404')) {
    console.log('  ✅ Passed: Nonexistent route returned HTTP 404 and rendered custom 404.ejs.');
    passed++;
  } else {
    console.error('  ❌ Failed: 404 handling failed.');
  }

  // Test 9: Confirm client-side validation script is present in served HTML of /register
  console.log('\nTest 9: Verify client-side validation script is present in served HTML...');
  const resRegHtml = await request('GET', '/register');
  const hasScriptTag = resRegHtml.body.includes('<script>') && resRegHtml.body.includes('function validateField');
  const hasOnSubmit = resRegHtml.body.includes('onsubmit="return validateFullForm(event)"');
  const hasLiveBio = resRegHtml.body.includes('updateBioCounter');
  const hasPassToggle = resRegHtml.body.includes('togglePasswordVisibility');

  if (hasScriptTag && hasOnSubmit && hasLiveBio && hasPassToggle) {
    console.log('  ✅ Passed: Inline JavaScript, validateField, onsubmit handler, live counter, and password toggle found in HTML.');
    passed++;
  } else {
    console.error('  ❌ Failed: Client-side validation scripts missing from /register page.');
  }

  console.log('\n====================================================');
  console.log(`📊 TEST RESULTS: ${passed} / ${total} SUITES PASSED`);
  console.log('====================================================\n');

  server.close(() => {
    process.exit(passed === total ? 0 : 1);
  });
}

server = app.listen(PORT, '127.0.0.1', () => {
  runTests().catch(err => {
    console.error('Test runner fatal error:', err);
    if (server) server.close();
    process.exit(1);
  });
});

# Task 2: Inline Styles, Basic Interaction, and Server-Side Validation

**Cognifyz Technologies &bull; Full Stack Web Development Internship (Level 1: Beginner)**

---

## 📖 Project Overview

This project is a beginner-level full-stack web application built using **Node.js**, **Express**, and **EJS**. It demonstrates the complete lifecycle of form validation across the client and server:

1. **Extended HTML5 Semantic Forms**: Implements multiple input types (text, email, tel, date, password, radio buttons, dropdown selects, checkboxes, and a bio textarea with a live character counter).
2. **Inline Styling (`style="..."`)**: Uses modular inline styling directly on HTML elements for layout, colors, responsive containers, box shadows, focus rings, and error borders without external CSS.
3. **Client-Side Validation & Interaction**: Employs inline JavaScript event handlers (`onblur`, `onfocus`, `oninput`, `onsubmit`, and `onchange`) inside `<script>` blocks to provide immediate visual feedback (red/green borders, error messages) and prevent invalid submissions.
4. **Server-Side Validation & Security**: Re-validates all rules on the Express backend, sanitizes inputs, handles duplicate email rejection, hashes passwords using `bcryptjs`, and retains non-sensitive values when re-rendering forms on error (HTTP 400).
5. **Temporary Server-Side Storage**: Stores validated users in an in-memory JavaScript array during server runtime and presents them in a secure, styled table (with passwords strictly excluded).

---

```text
task-2-validation/
├── server.js               # Main Express application, routes & server validation logic
├── package.json            # Node.js project manifest, dependencies & scripts

    ├── partials/

    │   └── footer.ejs      # Common footer with internship credits

    ├── register.ejs        # Complex registration form with inline styles & inline JS
    ├── success.ejs         # Post-registration confirmation card (PRG pattern)
    ├── users.ejs           # Registered users table (or empty state) omitting passwords
    ├── 404.ejs             # Not found handler page (status 404)
    └── error.ejs           # Global 4-argument error handler page (status 500)
```

## 📋 Comprehensive Validation Matrix

| Field | Input Type | Client-Side Rule (Inline JS) | Server-Side Rule (Express `validateRegistration`) | Error Message |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **First Name** | `text` | Required, &ge; 2 chars, letters and spaces only (`/^[A-Za-z\s]{2,}$/`). | Trimmed, required, &ge; 2 chars, letters only. | `"First name is required."` / `"First name must be at least 2 characters."` / `"First name must contain letters only."` |
| **Last Name** | `text` | Required, &ge; 2 chars, letters and spaces only (`/^[A-Za-z\s]{2,}$/`). | Trimmed, required, &ge; 2 chars, letters only. | `"Last name is required."` / `"Last name must be at least 2 characters."` / `"Last name must contain letters only."` |
| **Email** | `email` | Required, valid regex pattern (`/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/`). | Trimmed, lowercased, valid regex, **plus duplicate email check against `users` array (case-insensitive)**. | `"Email address is required."` / `"Please provide a valid email address..."` / `"This email is already registered."` |
| **Phone** | `tel` | Required, exactly 10 numeric digits (`/^\d{10}$/`). | Trimmed, required, regex check for exactly 10 digits (`/^\d{10}$/`). | `"Phone number is required."` / `"Phone number must be exactly 10 digits."` |
| **Date of Birth** | `date` | Required, valid date format, calculated age &ge; 13 years old. | Required, valid date, user age calculated against current date &ge; 13 years. | `"Date of birth is required."` / `"You must be at least 13 years old to register."` |
| **Password** | `password` | Required, &ge; 8 characters, at least 1 letter and 1 number (`/^(?=.*[A-Za-z])(?=.*\d).{8,}$/`). | Required, &ge; 8 characters, at least 1 letter and 1 number. Hashed with `bcryptjs` (salt 10) before storage. | `"Password is required."` / `"Password must be at least 8 characters long."` / `"Password must contain at least one letter and one number."` |
| **Confirm Password** | `password` | Required, exact string match with `password` value. | Required, must strictly equal `password`. Never retained in form re-renders. | `"Confirmation password is required."` / `"Passwords do not match."` |
| **Gender** | `radio` | Must select one radio option (`Male`, `Female`, `Other`, `Prefer not to say`). | Must match one of the allowed whitelist values. | `"Please select a gender option."` |
| **Country** | `select` | Dropdown value cannot be empty. | Must not be empty. | `"Please select your country."` |
| **Skills** | `checkbox` | At least 1 checkbox must be checked. | Normalized (handles undefined, string, or array); array length must be &ge; 1. | `"Please select at least one skill."` |
| **Bio** | `textarea` | Optional, max 200 characters with live counter. | Optional, trimmed, max length 200 characters. | `"Bio cannot exceed 200 characters."` |
| **Terms & Conditions** | `checkbox` | Checkbox must be checked. | Must be checked (`'on'`, `'true'`, or `true`). | `"You must agree to the Terms and Conditions to proceed."` |

## 🔄 The Complete Flow: Client &rarr; Server &rarr; Temporary Storage

```
[ User in Browser ]
       │
       ▼
1. User interacts with form fields (onfocus, onblur, oninput)
   - Real-time client feedback: green border on valid, red on error.
   - Live character count updates as user types bio.
   - Show/hide password checkbox toggles input type.
       │
       ▼
2. User clicks "Create Account" (onsubmit)
   - validateFullForm() verifies every field.
   - If invalid: submission blocked (return false), smooth scroll to first error.
   - If valid: form submitted via HTTP POST to /register.
       │
       ▼
3. Express Server receives POST /register
   - Why Server-Side Validation is Crucial:
     Client validation can be disabled or bypassed via cURL/Postman.
     The server independently re-validates all 12 rules to guarantee integrity.
   - Checks for duplicate emails against registered in-memory users.
   - Normalizes input formats (e.g., skills array).
       │
       ├─── [If Server Errors Found] ───► Responds with HTTP 400 Bad Request
       │                                  Re-renders register.ejs with error messages.
       │                                  Preserves user input (clears sensitive passwords).
       │
       ▼ [If Valid]
4. Security & Temporary Storage
   - Hashes password securely using bcryptjs (salt rounds: 10).
   - Generates ID and timestamp.
   - Appends user record to in-memory array `users = []`.
   - Issues 302 redirect to /success?name=... (Post-Redirect-Get pattern).
       │
       ▼
5. User views confirmation (/success) & checks User Directory (/users)
   - Stored records are displayed in a clean table.
   - Passwords and hashes are strictly excluded from output.
```

FILE: c:\Projects\cogifyz-fullstack-intership\level 1-beginner\task-2\task-2-validation\server.js 
================================================================================ 
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Task 2: Inline Styles, Basic Interaction, and Server-Side Validation
 * Cognifyz Technologies Full Stack Internship - Level 1 (Beginner)
 * ============================================================================
 *
 * File: server.js
 * Description: Express server implementing server-side validation, in-memory
 *              user storage, secure bcryptjs password hashing, and EJS rendering.
 */

const express = require('express');
const path = require('path');
const bcrypt = require('bcryptjs');

// Initialize Express app
const app = express();
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;

// Set EJS as templating engine
app.set('view engine', 'ejs');
app.set('views', path.join(__dirname, 'views'));

// Middleware for parsing form bodies and JSON data
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true }));
app.use(express.json());

// ============================================================================
// TEMPORARY STORAGE (In-Memory JavaScript Array)
// ============================================================================
// As per task instructions, an in-memory array acts as our temporary storage.
// It persists records during the server's lifecycle without requiring a database.
const users = [];

// ============================================================================
// SERVER-SIDE VALIDATION HELPER
// ============================================================================
/**
 * WHY SERVER-SIDE VALIDATION MATTERS:
 * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Client-side validation in the browser improves user experience by offering
 * instantaneous visual feedback (e.g., dynamic red/green borders, error spans).
 * However, client-side validation CAN NEVER BE TRUSTED as a security measure:
 *   1. A user can disable JavaScript in their browser settings.
 *   2. An attacker can alter HTML attributes (such as removing required/pattern)
 *      or bypass event handlers using browser DevTools.
 *   3. Automated HTTP clients (curl, Postman, custom scripts) can send POST
 *      requests directly to /register, bypassing browser execution entirely.
 *
 * Server-side validation is our true perimeter defense. It guarantees that
 * every incoming data payload is sanitized, strictly conforms to business rules,
 * and maintains data integrity before being accepted into storage.
 * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 */

/**
 * Validates registration form inputs.
 * @param {Object} data - Raw form body submitted by client.
 * @param {Array} existingUsers - Array of currently stored users for uniqueness check.
 * @returns {Object} errors - Map of field names to error messages (empty if valid).
 */
function validateRegistration(data, existingUsers = users) {
  const errors = {};

  // 1. Sanitize string inputs (trim leading/trailing whitespace)
  const firstName = (data.firstName || '').trim();
  const lastName = (data.lastName || '').trim();
  const email = (data.email || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const phone = (data.phone || '').trim();
  const dob = (data.dob || '').trim();
  const password = data.password || '';
  const confirmPassword = data.confirmPassword || '';
  const gender = (data.gender || '').trim();
  const country = (data.country || '').trim();
  const bio = (data.bio || '').trim();
  const terms = data.terms;

  // 2. Normalize skills field (could be undefined, a single string, or an array)
  let skills = [];
  if (Array.isArray(data.skills)) {
    skills = data.skills;
  } else if (typeof data.skills === 'string' && data.skills.trim().length > 0) {
    skills = [data.skills.trim()];
  }

  // --- Rule 1: First Name ---
  // Required, at least 2 characters, letters only
  const nameRegex = /^[A-Za-z\s]{2,}$/;
  if (!firstName) {
    errors.firstName = 'First name is required.';
  } else if (firstName.length < 2) {
    errors.firstName = 'First name must be at least 2 characters.';
  } else if (!nameRegex.test(firstName)) {
    errors.firstName = 'First name must contain letters only.';
  }

  // --- Rule 2: Last Name ---
  // Required, at least 2 characters, letters only
  if (!lastName) {
    errors.lastName = 'Last name is required.';
  } else if (lastName.length < 2) {
    errors.lastName = 'Last name must be at least 2 characters.';
  } else if (!nameRegex.test(lastName)) {
    errors.lastName = 'Last name must contain letters only.';
  }

  // --- Rule 3: Email & Server-Only Duplicate Check ---
  // Required, valid email format regex, case-insensitive duplicate check
  const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
  if (!email) {
    errors.email = 'Email address is required.';
  } else if (!emailRegex.test(email)) {
    errors.email = 'Please provide a valid email address (e.g. name@example.com).';
  } else {
    // Additional server-only check: Reject duplicate email against stored users
    const emailExists = existingUsers.some(
      (u) => u.email.toLowerCase() === email
    );
    if (emailExists) {
      errors.email = 'This email is already registered.';
    }
  }

  // --- Rule 4: Phone ---
  // Required, exactly 10 digits
  const phoneRegex = /^\d{10}$/;
  if (!phone) {
    errors.phone = 'Phone number is required.';
  } else if (!phoneRegex.test(phone)) {
    errors.phone = 'Phone number must be exactly 10 digits.';
  }

  // --- Rule 5: Date of Birth & Minimum Age (13 Years) ---
  if (!dob) {
    errors.dob = 'Date of birth is required.';
  } else {
    const dobDate = new Date(dob);
    if (isNaN(dobDate.getTime())) {
      errors.dob = 'Please provide a valid date.';
    } else {
      const today = new Date();
      let age = today.getFullYear() - dobDate.getFullYear();
      const monthDiff = today.getMonth() - dobDate.getMonth();
      if (monthDiff < 0 || (monthDiff === 0 && today.getDate() < dobDate.getDate())) {
        age--;
      }
      if (age < 13) {
        errors.dob = 'You must be at least 13 years old to register.';
      }
    }
  }

  // --- Rule 6: Password ---
  // At least 8 characters, at least one letter and one number
  const passwordRegex = /^(?=.*[A-Za-z])(?=.*\d).{8,}$/;
  if (!password) {
    errors.password = 'Password is required.';
  } else if (password.length < 8) {
    errors.password = 'Password must be at least 8 characters long.';
  } else if (!passwordRegex.test(password)) {
    errors.password = 'Password must contain at least one letter and one number.';
  }

  // --- Rule 7: Confirm Password ---
  // Must match password
  if (!confirmPassword) {
    errors.confirmPassword = 'Confirmation password is required.';
  } else if (password !== confirmPassword) {
    errors.confirmPassword = 'Passwords do not match.';
  }

  // --- Rule 8: Gender ---
  // One radio must be chosen from allowed options
  const allowedGenders = ['Male', 'Female', 'Other', 'Prefer not to say'];
  if (!gender || !allowedGenders.includes(gender)) {
    errors.gender = 'Please select a gender option.';
  }

  // --- Rule 9: Country ---
  // Non-empty selection from dropdown
  if (!country) {
    errors.country = 'Please select your country.';
  }

  // --- Rule 10: Skills ---
  // At least one skill checkbox selected
  if (skills.length === 0) {
    errors.skills = 'Please select at least one skill.';
  }

  // --- Rule 11: Bio ---
  // Optional, but cannot exceed 200 characters
  if (bio && bio.length > 200) {
    errors.bio = 'Bio cannot exceed 200 characters.';
  }

  // --- Rule 12: Terms and Conditions ---
  // Must be checked
  if (terms !== 'on' && terms !== 'true' && terms !== true) {
    errors.terms = 'You must agree to the Terms and Conditions to proceed.';
  }

  return errors;
}

    activePage: 'register',

  });

/**
 * POST /register
 * Validates submitted data on the server.
 * - If errors exist: responds with status 400 and re-renders register.ejs,
 *   preserving previously entered values (passwords are strictly redacted).
 * - If valid: hashes password with bcryptjs, saves to users array, and redirects to /success.
 */
app.post('/register', async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const rawData = req.body;
    const errors = validateRegistration(rawData, users);

    // If validation fails, return status 400 and preserve user input (NEVER passwords)
    if (Object.keys(errors).length > 0) {
      const safeFormData = { ...rawData };
      delete safeFormData.password;
      delete safeFormData.confirmPassword;

      if (!Array.isArray(safeFormData.skills)) {
        safeFormData.skills = safeFormData.skills ? [safeFormData.skills] : [];
      }

      return res.status(400).render('register', {
        title: 'Register - Fix Errors',
        activePage: 'register',
        formData: safeFormData,
        errors: errors
      });
    }

    // --- Data is valid ---
    // Security: Hash password using bcryptjs with 10 salt rounds
    // Passwords are never stored, logged, or exposed in plain text.
    const saltRounds = 10;
    const passwordHash = await bcrypt.hash(rawData.password, saltRounds);

    let normalizedSkills = [];
    if (Array.isArray(rawData.skills)) {
      normalizedSkills = rawData.skills;
    } else if (rawData.skills) {
      normalizedSkills = [rawData.skills];
    }

    const newUser = {
      id: users.length + 1,
      firstName: rawData.firstName.trim(),
      lastName: rawData.lastName.trim(),
      email: rawData.email.trim().toLowerCase(),
      phone: rawData.phone.trim(),
      dob: rawData.dob.trim(),
      gender: rawData.gender,
      country: rawData.country,
      skills: normalizedSkills,
      bio: (rawData.bio || '').trim(),
      passwordHash: passwordHash,
      createdAt: new Date().toLocaleString('en-US', {
        dateStyle: 'medium',
        timeStyle: 'short'
      })
    };

    // Store in temporary in-memory array
    users.push(newUser);

    // Post-Redirect-Get pattern: Redirect to /success
    res.redirect(`/success?name=${encodeURIComponent(newUser.firstName)}`);
  } catch (err) {
    next(err);
  }
});

/**
 * GET /success
 * Registration confirmation page showing congratulatory message.
 */
app.get('/success', (req, res) => {
  const name = req.query.name || 'Friend';
  res.render('success', {
    title: 'Registration Successful',
    activePage: 'register',
    name: name,
    totalUsers: users.length
  });
});

/**
 * GET /users
 * Displays all stored users in a styled table.
 * Strictly excludes passwords and password hashes. Shows empty state if none exist.
 */
app.get('/users', (req, res) => {
  const safeUsers = users.map((u) => ({
    id: u.id,
    name: `${u.firstName} ${u.lastName}`,
    email: u.email,
    phone: u.phone,
    country: u.country,
    skills: u.skills,
    createdAt: u.createdAt
  }));

  res.render('users', {
    title: 'Registered Users - In-Memory Store',
    activePage: 'users',
    users: safeUsers,
    totalCount: users.length
  });
});

    path: req.originalUrl
  });

/**
 * Automated Verification Script for Task 2

const http = require('http');
const { app, users } = require('./server');

const PORT = 3999;
let server;

function request(method, path, data = null, headers = {}) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    let postData = '';
    const reqHeaders = { ...headers };

    if (data) {
      if (typeof data === 'object') {
        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(data)) {
          if (Array.isArray(val)) {
            val.forEach(v => params.append(key, v));
          } else if (val !== undefined && val !== null) {
            params.append(key, val);
          }
        }
        postData = params.toString();
        reqHeaders['Content-Type'] = 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded';
        reqHeaders['Content-Length'] = Buffer.byteLength(postData);
      } else {
        postData = data;
      }
    }

    const options = {
      hostname: '127.0.0.1',
      port: PORT,
      path: path,
      method: method,
      headers: reqHeaders
    };

    const req = http.request(options, (res) => {
      let body = '';
      res.on('data', (chunk) => body += chunk);
      res.on('end', () => {
        resolve({
          statusCode: res.statusCode,
          headers: res.headers,
          body: body
        });
      });
    });

    req.on('error', (err) => reject(err));

    if (postData) {
      req.write(postData);
    }
    req.end();
  });
}

# Task 2: Inline Styles, Basic Interaction, and Server-Side Validation

**Cognifyz Technologies &bull; Full Stack Web Development Internship (Level 1: Beginner)**

---

## 📖 Project Overview

This project is a beginner-level full-stack web application built using **Node.js**, **Express**, and **EJS**. It demonstrates the complete lifecycle of form validation across the client and server:

1. **Extended HTML5 Semantic Forms**: Implements multiple input types (text, email, tel, date, password, radio buttons, dropdown selects, checkboxes, and a bio textarea with a live character counter).
2. **Inline Styling (`style="..."`)**: Uses modular inline styling directly on HTML elements for layout, colors, responsive containers, box shadows, focus rings, and error borders without external CSS.
3. **Client-Side Validation & Interaction**: Employs inline JavaScript event handlers (`onblur`, `onfocus`, `oninput`, `onsubmit`, and `onchange`) inside `<script>` blocks to provide immediate visual feedback (red/green borders, error messages) and prevent invalid submissions.
4. **Server-Side Validation & Security**: Re-validates all rules on the Express backend, sanitizes inputs, handles duplicate email rejection, hashes passwords using `bcryptjs`, and retains non-sensitive values when re-rendering forms on error (HTTP 400).
5. **Temporary Server-Side Storage**: Stores validated users in an in-memory JavaScript array during server runtime and presents them in a secure, styled table (with passwords strictly excluded).

---

```text

├── server.js               # Main Express application, routes & server validation logic

    ├── partials/

    │   └── footer.ejs      # Common footer with internship credits
    ├── index.ejs           # Landing page with architecture & conceptual guides
    ├── register.ejs        # Complex registration form with inline styles & inline JS
    ├── success.ejs         # Post-registration confirmation card (PRG pattern)
    ├── users.ejs           # Registered users table (or empty state) omitting passwords
    ├── 404.ejs             # Not found handler page (status 404)
    └── error.ejs           # Global 4-argument error handler page (status 500)
```

## 📋 Comprehensive Validation Matrix

| Field | Input Type | Client-Side Rule (Inline JS) | Server-Side Rule (Express `validateRegistration`) | Error Message |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **First Name** | `text` | Required, &ge; 2 chars, letters and spaces only (`/^[A-Za-z\s]{2,}$/`). | Trimmed, required, &ge; 2 chars, letters only. | `"First name is required."` / `"First name must be at least 2 characters."` / `"First name must contain letters only."` |
| **Last Name** | `text` | Required, &ge; 2 chars, letters and spaces only (`/^[A-Za-z\s]{2,}$/`). | Trimmed, required, &ge; 2 chars, letters only. | `"Last name is required."` / `"Last name must be at least 2 characters."` / `"Last name must contain letters only."` |
| **Email** | `email` | Required, valid regex pattern (`/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/`). | Trimmed, lowercased, valid regex, **plus duplicate email check against `users` array (case-insensitive)**. | `"Email address is required."` / `"Please provide a valid email address..."` / `"This email is already registered."` |
| **Phone** | `tel` | Required, exactly 10 numeric digits (`/^\d{10}$/`). | Trimmed, required, regex check for exactly 10 digits (`/^\d{10}$/`). | `"Phone number is required."` / `"Phone number must be exactly 10 digits."` |
| **Date of Birth** | `date` | Required, valid date format, calculated age &ge; 13 years old. | Required, valid date, user age calculated against current date &ge; 13 years. | `"Date of birth is required."` / `"You must be at least 13 years old to register."` |
| **Password** | `password` | Required, &ge; 8 characters, at least 1 letter and 1 number (`/^(?=.*[A-Za-z])(?=.*\d).{8,}$/`). | Required, &ge; 8 characters, at least 1 letter and 1 number. Hashed with `bcryptjs` (salt 10) before storage. | `"Password is required."` / `"Password must be at least 8 characters long."` / `"Password must contain at least one letter and one number."` |
| **Confirm Password** | `password` | Required, exact string match with `password` value. | Required, must strictly equal `password`. Never retained in form re-renders. | `"Confirmation password is required."` / `"Passwords do not match."` |
| **Gender** | `radio` | Must select one radio option (`Male`, `Female`, `Other`, `Prefer not to say`). | Must match one of the allowed whitelist values. | `"Please select a gender option."` |
| **Country** | `select` | Dropdown value cannot be empty. | Must not be empty. | `"Please select your country."` |
| **Skills** | `checkbox` | At least 1 checkbox must be checked. | Normalized (handles undefined, string, or array); array length must be &ge; 1. | `"Please select at least one skill."` |
| **Bio** | `textarea` | Optional, max 200 characters with live counter. | Optional, trimmed, max length 200 characters. | `"Bio cannot exceed 200 characters."` |
| **Terms & Conditions** | `checkbox` | Checkbox must be checked. | Must be checked (`'on'`, `'true'`, or `true`). | `"You must agree to the Terms and Conditions to proceed."` |

---

## 🔄 The Complete Flow: Client &rarr; Server &rarr; Temporary Storage

```
[ User in Browser ]
       │
       ▼
1. User interacts with form fields (onfocus, onblur, oninput)
   - Real-time client feedback: green border on valid, red on error.
   - Live character count updates as user types bio.
   - Show/hide password checkbox toggles input type.
       │
       ▼
2. User clicks "Create Account" (onsubmit)
   - validateFullForm() verifies every field.
   - If invalid: submission blocked (return false), smooth scroll to first error.
   - If valid: form submitted via HTTP POST to /register.
       │
       ▼
3. Express Server receives POST /register
   - Why Server-Side Validation is Crucial:
     Client validation can be disabled or bypassed via cURL/Postman.
     The server independently re-validates all 12 rules to guarantee integrity.
   - Checks for duplicate emails against registered in-memory users.
   - Normalizes input formats (e.g., skills array).
       │
       ├─── [If Server Errors Found] ───► Responds with HTTP 400 Bad Request
       │                                  Re-renders register.ejs with error messages.
       │                                  Preserves user input (clears sensitive passwords).
       │
       ▼ [If Valid]
4. Security & Temporary Storage
   - Hashes password securely using bcryptjs (salt rounds: 10).
   - Generates ID and timestamp.
   - Appends user record to in-memory array `users = []`.
   - Issues 302 redirect to /success?name=... (Post-Redirect-Get pattern).
       │
       ▼
5. User views confirmation (/success) & checks User Directory (/users)
   - Stored records are displayed in a clean table.
   - Passwords and hashes are strictly excluded from output.
```

        <h4 style="margin: 0 0 8px 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: #1d4ed8;">
          Client-Side Validation (Browser)
        </h4>
        <ul style="margin: 0; padding-left: 18px; font-size: 13.5px; color: #475569; line-height: 1.6;">
          <li>Executed directly in the browser via JavaScript.</li>
          <li>Provides instant visual cues before submission (e.g. green border on valid, red on error).</li>
          <li>Prevents unnecessary HTTP traffic for obvious typos.</li>
          <li><strong style="color: #b91c1c;">Limitation:</strong> Can be bypassed by disabling JS, modifying DOM, or sending direct API requests via Postman/cURL.</li>
        </ul>
      </div>

      <!-- Server Side Box -->
      <div style="border-left: 4px solid #10b981; background-color: #f8fafc; padding: 18px 20px; border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;">

          Server-Side Validation (Node.js/Express)
        </h4>
        <ul style="margin: 0; padding-left: 18px; font-size: 13.5px; color: #475569; line-height: 1.6;">
          <li>Executed on the server before accepting any data into memory or a database.</li>
          <li>The ultimate defense against malicious payloads, tampering, and invalid formats.</li>
          <li>Performs database-level checks (e.g., verifying that an email is not already taken).</li>
          <li><strong style="color: #047857;">Best Practice:</strong> Always validate on both layers for optimal UX and ironclad security.</li>
        </ul>

              onfocus="handleFocus(this)"

          const selectedSkills = Array.isArray(formData.skills) ? formData.skills : (formData.skills ? [formData.skills] : []);
          skillList.forEach((skill) => {
        %>
          <label style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 13.5px; color: #334155; cursor: pointer; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px; background-color: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;">

'border: 1.5px solid #ef4444; background-color: #fef2f2;' : 'border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; background-color: #ffffff;' %>"
                onfocus="handleFocus(this)"
                onblur="handleBlur(this, 'bio')"
                oninput="updateBioCounter(this); validateField('bio');"><%= formData.bio || '' %></textarea>
      <span id="bio-error" style="font-size: 12px; color: #dc2626; margin-top: 4px; font-weight: 500; display: <%= errors.bio ? 'block' : 'none' %>;">

        </span>

              onmouseover="this.style.backgroundColor='#1d4ed8'; this.style.transform='translateY(-1px)';"
              onmouseout="this.style.backgroundColor='#2563eb'; this.style.transform='translateY(0)';"

<!-- INLINE JAVASCRIPT: CLIENT-SIDE VALIDATION & INTERACTION -->
<!-- ======================================================================= -->
<script>
  /**
   * Focus Style Handler
   * Applies an accessible, active visual glow when a field gains focus.
   */
  function handleFocus(element) {
    element.style.borderColor = '#2563eb';
    element.style.boxShadow = '0 0 0 3px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.15)';
  }

  /**
   * Blur Style Handler
   * Removes focus glow and performs real-time field validation.
   */
  function handleBlur(element, fieldName) {
    element.style.boxShadow = 'none';
    validateField(fieldName);
  }

  /**
   * Password Visibility Toggle
   * Toggles the input type between "password" and "text" for both password fields.
   */
  function togglePasswordVisibility() {
    var pass = document.getElementById('password');
    var confirmPass = document.getElementById('confirmPassword');
    var isChecked = document.getElementById('togglePassword').checked;

    var newType = isChecked ? 'text' : 'password';
    if (pass) pass.type = newType;
    if (confirmPass) confirmPass.type = newType;
  }

  /**
   * Live Character Counter for Bio
   * Updates character count text and turns red if maximum length is approached/exceeded.
   */
  function updateBioCounter(textarea) {
    var counter = document.getElementById('bio-counter');
    if (!counter) return;
    var len = textarea.value.length;
    counter.textContent = len + ' / 200 characters';
    if (len >= 200) {
      counter.style.color = '#ef4444';
    } else {
      counter.style.color = '#64748b';
    }
  }

  /**
   * Helper: Show Error on Input
   */
  function showFieldError(inputElement, errorElement, message) {
    if (errorElement) {
      errorElement.textContent = message;
      errorElement.style.display = 'block';
    }
    if (inputElement && inputElement.style) {
      inputElement.style.borderColor = '#ef4444';
      inputElement.style.backgroundColor = '#fef2f2';
    }
  }

  /**
   * Helper: Clear Error & Set Valid State
   */
  function showFieldSuccess(inputElement, errorElement) {
    if (errorElement) {
      errorElement.textContent = '';
      errorElement.style.display = 'none';
    }
    if (inputElement && inputElement.style) {
      inputElement.style.borderColor = '#10b981'; // Green border
      inputElement.style.backgroundColor = '#ffffff';
    }
  }

  /**
   * Individual Field Validator
   * Validates a single field according to requirements.
   * @param {string} field - The identifier of the field being validated.
   * @returns {boolean} - True if valid, false otherwise.
   */
  function validateField(field) {
    var isValid = true;
    var lettersOnlyRegex = /^[A-Za-z\s]{2,}$/;

    // 1. First Name
    if (field === 'firstName') {
      var input = document.getElementById('firstName');
      var err = document.getElementById('firstName-error');
      var val = (input.value || '').trim();

      if (!val) {
        showFieldError(input, err, 'First name is required.');
        isValid = false;
      } else if (val.length < 2) {
        showFieldError(input, err, 'First name must be at least 2 characters.');
        isValid = false;
      } else if (!lettersOnlyRegex.test(val)) {
        showFieldError(input, err, 'First name must contain letters only.');
        isValid = false;
      } else {
        showFieldSuccess(input, err);
      }
    }

    // 2. Last Name
    if (field === 'lastName') {
      var input = document.getElementById('lastName');
      var err = document.getElementById('lastName-error');
      var val = (input.value || '').trim();

      if (!val) {
        showFieldError(input, err, 'Last name is required.');
        isValid = false;
      } else if (val.length < 2) {
        showFieldError(input, err, 'Last name must be at least 2 characters.');
        isValid = false;
      } else if (!lettersOnlyRegex.test(val)) {
        showFieldError(input, err, 'Last name must contain letters only.');
        isValid = false;
      } else {
        showFieldSuccess(input, err);
      }
    }

    // 3. Email
    if (field === 'email') {
      var input = document.getElementById('email');
      var err = document.getElementById('email-error');
      var val = (input.value || '').trim();
      var emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;

      if (!val) {
        showFieldError(input, err, 'Email address is required.');
        isValid = false;
      } else if (!emailRegex.test(val)) {
        showFieldError(input, err, 'Please provide a valid email format (e.g. user@example.com).');
        isValid = false;
      } else {
        showFieldSuccess(input, err);
      }
    }

    // 4. Phone
    if (field === 'phone') {
      var input = document.getElementById('phone');
      var err = document.getElementById('phone-error');
      var val = (input.value || '').trim();
      var phoneRegex = /^\d{10}$/;

      if (!val) {
        showFieldError(input, err, 'Phone number is required.');
        isValid = false;
      } else if (!phoneRegex.test(val)) {
        showFieldError(input, err, 'Phone number must be exactly 10 digits.');
        isValid = false;
      } else {
        showFieldSuccess(input, err);
      }
    }

    // 5. Date of Birth (Minimum age 13)
    if (field === 'dob') {
      var input = document.getElementById('dob');
      var err = document.getElementById('dob-error');
      var val = input.value;

      if (!val) {
        showFieldError(input, err, 'Date of birth is required.');
        isValid = false;
      } else {
        var dobDate = new Date(val);
        if (isNaN(dobDate.getTime())) {
          showFieldError(input, err, 'Please select a valid date.');
          isValid = false;
        } else {
          var today = new Date();
          var age = today.getFullYear() - dobDate.getFullYear();
          var monthDiff = today.getMonth() - dobDate.getMonth();
          if (monthDiff < 0 || (monthDiff === 0 && today.getDate() < dobDate.getDate())) {
            age--;
          }
          if (age < 13) {
            showFieldError(input, err, 'You must be at least 13 years old to register.');
            isValid = false;
          } else {
            showFieldSuccess(input, err);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // 6. Password
    if (field === 'password') {
      var input = document.getElementById('password');
      var err = document.getElementById('password-error');
      var val = input.value || '';
      var passRegex = /^(?=.*[A-Za-z])(?=.*\d).{8,}$/;

      if (!val) {
        showFieldError(input, err, 'Password is required.');
        isValid = false;
      } else if (val.length < 8) {
        showFieldError(input, err, 'Password must be at least 8 characters long.');
        isValid = false;
      } else if (!passRegex.test(val)) {
        showFieldError(input, err, 'Password must contain at least one letter and one number.');
        isValid = false;
      } else {
        showFieldSuccess(input, err);
      }
    }

    // 7. Confirm Password
    if (field === 'confirmPassword') {
      var passInput = document.getElementById('password');
      var input = document.getElementById('confirmPassword');
      var err = document.getElementById('confirmPassword-error');
      var val = input.value || '';

      if (!val) {
        showFieldError(input, err, 'Please confirm your password.');
        isValid = false;
      } else if (val !== passInput.value) {
        showFieldError(input, err, 'Passwords do not match.');
        isValid = false;
      } else {
        showFieldSuccess(input, err);
      }
    }

    // 8. Gender
    if (field === 'gender') {
      var err = document.getElementById('gender-error');
      var selected = document.querySelector('input[name="gender"]:checked');
      if (!selected) {
        if (err) {
          err.textContent = 'Please select a gender option.';
          err.style.display = 'block';
        }
        isValid = false;
      } else {
        if (err) {
          err.textContent = '';
          err.style.display = 'none';
        }
      }
    }

    // 9. Country
    if (field === 'country') {
      var input = document.getElementById('country');
      var err = document.getElementById('country-error');
      if (!input.value) {
        showFieldError(input, err, 'Please select your country.');
        isValid = false;
      } else {
        showFieldSuccess(input, err);
      }
    }

    // 10. Skills
    if (field === 'skills') {
      var err = document.getElementById('skills-error');
      var checkedSkills = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="skills"]:checked');
      if (checkedSkills.length === 0) {
        if (err) {
          err.textContent = 'Please select at least one technical skill.';
          err.style.display = 'block';
        }
        isValid = false;
      } else {
        if (err) {
          err.textContent = '';
          err.style.display = 'none';
        }
      }
    }

    // 11. Bio
    if (field === 'bio') {
      var input = document.getElementById('bio');
      var err = document.getElementById('bio-error');
      var val = input.value || '';
      if (val.length > 200) {
        showFieldError(input, err, 'Bio cannot exceed 200 characters.');
        isValid = false;
      } else {
        showFieldSuccess(input, err);
      }
    }

    // 12. Terms
    if (field === 'terms') {
      var input = document.getElementById('terms');
      var err = document.getElementById('terms-error');
      if (!input.checked) {
        if (err) {
          err.textContent = 'You must agree to the Terms and Conditions to proceed.';
          err.style.display = 'block';
        }
        isValid = false;
      } else {
        if (err) {
          err.textContent = '';
          err.style.display = 'none';
        }
      }
    }

    return isValid;
  }

  /**
   * Full Form Validation on Submission
   * Validates every field. If any rule fails:
   *  - Prevents form submission
   *  - Scrolls to and focuses the first invalid element
   *  - Returns false
   */
  function validateFullForm(event) {
    var fieldsToValidate = [
      'firstName', 'lastName', 'email', 'phone', 
      'dob', 'password', 'confirmPassword', 
      'gender', 'country', 'skills', 'bio', 'terms'
    ];

    var formIsValid = true;
    var firstInvalidElement = null;

    for (var i = 0; i < fieldsToValidate.length; i++) {
      var fieldName = fieldsToValidate[i];
      var isFieldValid = validateField(fieldName);

      if (!isFieldValid) {
        formIsValid = false;
        if (!firstInvalidElement) {
          if (fieldName === 'gender') {
            firstInvalidElement = document.querySelector('input[name="gender"]');
          } else if (fieldName === 'skills') {
            firstInvalidElement = document.querySelector('input[name="skills"]');
          } else {
            firstInvalidElement = document.getElementById(fieldName);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    if (!formIsValid) {
      if (event && event.preventDefault) {
        event.preventDefault();
      }

      // Smooth scroll and focus to the first invalid field
      if (firstInvalidElement) {
        firstInvalidElement.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
        if (firstInvalidElement.focus) {
          firstInvalidElement.focus();
        }
      }

      return false;
    }

    return true;
  }
</script>
