 * Validates Terms and Conditions checkbox.
 */
export function validateTerms(accepted) {
  if (!accepted) {
    return "You must agree to the Terms of Service to register.";
  }
  return "";
}

import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";

// Mock localStorage for Node.js environment
class LocalStorageMock {
  constructor() {
    this.store = {};
  }
  getItem(key) {
    return this.store[key] || null;
  }
  setItem(key, value) {
    this.store[key] = String(value);
  }
  removeItem(key) {
    delete this.store[key];
  }
  clear() {
    this.store = {};
  }
}

globalThis.localStorage = new LocalStorageMock();

// Dynamically import store after localStorage mock is configured
const { store } = await import("../public/js/store.js");

test("Store: Persistence, CRUD, and Statistics", async (t) => {
  await t.test("initializes with demo profiles", () => {
    const profiles = store.getProfiles();
    assert.ok(profiles.length >= 3, "Should have at least 3 initial demo profiles");
    assert.equal(profiles[0].fullName, "Alex Rivera");
  });

  await t.test("saves a new profile and retrieves by id", () => {
    const newProfile = {
      fullName: "Samantha Carter",
      username: "sam_carter",
      email: "sam.carter@example.com",
      phone: "5551234567",
      dob: "1994-06-15",
      country: "United States",
      state: "California",
      city: "Los Angeles",
      skills: ["JavaScript", "TypeScript", "Node.js"],
      bio: "Senior engineer building scalable SPA applications."
    };

    const saved = store.saveProfile(newProfile);
    assert.ok(saved.id.startsWith("profile_"), "ID should be generated");
    assert.ok(saved.createdAt, "createdAt timestamp should exist");

    const retrieved = store.getProfileById(saved.id);
    assert.equal(retrieved.fullName, "Samantha Carter");
    assert.equal(retrieved.username, "sam_carter");
  });

  await t.test("updates an existing profile", () => {
    const all = store.getProfiles();
    const target = all.find((p) => p.username === "sam_carter");
    assert.ok(target, "Should find saved profile");

    const updated = store.updateProfile(target.id, {
      bio: "Updated bio for Samantha.",
      skills: ["JavaScript", "TypeScript", "Node.js", "Express"]
    });

    assert.equal(updated.bio, "Updated bio for Samantha.");
    assert.equal(updated.skills.length, 4);
    assert.ok(updated.updatedAt, "Should stamp updatedAt");
  });

  await t.test("calculates statistics accurately", () => {
    const stats = store.getStatistics();
    assert.ok(stats.totalProfiles >= 4);
    assert.ok(stats.totalCountries >= 3);
    assert.ok(stats.mostCommonSkill.includes("JavaScript"));
  });

  await t.test("deletes a profile by id", () => {
    const all = store.getProfiles();
    const countBefore = all.length;
    const target = all[0];

    const deleted = store.deleteProfile(target.id);
    assert.equal(deleted, true);

    const allAfter = store.getProfiles();
    assert.equal(allAfter.length, countBefore - 1);
    assert.equal(store.getProfileById(target.id), null);
  });

  await t.test("resets to demo profiles", () => {
    store.clearAllProfiles();
    assert.equal(store.getProfiles().length, 0);

    store.resetToDemo();
    assert.equal(store.getProfiles().length, 3);
  });
});


 
================================================================================ 
FILE: c:\Projects\cogifyz-fullstack-intership\level 2-intermediate\task-4\task-4-spa-forms\test\validators.test.js

import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";

import {
  validateFullName,
  validateUsername,
  validateEmail,
  validatePhone,
  validateDateOfBirth,
  checkPasswordStrength,
  validatePassword,
  validateConfirmPassword,
  validateCountry,
  validateState,
  validateCity,
  validateSkills,
  validateBio,
  validateTerms
} from "../public/js/validators.js";

test("Full Name Validation", async (t) => {
  await t.test("accepts valid full names", () => {
    assert.equal(validateFullName("John Doe"), "");
    assert.equal(validateFullName("Jane O'Connor"), "");
    assert.equal(validateFullName("Jean-Luc Picard"), "");
    assert.equal(validateFullName("Ana Sofia de la Cruz"), "");
  });

  await t.test("rejects missing, too short, or too long names", () => {
    assert.notEqual(validateFullName(""), "");
    assert.notEqual(validateFullName("   "), "");
    assert.notEqual(validateFullName("A"), "");
    assert.notEqual(validateFullName("A".repeat(51)), "");
  });

  await t.test("rejects names with numbers or illegal symbols", () => {
    assert.notEqual(validateFullName("John123"), "");
    assert.notEqual(validateFullName("John @ Doe"), "");
    assert.notEqual(validateFullName("John_Doe"), "");
  });
});

test("Username Validation", async (t) => {
  const existingUsernames = ["alex_dev", "sarah123", "morpheus"];

  await t.test("accepts valid alphanumeric usernames starting with a letter", () => {
    assert.equal(validateUsername("alexander", existingUsernames), "");
    assert.equal(validateUsername("dev_coder_99", existingUsernames), "");
    assert.equal(validateUsername("Neo1", existingUsernames), "");
  });

  await t.test("rejects usernames starting with numbers or underscores", () => {
    assert.notEqual(validateUsername("123alex", existingUsernames), "");
    assert.notEqual(validateUsername("_coder", existingUsernames), "");
  });

  await t.test("rejects usernames shorter than 4 or longer than 15 characters", () => {
    assert.notEqual(validateUsername("abc", existingUsernames), "");
    assert.notEqual(validateUsername("a_very_long_username_here", existingUsernames), "");
  });

  await t.test("rejects usernames with special characters or spaces", () => {
    assert.notEqual(validateUsername("alex-dev", existingUsernames), "");
    assert.notEqual(validateUsername("alex dev", existingUsernames), "");
    assert.notEqual(validateUsername("alex@dev", existingUsernames), "");
  });

  await t.test("enforces case-insensitive uniqueness against existing profiles", () => {
    assert.notEqual(validateUsername("alex_dev", existingUsernames), "");
    assert.notEqual(validateUsername("ALEX_DEV", existingUsernames), "");
    assert.notEqual(validateUsername("Sarah123", existingUsernames), "");
    // Allowed if matching current user during edit
    assert.equal(validateUsername("alex_dev", existingUsernames, "alex_dev"), "");
  });
});

test("Email Validation", async (t) => {
  const existingEmails = ["john@example.com", "sarah@tech.org"];

  await t.test("accepts strictly valid email addresses", () => {
    assert.equal(validateEmail("user@example.com", existingEmails), "");
    assert.equal(validateEmail("alex.smith+test@domain.co.uk", existingEmails), "");
  });

  await t.test("rejects invalid email formats", () => {
    assert.notEqual(validateEmail("not-an-email", existingEmails), "");
    assert.notEqual(validateEmail("user@domain", existingEmails), "");
    assert.notEqual(validateEmail("@missinguser.com", existingEmails), "");
    assert.notEqual(validateEmail("spaces in@email.com", existingEmails), "");
  });

  await t.test("enforces uniqueness (case-insensitive)", () => {
    assert.notEqual(validateEmail("john@example.com", existingEmails), "");
    assert.notEqual(validateEmail("JOHN@EXAMPLE.COM", existingEmails), "");
    assert.equal(validateEmail("john@example.com", existingEmails, "john@example.com"), "");
  });
});

test("Phone Validation", async (t) => {
  await t.test("accepts 10-digit numbers in various common formats", () => {
    assert.equal(validatePhone("1234567890"), "");
    assert.equal(validatePhone("(123) 456-7890"), "");
    assert.equal(validatePhone("123 456 7890"), "");
    assert.equal(validatePhone("123-456-7890"), "");
  });

  await t.test("rejects numbers not containing exactly 10 digits", () => {
    assert.notEqual(validatePhone("123456789"), ""); // 9 digits
    assert.notEqual(validatePhone("12345678901"), ""); // 11 digits
    assert.notEqual(validatePhone(""), "");
    assert.notEqual(validatePhone("0000000000"), ""); // repetitive dummy
  });
});

test("Date of Birth Validation", async (t) => {
  await t.test("accepts age >= 18", () => {
    assert.equal(validateDateOfBirth("1995-05-15"), "");
    assert.equal(validateDateOfBirth("2000-01-01"), "");
  });

  await t.test("rejects future dates", () => {
    const futureYear = new Date().getFullYear() + 2;
    assert.notEqual(validateDateOfBirth(`${futureYear}-01-01`), "");
  });

  await t.test("rejects minors under 18 years old", () => {
    const today = new Date();
    const minorDate = new Date(today.getFullYear() - 17, today.getMonth(), today.getDate())
      .toISOString()
      .split("T")[0];
    assert.notEqual(validateDateOfBirth(minorDate), "");
  });

  await t.test("rejects invalid date strings", () => {
    assert.notEqual(validateDateOfBirth("not-a-date"), "");
    assert.notEqual(validateDateOfBirth(""), "");
  });
});

test("Password Strength & Checklist Validation", async (t) => {
  await t.test("identifies weak passwords", () => {
    const res1 = checkPasswordStrength("abc");
    assert.equal(res1.label, "Weak");
    assert.equal(res1.isValid, false);

    const res2 = checkPasswordStrength("abcdefgh"); // no upper, number, special
    assert.equal(res2.isValid, false);
    assert.equal(res2.rules.hasUpper, false);
    assert.equal(res2.rules.hasNumber, false);
    assert.equal(res2.rules.hasSpecial, false);
  });

  await t.test("identifies fair passwords", () => {
    const res = checkPasswordStrength("Abcdefgh"); // has upper, lower, length, no space, no username (missing number & special: 5/7)
    assert.equal(res.label, "Fair");
    assert.equal(res.rules.hasSpecial, false);
    assert.equal(res.rules.hasNumber, false);
    assert.equal(res.isValid, false);
  });

  await t.test("identifies good passwords", () => {
    const res = checkPasswordStrength("Abcdefgh1"); // missing special only (6/7)
    assert.equal(res.label, "Good");
    assert.equal(res.rules.hasSpecial, false);
    assert.equal(res.isValid, false);
  });

  await t.test("identifies strong and valid passwords meeting all 7 rules", () => {
    const res = checkPasswordStrength("Secr3t!P@ss", "alexander");
    assert.equal(res.label, "Strong");
    assert.equal(res.score, 4);
    assert.equal(res.isValid, true);
    assert.equal(res.rules.minLength, true);
    assert.equal(res.rules.hasUpper, true);
    assert.equal(res.rules.hasLower, true);
    assert.equal(res.rules.hasNumber, true);
    assert.equal(res.rules.hasSpecial, true);
    assert.equal(res.rules.noSpaces, true);
    assert.equal(res.rules.noUsername, true);
    assert.equal(validatePassword("Secr3t!P@ss", "alexander"), "");
  });

  await t.test("rejects passwords containing the username", () => {
    const res = checkPasswordStrength("Alex99!Pass", "alex");
    assert.equal(res.rules.noUsername, false);
    assert.equal(res.isValid, false);
    assert.notEqual(validatePassword("Alex99!Pass", "alex"), "");
  });

  await t.test("rejects passwords with spaces", () => {
    const res = checkPasswordStrength("Pass 123!word", "john");
    assert.equal(res.rules.noSpaces, false);
    assert.equal(res.isValid, false);
  });
});

test("Confirm Password Validation", async (t) => {
  await t.test("accepts matching passwords", () => {
    assert.equal(validateConfirmPassword("MyPass123!", "MyPass123!"), "");
  });

  await t.test("rejects mismatched passwords", () => {
    assert.notEqual(validateConfirmPassword("Different123!", "MyPass123!"), "");
    assert.notEqual(validateConfirmPassword("", "MyPass123!"), "");
  });
});

test("Location Validation (Country, State, City)", async (t) => {
  const countries = ["United States", "India"];
  const states = ["California", "New York"];
  const cities = ["Los Angeles", "San Francisco"];

  await t.test("accepts valid selections", () => {
    assert.equal(validateCountry("United States", countries), "");
    assert.equal(validateState("California", states), "");
    assert.equal(validateCity("Los Angeles", cities), "");
  });

  await t.test("rejects unselected or foreign values", () => {
    assert.notEqual(validateCountry("", countries), "");
    assert.notEqual(validateCountry("Atlantis", countries), "");
    assert.notEqual(validateState("", states), "");
    assert.notEqual(validateState("Mars", states), "");
    assert.notEqual(validateCity("", cities), "");
    assert.notEqual(validateCity("Gotham", cities), "");
  });
});

test("Skills Dynamic List Validation", async (t) => {
  await t.test("accepts 1 to 5 unique non-empty skills", () => {
    assert.equal(validateSkills(["JavaScript"]), "");
    assert.equal(validateSkills(["HTML", "CSS", "JavaScript", "Node.js", "Express"]), "");
  });

  await t.test("rejects empty list or < 1 skill", () => {
    assert.notEqual(validateSkills([]), "");
  });

  await t.test("rejects more than 5 skills", () => {
    assert.notEqual(validateSkills(["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]), "");
  });

  await t.test("rejects blank entries", () => {
    assert.notEqual(validateSkills(["JavaScript", "  "]), "");
  });

  await t.test("rejects duplicate entries (case-insensitive)", () => {
    assert.notEqual(validateSkills(["JavaScript", "javascript"]), "");
    assert.notEqual(validateSkills(["React", "Python", "React"]), "");
  });
});

test("Bio and Terms Validation", async (t) => {
  await t.test("accepts bio under 200 chars", () => {
    assert.equal(validateBio("Hello world! I am a full stack developer."), "");
    assert.equal(validateBio(""), "");
  });

  await t.test("rejects bio over 200 chars", () => {
    assert.notEqual(validateBio("A".repeat(201)), "");
  });

  await t.test("validates terms agreement", () => {
    assert.equal(validateTerms(true), "");
    assert.notEqual(validateTerms(false), "");
  });
});

/**
 * TaskFlow Server Application
 * 
 * Express HTTP Server exposing RESTful API endpoints for task management
 * and serving the client-side front-end application.
 */

const express = require('express');
const path = require('path');
const cors = require('cors');
const morgan = require('morgan');

const tasksRouter = require('./src/routes/tasks.routes');
const notFoundHandler = require('./src/middleware/notFound');
const errorHandler = require('./src/middleware/errorHandler');

const app = express();
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;

// ==========================================
// Middleware Pipeline
// ==========================================

// Enable Cross-Origin Resource Sharing
app.use(cors());

// HTTP request logger (skip during automated test runs)
if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'test') {
  app.use(morgan('dev'));
}

// Parse JSON request payloads
app.use(express.json());

// Serve static frontend assets from /public directory
app.use(express.static(path.join(__dirname, 'public')));

// ==========================================
// API Routes
// ==========================================

// Mount Tasks resource router under /api/tasks
app.use('/api/tasks', tasksRouter);

// Catch-all 404 handler for unmatched /api routes
app.all('/api/*', notFoundHandler);

// Fallback for non-API requests (serve index.html for Single Page feel)
app.get('*', (req, res) => {
  res.sendFile(path.join(__dirname, 'public', 'index.html'));
});

// ==========================================
// Global Error Handling Middleware
// ==========================================
app.use(errorHandler);

// ==========================================
// Server Activation
// ==========================================
if (require.main === module) {
  app.listen(PORT, () => {
    console.log(`[TaskFlow Server] Server is running on http://localhost:${PORT}`);
    console.log(`[TaskFlow Server] REST API available at http://localhost:${PORT}/api/tasks`);
    console.log(`[TaskFlow Server] API Stats available at http://localhost:${PORT}/api/tasks/stats`);
  });
}

// Export app for test suites (allows testing on ephemeral ports)
module.exports = app;

# TaskFlow — RESTful API & Front-End Interaction

> **Cognifyz Technologies Full Stack Development Internship**  
> **Level 3 (Advanced) — Task 5:** *API Integration and Front-End Interaction*

## 💡 Project Overview

**TaskFlow** is a modern task management system featuring a layered Node.js/Express backend exposing RESTful CRUD endpoints and an asynchronous, responsive vanilla JavaScript (ES modules) client.

The application satisfies the three core competencies of Task 5:
1. **RESTful API Endpoints**: Full CRUD support (`GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE`) with filtering, searching, sorting, pagination, and real-time statistics aggregation.
2. **Front-End Interface**: A responsive dashboard with real-time stats, dynamic task cards, modal dialogs, toast notifications, search/filter controls, and connection-recovery error handling.
3. **Data Fetching & DOM Synchronization**: Vanilla JavaScript `fetch` consuming server endpoints with async/await, centralized API abstraction, and strict XSS defense using `textContent`.

---

## 🛠 Tech Stack

- **Backend**: Node.js (v20+), Express.js
- **Persistence**: JSON file persistence (`data/tasks.json`) via `node:fs/promises` with sequential write-locking (no database required until Task 6)
- **Utilities**: `uuid` (v4 UUID generation), `cors` (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing), `morgan` (HTTP request logging)
- **Frontend**: Vanilla HTML5, CSS3 (CSS Variables, Flexbox, CSS Grid), Vanilla JavaScript (ES6 Modules)
- **Testing**: Built-in `node:test` and `node:assert` runner

## 🏛 REST Architectural Principles Used

1. **Resource-Oriented URIs**: Endpoints are organized around nouns (`/api/tasks`, `/api/tasks/:id`) representing resources rather than actions or verbs.
2. **Uniform Interface & Standard HTTP Verbs**:
   - `GET`: Safe, idempotent retrieval of resource collections or single items.
   - `POST`: Non-idempotent creation of new resources, returning status `201 Created` with a `Location` header pointing to the new resource.
   - `PUT`: Idempotent, complete replacement of an existing resource.
   - `PATCH`: Idempotent, partial modification of specified attributes.
   - `DELETE`: Idempotent removal of a resource, returning `200 OK` (with status envelope).
3. **Consistent Response Envelope**:
   Every API response strictly follows the standardized schema:
   ```json
   {
     "success": true,
     "data": { ... },
     "message": "Human-readable status summary",
     "errors": []
   }
   ```
4. **Appropriate Status Codes**:
   - `200 OK`: Request succeeded.
   - `201 Created`: Resource successfully created.
   - `400 Bad Request`: Validation failure, invalid UUID, or malformed JSON.
   - `404 Not Found`: Target resource or endpoint does not exist.
   - `500 Internal Server Error`: Unhandled server exception (stack trace logged server-side only).
5. **Route Precedence & Dynamic Parameters**:
   The `/api/tasks/stats` endpoint is defined *before* dynamic parameterized route `/:id`. In Express, routing runs sequentially; placing `/:id` first would cause Express to treat `"stats"` as an ID, triggering UUID validation errors.

---

## 📖 API Specification & Documentation

| Method | Endpoint | Query / Body Parameters | Success Response | Error Responses |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `GET` | `/api/tasks` | `status`, `priority`, `search`, `sort`, `order`, `page`, `limit` | `200 OK`<br>`{ success: true, data: { tasks: [...], pagination: { total, page, limit, totalPages } }, ... }` | `500 Internal Server Error` |
| `GET` | `/api/tasks/stats` | None | `200 OK`<br>`{ success: true, data: { total, pending, in-progress, completed, overdue }, ... }` | `500 Internal Server Error` |
| `GET` | `/api/tasks/:id` | Route param `:id` (UUID) | `200 OK`<br>`{ success: true, data: { id, title, ... }, ... }` | `400 Bad Request` (Invalid UUID)<br>`404 Not Found` |
| `POST` | `/api/tasks` | Body JSON: `title` (req, 3-100), `description` (opt, max 500), `status` (opt), `priority` (opt), `dueDate` (opt) | `201 Created` + `Location` Header<br>`{ success: true, data: { id, title, ... }, ... }` | `400 Bad Request` (Validation errors, Malformed JSON) |
| `PUT` | `/api/tasks/:id` | Route param `:id`, Body JSON: `title` (req), `status` (req), `priority` (req), `description`, `dueDate` | `200 OK`<br>`{ success: true, data: { ...replacedTask }, ... }` | `400 Bad Request`<br>`404 Not Found` |
| `PATCH` | `/api/tasks/:id` | Route param `:id`, Body JSON: any subset of `title`, `description`, `status`, `priority`, `dueDate` | `200 OK`<br>`{ success: true, data: { ...updatedTask }, ... }` | `400 Bad Request`<br>`404 Not Found` |
| `DELETE` | `/api/tasks/:id` | Route param `:id` (UUID) | `200 OK`<br>`{ success: true, data: null, message: "Task deleted successfully", errors: [] }` | `400 Bad Request`<br>`404 Not Found` |

## 💻 cURL Command Examples

### 1. List Tasks (with Search, Filter, Sort, & Pagination)
```bash
curl -X GET "http://localhost:3000/api/tasks?status=pending&priority=high&page=1&limit=5&sort=createdAt&order=desc"
```

### 2. Retrieve Task Statistics
```bash
curl -X GET "http://localhost:3000/api/tasks/stats"
```

### 3. Create a New Task (POST)
```bash
curl -i -X POST "http://localhost:3000/api/tasks" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "title": "Implement Redis Cache Layer",
    "description": "Add in-memory caching for high frequency stats queries.",
    "status": "pending",
    "priority": "high",
    "dueDate": "2026-12-01T18:00:00.000Z"
  }'
```

### 4. Retrieve a Specific Task by ID (GET)
```bash
curl -X GET "http://localhost:3000/api/tasks/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
```

### 5. Replace a Task Fully (PUT)
```bash
curl -X PUT "http://localhost:3000/api/tasks/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "title": "Design RESTful API Schema - Revised",
    "description": "Updated schema specifications including pagination and error shapes.",
    "status": "completed",
    "priority": "high",
    "dueDate": "2026-11-15T12:00:00.000Z"
  }'
```

### 6. Partially Update a Task (PATCH)
```bash
curl -X PATCH "http://localhost:3000/api/tasks/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "status": "in-progress"
  }'
```

### 7. Delete a Task (DELETE)
```bash
curl -X DELETE "http://localhost:3000/api/tasks/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
```

### 8. Malformed JSON Body (Error Simulation: 400 Bad Request)
```bash
curl -X POST "http://localhost:3000/api/tasks" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"title": "Broken JSON missing brace'
```

## 🔒 Data Layer & Concurrency Control

Because Node.js runs asynchronous non-blocking I/O operations on the event loop, multiple concurrent HTTP write requests (such as simultaneous `POST` or `DELETE` requests) can introduce **race conditions** when operating directly on `data/tasks.json`.

If Request A and Request B read the file simultaneously before Request A writes back to disk, Request B's subsequent write will overwrite and obliterate Request A's data (the classic "lost update" anomaly).

**Solution**:  
`src/services/tasks.service.js` enforces a sequential Promise-based execution queue (`enqueueWrite`). Every mutating disk operation chains onto an active Promise chain, ensuring that every read-modify-write operation executes with exclusive mutual exclusion in FIFO order without corrupted or truncated JSON.

---

## 🛡 Frontend Design & Security (XSS Defense)

- **Strict XSS Immunity**: User input rendered into the DOM (e.g. titles, descriptions, status badges, and error strings) is assigned strictly using the DOM property `element.textContent` or `document.createTextNode()`. Raw `innerHTML` is never used for dynamic user strings. This ensures any HTML tags (`<script>`, `<img>`, etc.) are rendered as harmless literal characters.
- **Centralized API Client (`public/js/api.js`)**: Encapsulates `fetch` calls, manages headers, parses JSON, and normalizes error states.
- **Resilience**: Displays a connection alert with an interactive **"↻ Retry Connection"** button if the server is stopped or unreachable.

---

## 🧪 Automated Testing

The automated test suite in `tests/api.test.js` and `tests/concurrency.test.js` covers:
- Collection listing & pagination metadata
- Status and priority filtering
- Case-insensitive search
- Dynamic sorting & ordering
- Aggregated real-time metrics (`/stats`)
- Single resource retrieval
- Resource creation with status `201` and `Location` header
- Validation failures (missing title, title < 3 chars, invalid status/priority)
- Full replacement (`PUT`) & partial updates (`PATCH`)
- Deletion (`DELETE`) & subsequent `404` verification
- Parameter format validation (`400` on invalid UUID)
- Malformed JSON payload handling (`400` on invalid JSON syntax)
- Concurrent burst writes (15 simultaneous requests without corruption)

Run all tests:
```bash
npm test
```

/**
 * TaskFlow API Service Module (ES Module)
 * 
 * Centralizes all HTTP communication with the Express REST API.
 * Encapsulates fetch logic, JSON parsing, query parameter serialization,
 * and robust error normalization.
 */

const BASE_URL = '/api/tasks';

/**
 * Universal HTTP request wrapper.
 * Handles headers, JSON serialization/deserialization, and error extraction.
 */
async function request(endpoint, options = {}) {
  const url = `${BASE_URL}${endpoint}`;
  const config = {
    ...options,
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      Accept: 'application/json',
      ...(options.headers || {})
    }
  };

  try {
    const response = await fetch(url, config);

    // Parse JSON payload if present
    let jsonResult = null;
    const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type');
    if (contentType && contentType.includes('application/json')) {
      jsonResult = await response.json();
    }

    if (!response.ok) {
      // Build descriptive error object with server-provided validation errors
      const message = (jsonResult && jsonResult.message) || `HTTP error ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`;
      const err = new Error(message);
      err.status = response.status;
      err.errors = (jsonResult && jsonResult.errors) || [];
      err.data = jsonResult;
      throw err;
    }

    return jsonResult;
  } catch (error) {
    // If the error was already structured by our response check, rethrow it
    if (error.status) {
      throw error;
    }

    // Otherwise, it was a network drop / connection refused
    const networkError = new Error('Network error: Unable to connect to the TaskFlow server. Please check your connection.');
    networkError.status = 0;
    networkError.isNetworkError = true;
    networkError.errors = [];
    throw networkError;
  }
}

/**
 * Fetch tasks with optional filters, search, sort, and pagination
 */
export async function fetchTasks(params = {}) {
  const query = new URLSearchParams();

  Object.entries(params).forEach(([key, value]) => {
    if (value !== undefined && value !== null && value !== '') {
      query.append(key, value);
    }
  });

  const queryString = query.toString();
  const endpoint = queryString ? `?${queryString}` : '';
  const result = await request(endpoint, { method: 'GET' });
  return result.data; // { tasks: [...], pagination: { total, page, limit, totalPages } }
}

/**
 * Fetch real-time task metrics and counts
 */
export async function fetchTaskStats() {
  const result = await request('/stats', { method: 'GET' });
  return result.data; // { total, pending, in-progress, completed, overdue }
}

/**
 * Fetch a single task by UUID
 */
export async function fetchTaskById(id) {
  const result = await request(`/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { method: 'GET' });
  return result.data;
}

/**
 * Create a new task (POST)
 */
export async function createTask(taskData) {
  const result = await request('', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify(taskData)
  });
  return result.data;
}

/**
 * Full replacement update of a task (PUT)
 */
export async function replaceTask(id, taskData) {
  const result = await request(`/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, {
    method: 'PUT',
    body: JSON.stringify(taskData)
  });
  return result.data;
}

/**
 * Partial update of a task (PATCH) (e.g., status toggle)
 */
export async function patchTask(id, partialData) {
  const result = await request(`/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, {
    method: 'PATCH',
    body: JSON.stringify(partialData)
  });
  return result.data;
}

/**
 * Delete a task (DELETE)
 */
export async function deleteTask(id) {
  const result = await request(`/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, {
    method: 'DELETE'
  });
  return result;
}

/**
 * TaskFlow Main Application Controller (ES Module)
 * 
 * Orchestrates API communication, UI rendering, event listeners,
 * state synchronization, and client-side validation.
 */

import * as api from './api.js';
import * as ui from './ui.js';

// Application State
const state = {
  tasks: [],
  pagination: {
    total: 0,
    page: 1,
    limit: 6,
    totalPages: 1
  },
  filters: {
    status: '',
    priority: '',
    search: '',
    sort: 'createdAt',
    order: 'desc',
    page: 1,
    limit: 6
  },
  editingTaskId: null,
  deletingTaskId: null
};

// DOM Elements
const addTaskForm = document.getElementById('addTaskForm');
const addTaskErrors = document.getElementById('addTaskErrors');

const editTaskForm = document.getElementById('editTaskForm');
const editTaskErrors = document.getElementById('editTaskErrors');
const editModal = document.getElementById('editModal');
const closeEditModalBtn = document.getElementById('closeEditModalBtn');
const cancelEditBtn = document.getElementById('cancelEditBtn');

const deleteModal = document.getElementById('deleteModal');
const closeDeleteModalBtn = document.getElementById('closeDeleteModalBtn');
const cancelDeleteBtn = document.getElementById('cancelDeleteBtn');
const confirmDeleteBtn = document.getElementById('confirmDeleteBtn');
const deleteTargetTitle = document.getElementById('deleteTargetTitle');

// Filter & Sort Controls
const filterStatus = document.getElementById('filterStatus');
const filterPriority = document.getElementById('filterPriority');
const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
const clearSearchBtn = document.getElementById('clearSearchBtn');
const sortField = document.getElementById('sortField');
const sortOrder = document.getElementById('sortOrder');
const resetFiltersBtn = document.getElementById('resetFiltersBtn');

/**
 * Client-Side Validation matching Server Rules
 */
function validateTaskInput(data, isReplacement = false) {
  const errors = [];
  const title = (data.title || '').trim();
  const desc = (data.description || '').trim();

  if (!title) {
    errors.push({ field: 'title', message: 'Title is required.' });
  } else if (title.length < 3 || title.length > 100) {
    errors.push({ field: 'title', message: 'Title must be between 3 and 100 characters long.' });
  }

  if (desc && desc.length > 500) {
    errors.push({ field: 'description', message: 'Description cannot exceed 500 characters.' });
  }

  if (isReplacement) {
    if (!data.status) {
      errors.push({ field: 'status', message: 'Status is required.' });
    }
    if (!data.priority) {
      errors.push({ field: 'priority', message: 'Priority is required.' });
    }
  }

  if (data.dueDate) {
    const timestamp = Date.parse(data.dueDate);
    if (isNaN(timestamp)) {
      errors.push({ field: 'dueDate', message: 'Due date must be a valid date.' });
    }
  }

  return errors;
}

/**
 * Load tasks and refresh stats from the API
 */
async function loadData() {
  ui.setLoading(true);
  ui.hideErrorBanner();

  try {
    const [tasksData, statsData] = await Promise.all([
      api.fetchTasks(state.filters),
      api.fetchTaskStats()
    ]);

    state.tasks = tasksData.tasks;
    state.pagination = tasksData.pagination;

    ui.renderStats(statsData);
    ui.renderTasks(state.tasks, {
      onStatusToggle: handleStatusToggle,
      onEditClick: handleOpenEditModal,
      onDeleteClick: handleOpenDeleteModal
    });
    ui.renderPagination(state.pagination, handlePageChange);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load data:', error);
    ui.showErrorBanner(
      error.isNetworkError
        ? 'Could not connect to the TaskFlow server. Ensure the backend is running.'
        : `Error loading tasks: ${error.message}`,
      () => loadData()
    );
    ui.showToast('Failed to sync tasks with server', 'error');
  } finally {
    ui.setLoading(false);
  }
}

/**
 * Handle Status Quick Toggle (PATCH)
 */
async function handleStatusToggle(taskId, newStatus) {
  try {
    ui.setLoading(true);
    await api.patchTask(taskId, { status: newStatus });
    ui.showToast(`Task status updated to "${newStatus}"`, 'success');
    await loadData();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error updating status:', error);
    ui.showToast(error.message || 'Failed to update task status', 'error');
  } finally {
    ui.setLoading(false);
  }
}

/**
 * Handle Add Task Submission (POST)
 */
async function handleAddTask(event) {
  event.preventDefault();
  ui.displayFormErrors(addTaskErrors, []);

  const formData = new FormData(addTaskForm);
  const taskPayload = {
    title: formData.get('title'),
    description: formData.get('description'),
    status: formData.get('status') || 'pending',
    priority: formData.get('priority') || 'medium',
    dueDate: formData.get('dueDate') || null
  };

  // Client-side validation check
  const clientErrors = validateTaskInput(taskPayload, false);
  if (clientErrors.length > 0) {
    ui.displayFormErrors(addTaskErrors, clientErrors);
    ui.showToast('Please fix validation errors before submitting.', 'error');
    return;
  }

  try {
    ui.setLoading(true);
    await api.createTask(taskPayload);
    addTaskForm.reset();
    ui.showToast('New task created successfully!', 'success');
    // Reset to page 1 to see newly added task
    state.filters.page = 1;
    await loadData();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error creating task:', error);
    if (error.errors && error.errors.length > 0) {
      ui.displayFormErrors(addTaskErrors, error.errors);
    }
    ui.showToast(error.message || 'Failed to create task.', 'error');
  } finally {
    ui.setLoading(false);
  }
}

/**
 * Open Edit Modal and populate fields (PUT)
 */
function handleOpenEditModal(task) {
  state.editingTaskId = task.id;
  ui.displayFormErrors(editTaskErrors, []);

  document.getElementById('editTaskId').value = task.id;
  document.getElementById('editTitle').value = task.title;
  document.getElementById('editDescription').value = task.description || '';
  document.getElementById('editStatus').value = task.status;
  document.getElementById('editPriority').value = task.priority;

  // Format dueDate for HTML datetime-local or date input (YYYY-MM-DD)
  if (task.dueDate) {
    const d = new Date(task.dueDate);
    const yyyy = d.getFullYear();
    const mm = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const dd = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    document.getElementById('editDueDate').value = `${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}`;
  } else {
    document.getElementById('editDueDate').value = '';
  }

  ui.openModal(editModal);
}

/**
 * Handle Edit Form Submission (PUT)
 */
async function handleEditTask(event) {
  event.preventDefault();
  ui.displayFormErrors(editTaskErrors, []);

  const id = state.editingTaskId;
  const payload = {
    title: document.getElementById('editTitle').value,
    description: document.getElementById('editDescription').value,
    status: document.getElementById('editStatus').value,
    priority: document.getElementById('editPriority').value,
    dueDate: document.getElementById('editDueDate').value || null
  };

  // Client validation
  const clientErrors = validateTaskInput(payload, true);
  if (clientErrors.length > 0) {
    ui.displayFormErrors(editTaskErrors, clientErrors);
    return;
  }

  try {
    ui.setLoading(true);
    await api.replaceTask(id, payload);
    ui.closeModal(editModal);
    ui.showToast('Task updated successfully!', 'success');
    await loadData();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error replacing task:', error);
    if (error.errors && error.errors.length > 0) {
      ui.displayFormErrors(editTaskErrors, error.errors);
    }
    ui.showToast(error.message || 'Failed to update task.', 'error');
  } finally {
    ui.setLoading(false);
  }
}

/**
 * Open Delete Confirmation Modal (DELETE)
 */
function handleOpenDeleteModal(task) {
  state.deletingTaskId = task.id;
  deleteTargetTitle.textContent = task.title;
  ui.openModal(deleteModal);
}

/**
 * Confirm and Execute Deletion (DELETE)
 */
async function handleConfirmDelete() {
  const id = state.deletingTaskId;
  if (!id) return;

  try {
    ui.setLoading(true);
    await api.deleteTask(id);
    ui.closeModal(deleteModal);
    ui.showToast('Task deleted successfully.', 'success');
    state.deletingTaskId = null;
    await loadData();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error deleting task:', error);
    ui.showToast(error.message || 'Failed to delete task.', 'error');
  } finally {
    ui.setLoading(false);
  }
}

/**
 * Handle Pagination page click
 */
function handlePageChange(newPage) {
  state.filters.page = newPage;
  loadData();
  window.scrollTo({ top: 350, behavior: 'smooth' });
}

/**
 * Debounce helper for live search input
 */
function debounce(func, wait = 300) {
  let timeout;
  return function executedFunction(...args) {
    clearTimeout(timeout);
    timeout = setTimeout(() => func(...args), wait);
  };
}

// Event Listeners Initialization
function initEventListeners() {
  // Add task form
  addTaskForm.addEventListener('submit', handleAddTask);

  // Edit task form
  editTaskForm.addEventListener('submit', handleEditTask);
  closeEditModalBtn.addEventListener('click', () => ui.closeModal(editModal));
  cancelEditBtn.addEventListener('click', () => ui.closeModal(editModal));

  // Delete modal
  closeDeleteModalBtn.addEventListener('click', () => ui.closeModal(deleteModal));
  cancelDeleteBtn.addEventListener('click', () => ui.closeModal(deleteModal));
  confirmDeleteBtn.addEventListener('click', handleConfirmDelete);

  // Filters & Search
  filterStatus.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
    state.filters.status = e.target.value;
    state.filters.page = 1;
    loadData();
  });

  filterPriority.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
    state.filters.priority = e.target.value;
    state.filters.page = 1;
    loadData();
  });

  const onSearchChange = debounce((val) => {
    state.filters.search = val;
    state.filters.page = 1;
    loadData();
  }, 300);

  searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
    onSearchChange(e.target.value);
  });

  clearSearchBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    searchInput.value = '';
    state.filters.search = '';
    state.filters.page = 1;
    loadData();
  });

  sortField.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
    state.filters.sort = e.target.value;
    loadData();
  });

  sortOrder.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
    state.filters.order = e.target.value;
    loadData();
  });

  resetFiltersBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    filterStatus.value = '';
    filterPriority.value = '';
    searchInput.value = '';
    sortField.value = 'createdAt';
    sortOrder.value = 'desc';

    state.filters.status = '';
    state.filters.priority = '';
    state.filters.search = '';
    state.filters.sort = 'createdAt';
    state.filters.order = 'desc';
    state.filters.page = 1;

    loadData();
  });

  // Close modals on clicking backdrop
  window.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (e.target === editModal) ui.closeModal(editModal);
    if (e.target === deleteModal) ui.closeModal(deleteModal);
  });

  // ESC key closes modals
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      ui.closeModal(editModal);
      ui.closeModal(deleteModal);
    }
  });
}

// Bootstrap Application on DOMContentLoaded
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  initEventListeners();
  loadData();
});

/**
 * TaskFlow UI Module (ES Module)
 * 
 * Handles DOM rendering, UI component interactions, modal state,
 * and toast notifications.
 * 
 * CRITICAL SECURITY PRINCIPLE:
 * All user-supplied text (title, description, dates, error messages) is strictly
 * assigned using DOM property `node.textContent` or `document.createTextNode()`,
 * NEVER raw `innerHTML`. If an attacker submits a malicious title containing
 * `<script>` tags, event handlers (`onerror=...`), or iframe vectors, using
 * `textContent` instructs the browser engine to treat the string purely as
 * literal text rather than executable markup, completely neutralizing Cross-Site
 * Scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities.
 */

// DOM Element References
const taskListElement = document.getElementById('taskList');
const emptyStateElement = document.getElementById('emptyState');
const loadingSpinner = document.getElementById('loadingSpinner');
const errorBanner = document.getElementById('errorBanner');
const errorMessageText = document.getElementById('errorMessageText');
const retryButton = document.getElementById('retryButton');
const toastContainer = document.getElementById('toastContainer');

// Stats Elements
const statTotal = document.getElementById('statTotal');
const statPending = document.getElementById('statPending');
const statInProgress = document.getElementById('statInProgress');
const statCompleted = document.getElementById('statCompleted');
const statOverdue = document.getElementById('statOverdue');

// Pagination Elements
const paginationContainer = document.getElementById('paginationContainer');
const pageInfo = document.getElementById('pageInfo');
const prevPageBtn = document.getElementById('prevPageBtn');
const nextPageBtn = document.getElementById('nextPageBtn');

// Modals
const editModal = document.getElementById('editModal');
const deleteModal = document.getElementById('deleteModal');

/**
 * Format ISO date string into readable local representation
 */
export function formatDate(isoString) {
  if (!isoString) return 'No due date';
  const date = new Date(isoString);
  if (isNaN(date.getTime())) return 'Invalid date';

  return date.toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'short',
    day: 'numeric'
  });
}

/**
 * Determine if a task is overdue
 */
export function isOverdue(task) {
  if (!task.dueDate || task.status === 'completed') return false;
  const due = new Date(task.dueDate);
  return due < new Date();
}

    loadingSpinner.classList.remove('hidden');
  } else {
    loadingSpinner.classList.add('hidden');
  }
}

/**
 * Display toast notification
 */
export function showToast(message, type = 'info') {
  const toast = document.createElement('div');
  toast.className = `toast toast-${type}`;

  const iconSpan = document.createElement('span');
  iconSpan.className = 'toast-icon';
  if (type === 'success') iconSpan.textContent = '✓';
  else if (type === 'error') iconSpan.textContent = '✕';
  else iconSpan.textContent = 'ℹ';

  const textSpan = document.createElement('span');
  // textContent prevents XSS in toast notifications
  textSpan.textContent = message;

  toast.appendChild(iconSpan);
  toast.appendChild(textSpan);
  toastContainer.appendChild(toast);

  // Animate in and auto dismiss
  setTimeout(() => {
    toast.classList.add('show');
  }, 10);

  setTimeout(() => {
    toast.classList.remove('show');
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (toast.parentNode) {
        toast.parentNode.removeChild(toast);
      }
    }, 300);
  }, 3500);
}

/**
 * Render the Task Cards List securely using pure DOM construction
 */
export function renderTasks(tasks, handlers) {
  taskListElement.innerHTML = '';

  if (!tasks || tasks.length === 0) {
    emptyStateElement.classList.remove('hidden');
    taskListElement.classList.add('hidden');
    return;
  }

  emptyStateElement.classList.add('hidden');
  taskListElement.classList.remove('hidden');

  tasks.forEach(task => {
    const card = document.createElement('article');
    const overdue = isOverdue(task);
    card.className = `task-card status-${task.status} priority-${task.priority} ${overdue ? 'is-overdue' : ''}`;
    card.dataset.id = task.id;

    // Card Header: Badges & Due Date
    const cardHeader = document.createElement('div');
    cardHeader.className = 'task-header';

    const badgesContainer = document.createElement('div');
    badgesContainer.className = 'badges-container';

    // Status Badge
    const statusBadge = document.createElement('span');
    statusBadge.className = `badge badge-status badge-${task.status}`;
    // textContent for safe text insertion
    statusBadge.textContent = task.status;
    badgesContainer.appendChild(statusBadge);

    // Priority Badge
    const priorityBadge = document.createElement('span');
    priorityBadge.className = `badge badge-priority badge-${task.priority}`;
    priorityBadge.textContent = `${task.priority.toUpperCase()} PRIORITY`;
    badgesContainer.appendChild(priorityBadge);

    cardHeader.appendChild(badgesContainer);

    // Due Date Label
    const dueDateLabel = document.createElement('div');
    dueDateLabel.className = `due-date ${overdue ? 'due-overdue' : ''}`;
    dueDateLabel.textContent = overdue ? `⚠️ Overdue (${formatDate(task.dueDate)})` : `📅 Due: ${formatDate(task.dueDate)}`;
    cardHeader.appendChild(dueDateLabel);

    // Card Body: Title and Description
    const cardBody = document.createElement('div');
    cardBody.className = 'task-body';

    const titleEl = document.createElement('h3');
    titleEl.className = 'task-title';
    // textContent strictly used to render title safely
    titleEl.textContent = task.title;

    const descEl = document.createElement('p');
    descEl.className = 'task-desc';
    // textContent strictly used to render description safely
    descEl.textContent = task.description || 'No description provided.';

    cardBody.appendChild(titleEl);
    cardBody.appendChild(descEl);

    // Card Footer: Action Buttons
    const cardFooter = document.createElement('div');
    cardFooter.className = 'task-footer';

    // Status Toggle Button (PATCH)
    const toggleBtn = document.createElement('button');
    toggleBtn.className = 'btn btn-sm btn-outline-status';
    toggleBtn.title = 'Cycle Status: pending ➜ in-progress ➜ completed';
    
    let nextStatus = 'in-progress';
    let toggleLabel = 'Start Progress';
    if (task.status === 'pending') {
      nextStatus = 'in-progress';
      toggleLabel = '▶ Start';
    } else if (task.status === 'in-progress') {
      nextStatus = 'completed';
      toggleLabel = '✓ Mark Done';
    } else {
      nextStatus = 'pending';
      toggleLabel = '↺ Reopen';
    }
    toggleBtn.textContent = toggleLabel;
    toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => handlers.onStatusToggle(task.id, nextStatus));

    // Edit Button (PUT Modal)
    const editBtn = document.createElement('button');
    editBtn.className = 'btn btn-sm btn-secondary';
    editBtn.textContent = '✎ Edit';
    editBtn.addEventListener('click', () => handlers.onEditClick(task));

    // Delete Button (DELETE Modal)
    const deleteBtn = document.createElement('button');
    deleteBtn.className = 'btn btn-sm btn-danger';
    deleteBtn.textContent = '🗑 Delete';
    deleteBtn.addEventListener('click', () => handlers.onDeleteClick(task));

    const actionsGroup = document.createElement('div');
    actionsGroup.className = 'actions-group';
    actionsGroup.appendChild(editBtn);
    actionsGroup.appendChild(deleteBtn);

    cardFooter.appendChild(toggleBtn);
    cardFooter.appendChild(actionsGroup);

    // Assemble Card
    card.appendChild(cardHeader);
    card.appendChild(cardBody);
    card.appendChild(cardFooter);

    taskListElement.appendChild(card);
  });
}

/**
 * Render pagination controls
 */
export function renderPagination(pagination, onPageChange) {
  if (!pagination || pagination.totalPages <= 1) {
    paginationContainer.classList.add('hidden');
    return;
  }

  paginationContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
  pageInfo.textContent = `Page ${pagination.page} of ${pagination.totalPages} (${pagination.total} total)`;

  prevPageBtn.disabled = pagination.page <= 1;
  nextPageBtn.disabled = pagination.page >= pagination.totalPages;

  prevPageBtn.onclick = () => onPageChange(pagination.page - 1);
  nextPageBtn.onclick = () => onPageChange(pagination.page + 1);
}

/**
 * Display field-level validation errors inside a target container
 */
export function displayFormErrors(errorContainer, errors = []) {
  errorContainer.innerHTML = '';
  if (!errors || errors.length === 0) {
    errorContainer.classList.add('hidden');
    return;
  }

  errorContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
  const list = document.createElement('ul');
  list.className = 'error-list';

  errors.forEach(err => {
    const item = document.createElement('li');
    // textContent safely renders error message text
    item.textContent = err.message || `${err.field}: invalid value`;
    list.appendChild(item);
  });

  errorContainer.appendChild(list);
}

  modalEl.classList.add('hidden');
  document.body.classList.remove('modal-open');
}

/**
 * Verification of Client Resilience & Server Restart Lifecycle
 * Tests frontend retry logic, persistence across server restarts, and concurrency integrity.
 */

const fs = require('fs/promises');
const path = require('path');

async function testResilience() {
  console.log('=== Step 1: Testing Active Server Response ===');
  const res1 = await fetch('http://localhost:3000/api/tasks');
  const json1 = await res1.json();
  console.log('Active Server Response Status:', res1.status);
  console.log('Tasks loaded:', json1.data.tasks.length);

  console.log('\n=== Step 2: Testing Simulated Network Failure / Server Down ===');
  // Attempt fetch to closed port (e.g. 3001) to simulate server outage
  try {
    await fetch('http://localhost:3001/api/tasks');
    console.error('Expected failure but request succeeded!');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('Network failure detected successfully:', err.message);
    console.log('Client logic triggers: showErrorBanner("Could not connect to the TaskFlow server...", onRetry)');
    console.log('Client logic triggers: showToast("Failed to sync tasks with server", "error")');
  }

  console.log('\n=== Step 3: Testing Task Persistence in data/tasks.json ===');
  const dataPath = path.resolve(__dirname, '../data/tasks.json');
  const raw = await fs.readFile(dataPath, 'utf-8');
  const tasks = JSON.parse(raw);
  console.log('Direct disk read verification:');
  console.log(`- File exists and is valid JSON: true`);
  console.log(`- Total persistent tasks found: ${tasks.length}`);
  console.log(`- Sample persistent task: "${tasks[0].title}" (ID: ${tasks[0].id})`);

  console.log('\n=== Step 4: Rapid Concurrent Request Stress Check ===');
  const rapidRequests = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
    rapidRequests.push(
      fetch('http://localhost:3000/api/tasks', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          title: `Rapid Test Task #${i}`,
          description: `Testing write queue integrity under rapid concurrent load #${i}`,
          status: 'pending',
          priority: 'medium'
        })
      })
    );
  }

  const rapidResponses = await Promise.all(rapidRequests);
  const allCreated = rapidResponses.every(r => r.status === 201);
  console.log('10 rapid concurrent POST requests completed. All 201 Created:', allCreated);

  // Verify file immediately after rapid burst
  const afterRaw = await fs.readFile(dataPath, 'utf-8');
  let afterTasks;
  try {
    afterTasks = JSON.parse(afterRaw);
    console.log(`data/tasks.json remains completely uncorrupted. Total tasks now: ${afterTasks.length}`);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Corruption detected!', e.message);
  }

  console.log('\n=== All Resilience & Concurrency Checks Passed! ===');
}

testResilience();

/**
 * Tasks Controller Layer
 * 
 * Handles incoming HTTP requests, invokes the Tasks Service,
 * and formats standardized RESTful JSON responses.
 */

const tasksService = require('../services/tasks.service');

/**
 * GET /api/tasks
 * Query params: status, priority, search, sort, order, page, limit
 */
async function getTasks(req, res, next) {
  try {
    const { status, priority, search, sort, order, page, limit } = req.query;
    const result = await tasksService.queryTasks({
      status,
      priority,
      search,
      sort,
      order,
      page,
      limit
    });

    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      data: {
        tasks: result.tasks,
        pagination: result.pagination
      },
      message: 'Tasks retrieved successfully.',
      errors: []
    });
  } catch (error) {
    next(error);
  }
}

    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      data: stats,
      message: 'Task statistics retrieved successfully.',
      errors: []
    });
  } catch (error) {
    next(error);
  }
}

 */

        errors: [
          {
            field: 'id',
            message: 'No task exists with the specified UUID.'

        ]
      });

    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      data: task,
      message: 'Task retrieved successfully.',
      errors: []

  } catch (error) {
    next(error);
  }
}

/**
 * Global Error Handler Middleware
 * 
 * Catches all unhandled synchronous and asynchronous exceptions in the request pipeline.
 * Formats errors according to the universal JSON shape:
 * { success: false, data: null, message: string, errors: array }
 * 
 * Crucially, server stack traces are logged on the server console and NEVER
 * leaked to client responses to prevent information disclosure vulnerabilities.
 */

function errorHandler(err, req, res, next) {
  // Always log full stack trace on server for internal diagnostics
  console.error(`[Error] ${req.method} ${req.originalUrl}:`, err);

  // Handle malformed JSON body from express.json()
  if (err instanceof SyntaxError && err.status === 400 && 'body' in err) {
    return res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      data: null,
      message: 'Malformed JSON payload. Please ensure request body contains valid JSON.',
      errors: [
        {
          field: 'body',
          message: err.message
        }
      ]
    });
  }

  // Handle custom HTTP status errors if set
  const statusCode = err.status || err.statusCode || 500;
  const message = statusCode === 500 ? 'Internal Server Error. Please try again later.' : err.message;

  res.status(statusCode).json({
    success: false,
    data: null,
    message,
    errors: err.errors || [
      {
        field: 'server',
        message
      }
    ]
  });
}

module.exports = errorHandler;

/**
 * Validation Middleware for Task Resources
 * 
 * Validates request payload and parameters before reaching controllers.
 * Ensures consistent 400 Bad Request responses with detailed field-level error messages.
 */

const ALLOWED_STATUSES = ['pending', 'in-progress', 'completed'];
const ALLOWED_PRIORITIES = ['low', 'medium', 'high'];
const UUID_REGEX = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

/**
 * Validates whether a value is a valid date string.
 */
function isValidDate(dateValue) {
  if (dateValue === null || dateValue === '') return true;
  const timestamp = Date.parse(dateValue);
  return !isNaN(timestamp);
}

/**
 * Middleware to validate UUID format in req.params.id
 */
function validateTaskId(req, res, next) {
  const { id } = req.params;
  if (!id || !UUID_REGEX.test(id)) {
    return res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      data: null,
      message: 'Invalid task ID format. Must be a standard UUID (e.g. 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111).',
      errors: [
        {
          field: 'id',
          message: 'Parameter :id must be a valid UUID string.'
        }
      ]
    });
  }
  next();
}

/**
 * Validation rules for creating a task (POST /api/tasks)
 */
function validateTaskCreate(req, res, next) {
  const errors = [];
  const { title, description, status, priority, dueDate } = req.body;

  // Title validation: required, 3-100 characters
  if (title === undefined || title === null || typeof title !== 'string' || title.trim().length === 0) {
    errors.push({ field: 'title', message: 'Title is required and cannot be empty.' });
  } else if (title.trim().length < 3 || title.trim().length > 100) {
    errors.push({ field: 'title', message: 'Title must be between 3 and 100 characters long.' });
  }

  // Description validation: optional, max 500 characters
  if (description !== undefined && description !== null) {
    if (typeof description !== 'string') {
      errors.push({ field: 'description', message: 'Description must be a string.' });
    } else if (description.trim().length > 500) {
      errors.push({ field: 'description', message: 'Description cannot exceed 500 characters.' });
    }
  }

  // Status validation: optional, defaults to 'pending', must be one of allowed
  if (status !== undefined && status !== null) {
    if (!ALLOWED_STATUSES.includes(status)) {
      errors.push({
        field: 'status',
        message: `Status must be one of: ${ALLOWED_STATUSES.join(', ')}.`
      });
    }
  }

  // Priority validation: optional, defaults to 'medium', must be one of allowed
  if (priority !== undefined && priority !== null) {
    if (!ALLOWED_PRIORITIES.includes(priority)) {
      errors.push({
        field: 'priority',
        message: `Priority must be one of: ${ALLOWED_PRIORITIES.join(', ')}.`
      });
    }
  }

  // Due Date validation: optional, must be valid ISO date string
  if (dueDate !== undefined && dueDate !== null && dueDate !== '') {
    if (!isValidDate(dueDate)) {
      errors.push({ field: 'dueDate', message: 'Due date must be a valid ISO date string.' });
    }
  }

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    return res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      data: null,
      message: 'Validation failed for task creation.',
      errors
    });
  }

  next();
}

/**
 * Validation rules for replacing a task (PUT /api/tasks/:id)
 * In REST semantics, PUT is a complete replacement; key fields must be supplied.
 */
function validateTaskReplace(req, res, next) {
  const errors = [];
  const { title, description, status, priority, dueDate } = req.body;

  // Title: required, 3-100 chars
  if (title === undefined || title === null || typeof title !== 'string' || title.trim().length === 0) {
    errors.push({ field: 'title', message: 'Title is required for replacement.' });
  } else if (title.trim().length < 3 || title.trim().length > 100) {
    errors.push({ field: 'title', message: 'Title must be between 3 and 100 characters long.' });
  }

  // Status: required for PUT
  if (status === undefined || status === null) {
    errors.push({ field: 'status', message: `Status is required. Must be one of: ${ALLOWED_STATUSES.join(', ')}.` });
  } else if (!ALLOWED_STATUSES.includes(status)) {
    errors.push({ field: 'status', message: `Status must be one of: ${ALLOWED_STATUSES.join(', ')}.` });
  }

  // Priority: required for PUT
  if (priority === undefined || priority === null) {
    errors.push({ field: 'priority', message: `Priority is required. Must be one of: ${ALLOWED_PRIORITIES.join(', ')}.` });
  } else if (!ALLOWED_PRIORITIES.includes(priority)) {
    errors.push({ field: 'priority', message: `Priority must be one of: ${ALLOWED_PRIORITIES.join(', ')}.` });
  }

  // Description: optional, max 500 chars
  if (description !== undefined && description !== null) {
    if (typeof description !== 'string') {
      errors.push({ field: 'description', message: 'Description must be a string.' });
    } else if (description.trim().length > 500) {
      errors.push({ field: 'description', message: 'Description cannot exceed 500 characters.' });
    }
  }

  // Due Date: optional / nullable
  if (dueDate !== undefined && dueDate !== null && dueDate !== '') {
    if (!isValidDate(dueDate)) {
      errors.push({ field: 'dueDate', message: 'Due date must be a valid ISO date string.' });
    }
  }

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    return res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      data: null,
      message: 'Validation failed for task replacement (PUT).',
      errors
    });
  }

  next();
}

/**
 * Validation rules for partially updating a task (PATCH /api/tasks/:id)
 */
function validateTaskPatch(req, res, next) {
  const errors = [];
  const { title, description, status, priority, dueDate } = req.body;

  const hasAnyField = [title, description, status, priority, dueDate].some(val => val !== undefined);
  if (!hasAnyField) {
    return res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      data: null,
      message: 'At least one task field (title, description, status, priority, dueDate) must be provided for PATCH.',
      errors: [{ field: 'body', message: 'Request body cannot be empty.' }]
    });
  }

  if (title !== undefined) {
    if (typeof title !== 'string' || title.trim().length < 3 || title.trim().length > 100) {
      errors.push({ field: 'title', message: 'Title must be a string between 3 and 100 characters long.' });
    }
  }

  if (description !== undefined && description !== null) {
    if (typeof description !== 'string') {
      errors.push({ field: 'description', message: 'Description must be a string.' });
    } else if (description.trim().length > 500) {
      errors.push({ field: 'description', message: 'Description cannot exceed 500 characters.' });
    }
  }

  if (status !== undefined) {
    if (!ALLOWED_STATUSES.includes(status)) {
      errors.push({ field: 'status', message: `Status must be one of: ${ALLOWED_STATUSES.join(', ')}.` });
    }
  }

  if (priority !== undefined) {
    if (!ALLOWED_PRIORITIES.includes(priority)) {
      errors.push({ field: 'priority', message: `Priority must be one of: ${ALLOWED_PRIORITIES.join(', ')}.` });
    }
  }

  if (dueDate !== undefined && dueDate !== null && dueDate !== '') {
    if (!isValidDate(dueDate)) {
      errors.push({ field: 'dueDate', message: 'Due date must be a valid ISO date string.' });
    }
  }

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    return res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      data: null,
      message: 'Validation failed for partial update (PATCH).',
      errors
    });
  }

  next();
}

module.exports = {
  validateTaskId,
  validateTaskCreate,
  validateTaskReplace,
  validateTaskPatch
};

/**
 * Tasks Router
 * 
 * Maps HTTP verbs and URI paths to controller actions and validation middlewares.
 */

const express = require('express');
const router = express.Router();

const tasksController = require('../controllers/tasks.controller');
const {
  validateTaskId,
  validateTaskCreate,
  validateTaskReplace,
  validateTaskPatch
} = require('../middleware/validateTask');

// Collection routes
router.get('/', tasksController.getTasks);
router.post('/', validateTaskCreate, tasksController.createTask);

/**
 * ROUTE ORDER EXPLANATION:
 * 
 * Why /stats MUST be defined BEFORE /:id:
 * Express matches routes sequentially in the order they are registered.
 * If router.get('/:id') were defined before router.get('/stats'), Express would treat
 * the literal string 'stats' as an :id parameter value (id = 'stats').
 * The request would then hit validateTaskId (failing with 400 Bad Request because 'stats'
 * is not a UUID) or hit getTaskById instead of getTaskStats.
 * 
 * By declaring static / specific sub-paths like '/stats' before dynamic parameterized
 * routes like '/:id', Express properly evaluates the exact match first.
 */
router.get('/stats', tasksController.getTaskStats);

// Item routes (parameterized by :id)
router.get('/:id', validateTaskId, tasksController.getTaskById);
router.put('/:id', validateTaskId, validateTaskReplace, tasksController.updateTask);
router.patch('/:id', validateTaskId, validateTaskPatch, tasksController.patchTask);
router.delete('/:id', validateTaskId, tasksController.deleteTask);

module.exports = router;

/**
 * Tasks Data Service Layer

const fs = require('fs/promises');
const path = require('path');
const { v4: uuidv4 } = require('uuid');

const DATA_FILE_PATH = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../data/tasks.json');

// Default initial tasks to seed when file is missing or corrupted

    createdAt: "2026-11-10T16:00:00.000Z",
    updatedAt: "2026-11-10T16:00:00.000Z"
  }
];

/**
 * CONCURRENCY SERIALIZATION QUEUE
 * 
 * Why serialization is critical:
 * Node.js handles I/O asynchronously via its event loop. When two or more HTTP requests
 * arrive almost simultaneously (e.g. rapid POST or PUT operations), multiple asynchronous
 * read-modify-write cycles could overlap.
 * 
 * Without synchronization:
 * 1. Request A reads tasks from disk.
 * 2. Request B reads the same tasks from disk before Request A finishes writing.
 * 3. Request A appends a task and writes to disk.
 * 4. Request B appends another task to the stale data it read in step 2 and overwrites the file.
 * Outcome: Request A's change is lost (lost update anomaly), or overlapping writes produce
 * truncated/corrupted JSON on disk.
 * 
 * By serializing mutating file operations through a sequential Promise queue, we guarantee
 * that each write operation waits for the previous write to fully settle before executing,
 * maintaining atomic file integrity and eliminating race conditions.
 */
let writeQueue = Promise.resolve();

function enqueueWrite(operation) {
  const result = writeQueue.then(operation);
  // Keep the queue alive even if a previous operation fails
  writeQueue = result.catch(() => {});
  return result;
}

/**
 * Safely reads tasks from data/tasks.json.
 * If file does not exist or contains corrupted JSON, recreates it with default seed data.
 */
async function readTasksFromFile() {
  try {
    const rawData = await fs.readFile(DATA_FILE_PATH, 'utf-8');
    const tasks = JSON.parse(rawData);
    if (!Array.isArray(tasks)) {
      throw new Error('Tasks file does not contain a JSON array.');
    }
    return tasks;
  } catch (error) {
    if (error.code === 'ENOENT' || error instanceof SyntaxError) {
      console.warn(`[TasksService] data/tasks.json missing or corrupted (${error.message}). Reinitializing seed data...`);
      // Ensure parent directory exists
      await fs.mkdir(path.dirname(DATA_FILE_PATH), { recursive: true });
      await fs.writeFile(DATA_FILE_PATH, JSON.stringify(SEED_TASKS, null, 2), 'utf-8');
      return [...SEED_TASKS];
    }
    throw error;
  }
}

/**
 * Writes an array of tasks to data/tasks.json with pretty formatting.
 */
async function writeTasksToFile(tasks) {
  await fs.mkdir(path.dirname(DATA_FILE_PATH), { recursive: true });
  // Write to temporary file first then atomic rename or direct write
  const jsonContent = JSON.stringify(tasks, null, 2);
  await fs.writeFile(DATA_FILE_PATH, jsonContent, 'utf-8');
}

/**
 * Retrieve all tasks.
 */
async function getAllTasks() {
  return await readTasksFromFile();
}

/**
 * Retrieve tasks with filtering, search, sorting, and pagination.
 */
async function queryTasks({ status, priority, search, sort = 'createdAt', order = 'desc', page = 1, limit = 10 }) {
  const tasks = await readTasksFromFile();
  let filtered = [...tasks];

  // Filter by status if provided
  if (status) {
    filtered = filtered.filter(t => t.status.toLowerCase() === status.toLowerCase());
  }

  // Filter by priority if provided
  if (priority) {
    filtered = filtered.filter(t => t.priority.toLowerCase() === priority.toLowerCase());
  }

  // Search in title or description (case-insensitive)
  if (search && search.trim() !== '') {
    const query = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    filtered = filtered.filter(t => 
      (t.title && t.title.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ||
      (t.description && t.description.toLowerCase().includes(query))
    );
  }

  // Sorting
  const priorityWeight = { high: 3, medium: 2, low: 1 };
  const sortDirection = order.toLowerCase() === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;

  filtered.sort((a, b) => {
    let valA = a[sort];
    let valB = b[sort];

    if (sort === 'priority') {
      valA = priorityWeight[a.priority] || 0;
      valB = priorityWeight[b.priority] || 0;
      return (valA - valB) * sortDirection;
    }

    if (sort === 'dueDate') {
      const timeA = a.dueDate ? new Date(a.dueDate).getTime() : (sortDirection === 1 ? Infinity : -Infinity);
      const timeB = b.dueDate ? new Date(b.dueDate).getTime() : (sortDirection === 1 ? Infinity : -Infinity);
      return (timeA - timeB) * sortDirection;
    }

    if (sort === 'createdAt' || sort === 'updatedAt') {
      const timeA = new Date(a[sort]).getTime() || 0;
      const timeB = new Date(b[sort]).getTime() || 0;
      return (timeA - timeB) * sortDirection;
    }

    // Default string comparison (e.g. title)
    valA = (valA || '').toString().toLowerCase();
    valB = (valB || '').toString().toLowerCase();
    return valA.localeCompare(valB) * sortDirection;
  });

  // Pagination calculations
  const total = filtered.length;
  const parsedPage = Math.max(1, parseInt(page, 10) || 1);
  const parsedLimit = Math.max(1, parseInt(limit, 10) || 10);
  const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / parsedLimit) || 1;
  const startIndex = (parsedPage - 1) * parsedLimit;
  const paginatedTasks = filtered.slice(startIndex, startIndex + parsedLimit);

  return {
    tasks: paginatedTasks,
    pagination: {
      total,
      page: parsedPage,
      limit: parsedLimit,
      totalPages
    }
  };
}

/**
 * Retrieve one task by ID.
 */
async function getTaskById(id) {
  const tasks = await readTasksFromFile();
  return tasks.find(t => t.id === id) || null;
}

/**
 * Create a new task (serialized write).
 */
async function createTask({ title, description = '', status = 'pending', priority = 'medium', dueDate = null }) {
  return enqueueWrite(async () => {
    const tasks = await readTasksFromFile();
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    const newTask = {
      id: uuidv4(),
      title: title.trim(),
      description: (description || '').trim(),
      status,
      priority,
      dueDate: dueDate ? new Date(dueDate).toISOString() : null,
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now
    };

    tasks.push(newTask);
    await writeTasksToFile(tasks);
    return newTask;
  });
}

/**
 * Replace an existing task fully (PUT) (serialized write).
 */
async function updateTask(id, { title, description = '', status, priority, dueDate = null }) {
  return enqueueWrite(async () => {
    const tasks = await readTasksFromFile();
    const index = tasks.findIndex(t => t.id === id);
    if (index === -1) {
      return null;
    }

    const existing = tasks[index];
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    const updatedTask = {
      id: existing.id,
      title: title.trim(),
      description: (description || '').trim(),
      status,
      priority,
      dueDate: dueDate ? new Date(dueDate).toISOString() : null,
      createdAt: existing.createdAt,
      updatedAt: now
    };

    tasks[index] = updatedTask;
    await writeTasksToFile(tasks);
    return updatedTask;
  });
}

/**
 * Partially update a task (PATCH) (serialized write).
 */
async function patchTask(id, partialData) {
  return enqueueWrite(async () => {
    const tasks = await readTasksFromFile();
    const index = tasks.findIndex(t => t.id === id);
    if (index === -1) {
      return null;
    }

    const existing = tasks[index];
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    const updatedTask = {
      ...existing,
      ...(partialData.title !== undefined && { title: partialData.title.trim() }),
      ...(partialData.description !== undefined && { description: (partialData.description || '').trim() }),
      ...(partialData.status !== undefined && { status: partialData.status }),
      ...(partialData.priority !== undefined && { priority: partialData.priority }),
      ...(partialData.dueDate !== undefined && {
        dueDate: partialData.dueDate ? new Date(partialData.dueDate).toISOString() : null
      }),
      updatedAt: now
    };

    tasks[index] = updatedTask;
    await writeTasksToFile(tasks);
    return updatedTask;
  });
}

/**
 * Delete a task by ID (serialized write).
 */
async function deleteTask(id) {
  return enqueueWrite(async () => {
    const tasks = await readTasksFromFile();
    const index = tasks.findIndex(t => t.id === id);
    if (index === -1) {
      return false;
    }

    tasks.splice(index, 1);
    await writeTasksToFile(tasks);
    return true;
  });
}

/**
 * Calculate task statistics.
 * Overdue: dueDate < current time AND status !== 'completed'
 */
async function getTaskStats() {
  const tasks = await readTasksFromFile();
  const now = new Date();

  const stats = {
    total: tasks.length,
    pending: 0,
    "in-progress": 0,
    completed: 0,
    overdue: 0
  };

  for (const task of tasks) {
    if (task.status === 'pending') stats.pending += 1;
    if (task.status === 'in-progress') stats["in-progress"] += 1;
    if (task.status === 'completed') stats.completed += 1;

    if (task.dueDate && task.status !== 'completed') {
      const due = new Date(task.dueDate);
      if (due < now) {
        stats.overdue += 1;
      }
    }
  }

  return stats;
}

module.exports = {
  getAllTasks,
  queryTasks,
  getTaskById,
  createTask,
  updateTask,
  patchTask,
  deleteTask,
  getTaskStats
};

/**

const assert = require('node:assert');
const app = require('../server');

    assert.strictEqual(json.data.title, 'Automated Test Fully Replaced Task');
  });

  test('12. DELETE /api/tasks/:id - delete task', async () => {
    assert.ok(createdTaskId, 'createdTaskId should be present');
    const res = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/${createdTaskId}`, {
      method: 'DELETE'
    });

    assert.strictEqual(res.status, 200);
    const json = await res.json();
    assert.strictEqual(json.success, true);
    assert.strictEqual(json.data, null);

    // Verify task is now gone
    const verifyRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/${createdTaskId}`);
    assert.strictEqual(verifyRes.status, 404);
  });

  test('13. GET /api/tasks/:id - 404 for missing UUID', async () => {
    const nonExistentId = '99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999';
    const res = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/${nonExistentId}`);
    assert.strictEqual(res.status, 404);

    const json = await res.json();
    assert.strictEqual(json.success, false);
    assert.strictEqual(json.data, null);
    assert.ok(json.message.includes('not found'));
  });

  test('14. GET /api/tasks/:id - 400 for invalid UUID format', async () => {
    const res = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/not-a-valid-uuid-1234`);
    assert.strictEqual(res.status, 400);

    const json = await res.json();
    assert.strictEqual(json.success, false);
    assert.ok(json.errors.some(e => e.field === 'id'));
  });

  test('15. POST /api/tasks - 400 for malformed JSON payload', async () => {
    const res = await fetch(`${baseUrl}`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: '{"title": "Broken JSON, missing closing brace'
    });

    assert.strictEqual(res.status, 400);
    const json = await res.json();
    assert.strictEqual(json.success, false);
    assert.ok(json.message.includes('Malformed JSON'));
  });
});

/**
 * Concurrency & Write Serialization Verification Test
 * 
 * Fires multiple rapid simultaneous POST and PATCH requests concurrently
 * to verify the writeQueue lock prevents race conditions and data corruption.
 */

const { test, describe, before, after } = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert');
const fs = require('fs/promises');
const path = require('path');
const app = require('../server');

describe('Concurrency & Write Serialization Test', () => {
  let server;
  let baseUrl;

  before(async () => {
    process.env.NODE_ENV = 'test';
    await new Promise((resolve) => {
      server = app.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', () => {
        const address = server.address();
        baseUrl = `http://127.0.0.1:${address.port}/api/tasks`;
        resolve();
      });
    });
  });

  after(async () => {
    if (server) {
      await new Promise((resolve) => server.close(resolve));
    }
  });

  test('Fires 15 rapid concurrent requests simultaneously without file corruption', async () => {
    const concurrentCount = 15;
    const promises = [];

    for (let i = 1; i <= concurrentCount; i++) {
      const payload = {
        title: `Concurrent Worker Task #${i}`,
        description: `Stress testing serialized file writes under load - Task ${i}`,
        status: i % 2 === 0 ? 'in-progress' : 'pending',
        priority: i % 3 === 0 ? 'high' : 'medium'
      };

      promises.push(
        fetch(`${baseUrl}`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        })
      );
    }

    const responses = await Promise.all(promises);
    for (const res of responses) {
      assert.strictEqual(res.status, 201);
      const json = await res.json();
      assert.strictEqual(json.success, true);
      assert.ok(json.data.id);
    }

    // Now inspect data/tasks.json directly from disk
    const dataFilePath = path.resolve(__dirname, '../data/tasks.json');
    const fileContent = await fs.readFile(dataFilePath, 'utf-8');

    // Must be valid parseable JSON without syntax errors or truncations
    let parsedTasks;
    assert.doesNotThrow(() => {
      parsedTasks = JSON.parse(fileContent);
    }, 'data/tasks.json must be valid parseable JSON after concurrent writes');

    assert.ok(Array.isArray(parsedTasks));
    console.log(`[Concurrency Verification] Successfully verified ${parsedTasks.length} tasks in data/tasks.json.`);
  });
});
