const path = require('path');
const { test, describe, before, after, beforeEach } = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const request = require('supertest');
const mongoose = require('mongoose');

// Configure MongoMemoryServer download directory inside workspace to avoid sandbox EPERM
process.env.MONGOMS_DOWNLOAD_DIR = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '.cache', 'mongodb-binaries');

const { MongoMemoryServer } = require('mongodb-memory-server');

// Set test environment variables before importing app
process.env.NODE_ENV = 'test';
process.env.JWT_SECRET = 'super_test_secret_key_minimum_32_characters_long_12345';
process.env.JWT_EXPIRES_IN = '1h';
process.env.COOKIE_SECURE = 'false';

const app = require('../app');
const User = require('../src/models/User');

let mongoServer;

describe('Authentication API Tests (/api/auth)', () => {
  before(async () => {
    // Start in-memory MongoDB instance
    mongoServer = await MongoMemoryServer.create();
    const uri = mongoServer.getUri();
    await mongoose.connect(uri);
  });

  after(async () => {
    await mongoose.disconnect();
    await mongoServer.stop();
  });

  beforeEach(async () => {
    // Clear users collection before each test
    await User.deleteMany({});
  });

  test('1. POST /register - Successfully registers user and hashes password', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .send({
        name: 'Alice Johnson',
        email: 'alice@example.com',
        password: 'Password123!',
      });

    assert.equal(res.status, 201);
    assert.equal(res.body.success, true);
    assert.equal(res.body.data.user.name, 'Alice Johnson');
    assert.equal(res.body.data.user.email, 'alice@example.com');
    assert.equal(res.body.data.user.role, 'user');
    assert.ok(res.body.data.token, 'JWT token should be returned');

    // Verify password hash is NEVER present in response
    assert.equal(res.body.data.user.password, undefined);
    assert.equal(JSON.stringify(res.body).includes('Password123!'), false);

    // Verify cookie was set
    const cookies = res.headers['set-cookie'];
    assert.ok(cookies, 'set-cookie header must be present');
    assert.ok(cookies.some((c) => c.includes('token=')), 'token cookie should be set');

    // Verify database record has hashed password (cost 12)
    const userInDb = await User.findOne({ email: 'alice@example.com' }).select('+password');
    assert.ok(userInDb, 'User must exist in DB');
    assert.notEqual(userInDb.password, 'Password123!');
    assert.ok(userInDb.password.startsWith('$2'), 'Password must be a bcrypt hash');
  });

  test('2. POST /register - Rejects duplicate email with 409 Conflict', async () => {
    await User.create({
      name: 'Alice Johnson',
      email: 'alice@example.com',
      password: 'Password123!',
      role: 'user',
    });

    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .send({
        name: 'Alice Duplicate',
        email: 'alice@example.com',
        password: 'AnotherPassword123!',
      });

    assert.equal(res.status, 409);
    assert.equal(res.body.success, false);
    assert.ok(res.body.message.includes('already exists'));
  });

  test('3. POST /register - Rejects weak password with 400 Bad Request', async () => {
    // Password with only numbers, under 8 chars
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .send({
        name: 'Weak User',
        email: 'weak@example.com',
        password: '12345',
      });

    assert.equal(res.status, 400);
    assert.equal(res.body.success, false);
    assert.ok(res.body.errors.length > 0);
  });

  test('4. POST /register - Ignores client-supplied role "admin" (Privilege Escalation Protection)', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .send({
        name: 'Malicious Attacker',
        email: 'attacker@example.com',
        password: 'Password123!',
        role: 'admin', // Attempted mass-assignment privilege escalation
      });

    assert.equal(res.status, 201);
    assert.equal(res.body.data.user.role, 'user', 'Role must default to user, ignoring client payload');

    const userInDb = await User.findOne({ email: 'attacker@example.com' });
    assert.equal(userInDb.role, 'user');
  });

  test('5. POST /login - Successfully logs in with correct credentials', async () => {
    await User.create({
      name: 'Bob Smith',
      email: 'bob@example.com',
      password: 'Password123!',
      role: 'user',
    });

    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .send({
        email: 'bob@example.com',
        password: 'Password123!',
      });

    assert.equal(res.status, 200);
    assert.equal(res.body.success, true);
    assert.ok(res.body.data.token);
    assert.equal(res.body.data.user.email, 'bob@example.com');
    assert.equal(res.body.data.user.password, undefined);

    const cookies = res.headers['set-cookie'];
    assert.ok(cookies.some((c) => c.includes('token=')));
  });

  test('6. POST /login - Fails with generic message for non-existent email', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .send({
        email: 'nonexistent@example.com',
        password: 'Password123!',
      });

    assert.equal(res.status, 401);
    assert.equal(res.body.message, 'Invalid email or password');
  });

  test('7. POST /login - Fails with identical generic message for wrong password', async () => {
    await User.create({
      name: 'Bob Smith',
      email: 'bob@example.com',
      password: 'Password123!',
      role: 'user',
    });

    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .send({
        email: 'bob@example.com',
        password: 'WrongPassword999!',
      });

    assert.equal(res.status, 401);
    // User enumeration protection: identical message to non-existent email
    assert.equal(res.body.message, 'Invalid email or password');
  });

  test('8. GET /api/auth/me - Succeeds with Authorization Bearer header', async () => {
    const user = await User.create({
      name: 'Charlie Brown',
      email: 'charlie@example.com',
      password: 'Password123!',
      role: 'user',
    });

    const loginRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .send({ email: 'charlie@example.com', password: 'Password123!' });

    const token = loginRes.body.data.token;

    const meRes = await request(app)
      .get('/api/auth/me')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${token}`);

    assert.equal(meRes.status, 200);
    assert.equal(meRes.body.data.user.email, 'charlie@example.com');
    assert.equal(meRes.body.data.user.password, undefined);
  });

  test('9. GET /api/auth/me - Succeeds with HTTP-only cookie', async () => {
    await User.create({
      name: 'Diana Prince',
      email: 'diana@example.com',
      password: 'Password123!',
      role: 'user',
    });

    const loginRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .send({ email: 'diana@example.com', password: 'Password123!' });

    const cookies = loginRes.headers['set-cookie'];

    const meRes = await request(app)
      .get('/api/auth/me')
      .set('Cookie', cookies);

    assert.equal(meRes.status, 200);
    assert.equal(meRes.body.data.user.email, 'diana@example.com');
  });

  test('10. GET /api/auth/me - Rejects with 401 when no token is provided', async () => {
    const res = await request(app).get('/api/auth/me');

    assert.equal(res.status, 401);
    assert.equal(res.body.success, false);
  });

  test('11. GET /api/auth/me - Rejects with 401 on malformed/invalid token', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .get('/api/auth/me')
      .set('Authorization', 'Bearer invalid.tampered.token');

    assert.equal(res.status, 401);
    assert.equal(res.body.success, false);
  });

  test('12. NoSQL Injection protection - Sanitizes query operators like {"$gt": ""}', async () => {
    await User.create({
      name: 'Safe User',
      email: 'safe@example.com',
      password: 'Password123!',
      role: 'user',
    });

    // Attempt NoSQL injection in login payload
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .send({
        email: { $gt: '' }, // Query operator injection attempt
        password: 'Password123!',
      });

    // Sanitizer removes $gt key, so email becomes empty/invalid and validator rejects with 400
    assert.equal(res.status, 400);
    assert.equal(res.body.success, false);
  });
});

const path = require('path');
const { test, describe, before, after, beforeEach } = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const request = require('supertest');
const mongoose = require('mongoose');
const jwt = require('jsonwebtoken');

// Configure MongoMemoryServer download directory inside workspace to avoid sandbox EPERM
process.env.MONGOMS_DOWNLOAD_DIR = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '.cache', 'mongodb-binaries');

const { MongoMemoryServer } = require('mongodb-memory-server');

process.env.NODE_ENV = 'test';
process.env.JWT_SECRET = 'super_test_secret_key_minimum_32_characters_long_12345';
process.env.JWT_EXPIRES_IN = '1h';
process.env.COOKIE_SECURE = 'false';

const app = require('../app');
const User = require('../src/models/User');
const Task = require('../src/models/Task');

let mongoServer;
let userAToken, userAId;
let userBToken, userBId;
let adminToken, adminId;

describe('Tasks & Authorization API Tests (/api/tasks & /api/admin)', () => {
  before(async () => {
    mongoServer = await MongoMemoryServer.create();
    const uri = mongoServer.getUri();
    await mongoose.connect(uri);
  });

  after(async () => {
    await mongoose.disconnect();
    await mongoServer.stop();
  });

  beforeEach(async () => {
    await User.deleteMany({});
    await Task.deleteMany({});

    // 1. Create User A
    const userA = await User.create({
      name: 'User Alpha',
      email: 'user.a@example.com',
      password: 'Password123!',
      role: 'user',
    });
    userAId = userA._id.toString();
    userAToken = jwt.sign({ id: userA._id, role: userA.role }, process.env.JWT_SECRET, { expiresIn: '1h' });

    // 2. Create User B
    const userB = await User.create({
      name: 'User Beta',
      email: 'user.b@example.com',
      password: 'Password123!',
      role: 'user',
    });
    userBId = userB._id.toString();
    userBToken = jwt.sign({ id: userB._id, role: userB.role }, process.env.JWT_SECRET, { expiresIn: '1h' });

    // 3. Create Admin
    const admin = await User.create({
      name: 'Admin Boss',
      email: 'admin.boss@example.com',
      password: 'Password123!',
      role: 'admin',
    });
    adminId = admin._id.toString();
    adminToken = jwt.sign({ id: admin._id, role: admin.role }, process.env.JWT_SECRET, { expiresIn: '1h' });
  });

  test('1. POST /api/tasks - Creates a task for User A; prevents owner mass-assignment', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/tasks')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${userAToken}`)
      .send({
        title: 'Alpha Task 1',
        description: 'First task for Alpha',
        priority: 'high',
        status: 'pending',
        owner: userBId, // Attempted mass assignment: should be ignored!
      });

    assert.equal(res.status, 201);
    assert.equal(res.body.success, true);
    assert.equal(res.body.data.task.title, 'Alpha Task 1');
    assert.equal(res.body.data.task.owner._id, userAId, 'Task owner must remain User A');

    const taskInDb = await Task.findById(res.body.data.task._id);
    assert.equal(taskInDb.owner.toString(), userAId);
  });

  test('2. GET /api/tasks - Retrieves only the authenticated user tasks with pagination', async () => {
    // Create 2 tasks for User A, 1 task for User B
    await Task.create([
      { title: 'Alpha Task 1', owner: userAId },
      { title: 'Alpha Task 2', owner: userAId },
      { title: 'Beta Task 1', owner: userBId },
    ]);

    const res = await request(app)
      .get('/api/tasks')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${userAToken}`);

    assert.equal(res.status, 200);
    assert.equal(res.body.data.tasks.length, 2);
    assert.equal(res.body.data.pagination.total, 2);
    assert.ok(res.body.data.tasks.every((t) => t.owner._id === userAId));
  });

  test('3. GET /api/tasks/stats - Aggregates task counts by status and priority', async () => {
    await Task.create([
      { title: 'Task Alpha 1', status: 'pending', priority: 'low', owner: userAId },
      { title: 'Task Alpha 2', status: 'in-progress', priority: 'medium', owner: userAId },
      { title: 'Task Alpha 3', status: 'completed', priority: 'high', owner: userAId },
      { title: 'Task Beta 1', status: 'completed', priority: 'high', owner: userBId },
    ]);

    const res = await request(app)
      .get('/api/tasks/stats')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${userAToken}`);

    assert.equal(res.status, 200);
    const { stats } = res.body.data;
    assert.equal(stats.total, 3);
    assert.equal(stats.byStatus.pending, 1);
    assert.equal(stats.byStatus['in-progress'], 1);
    assert.equal(stats.byStatus.completed, 1);
    assert.equal(stats.byPriority.low, 1);
    assert.equal(stats.byPriority.medium, 1);
    assert.equal(stats.byPriority.high, 1);
  });

  test('4. GET /api/tasks/:id - User A can read their own task; User B receives 404 (Information Disclosure Protection)', async () => {
    const taskA = await Task.create({
      title: 'Alpha Private Task',
      owner: userAId,
    });

    // User A accesses their own task -> 200
    const resA = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/tasks/${taskA._id}`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${userAToken}`);

    assert.equal(resA.status, 200);
    assert.equal(resA.body.data.task.title, 'Alpha Private Task');

    // User B attempts to access User A's task -> MUST return 404, not 403
    const resB = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/tasks/${taskA._id}`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${userBToken}`);

    assert.equal(resB.status, 404);
    assert.equal(resB.body.message, 'Task not found');
  });

  test('5. PUT & PATCH /api/tasks/:id - User A can update; User B updating User A task receives 404', async () => {
    const taskA = await Task.create({
      title: 'Original Title',
      status: 'pending',
      owner: userAId,
    });

    // User B tries to update User A's task -> 404
    const resB = await request(app)
      .put(`/api/tasks/${taskA._id}`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${userBToken}`)
      .send({ title: 'Hacked Title' });

    assert.equal(resB.status, 404);

    // User A updates their own task -> 200
    const resA = await request(app)
      .put(`/api/tasks/${taskA._id}`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${userAToken}`)
      .send({ title: 'Updated Title', status: 'completed' });

    assert.equal(resA.status, 200);
    assert.equal(resA.body.data.task.title, 'Updated Title');
    assert.equal(resA.body.data.task.status, 'completed');
  });

  test('6. DELETE /api/tasks/:id - User A can delete; User B deleting User A task receives 404', async () => {
    const taskA = await Task.create({
      title: 'To Be Deleted',
      owner: userAId,
    });

    // User B tries to delete User A's task -> 404
    const resB = await request(app)
      .delete(`/api/tasks/${taskA._id}`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${userBToken}`);

    assert.equal(resB.status, 404);

    // Verify task is still in DB
    const stillExists = await Task.findById(taskA._id);
    assert.ok(stillExists);

    // User A deletes their own task -> 200
    const resA = await request(app)
      .delete(`/api/tasks/${taskA._id}`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${userAToken}`);

    assert.equal(resA.status, 200);

    // Verify task is deleted
    const deleted = await Task.findById(taskA._id);
    assert.equal(deleted, null);
  });

  test('7. Malformed ObjectId handling - Returns 400 Bad Request instead of 500 CastError', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .get('/api/tasks/not-a-valid-object-id')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${userAToken}`);

    assert.equal(res.status, 400);
    assert.equal(res.body.success, false);
    assert.ok(res.body.message.includes('Invalid id format'));
  });

  test('8. Authorization / RBAC - Normal user calling admin routes receives 403 Forbidden', async () => {
    const resUsers = await request(app)
      .get('/api/admin/users')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${userAToken}`);

    assert.equal(resUsers.status, 403);
    assert.equal(resUsers.body.success, false);
    assert.ok(resUsers.body.message.includes('Access denied'));

    const resTasks = await request(app)
      .get('/api/admin/tasks')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${userAToken}`);

    assert.equal(resTasks.status, 403);
  });

  test('9. Admin access - Admin calling admin routes receives 200 OK', async () => {
    await Task.create([
      { title: 'Alpha Task', owner: userAId },
      { title: 'Beta Task', owner: userBId },
    ]);

    const resUsers = await request(app)
      .get('/api/admin/users')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${adminToken}`);

    assert.equal(resUsers.status, 200);
    assert.equal(resUsers.body.data.users.length, 3); // User A, User B, Admin

    // Verify each user has taskCount
    const userAEntry = resUsers.body.data.users.find((u) => u._id.toString() === userAId);
    assert.equal(userAEntry.taskCount, 1);

    const resTasks = await request(app)
      .get('/api/admin/tasks')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${adminToken}`);

    assert.equal(resTasks.status, 200);
    assert.equal(resTasks.body.data.tasks.length, 2);
  });

  test('10. Admin delete user - Cascades to delete all user tasks; prevents self-deletion', async () => {
    // Create 2 tasks for User B
    await Task.create([
      { title: 'Beta Task 1', owner: userBId },
      { title: 'Beta Task 2', owner: userBId },
    ]);

    // Admin attempts to delete themselves -> 400
    const selfDeleteRes = await request(app)
      .delete(`/api/admin/users/${adminId}`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${adminToken}`);

    assert.equal(selfDeleteRes.status, 400);
    assert.ok(selfDeleteRes.body.message.includes('cannot delete your own account'));

    // Admin deletes User B -> 200
    const deleteRes = await request(app)
      .delete(`/api/admin/users/${userBId}`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${adminToken}`);

    assert.equal(deleteRes.status, 200);
    assert.equal(deleteRes.body.data.deletedTasksCount, 2);

    // Verify User B is deleted
    const userBInDb = await User.findById(userBId);
    assert.equal(userBInDb, null);

    // Verify User B's tasks are cascaded and deleted
    const tasksRemaining = await Task.find({ owner: userBId });
    assert.equal(tasksRemaining.length, 0);
  });
});

/**
 * Express Application Configuration and Factory.
 * Builds and exports the app for both server startup and automated testing.
 */

const path = require('path');
const express = require('express');
const session = require('express-session');
const helmet = require('helmet');
const cors = require('cors');
const morgan = require('morgan');

const { SESSION_SECRET, NODE_ENV, CLIENT_ORIGIN } = require('./src/config/env');
const passport = require('./src/config/passport');
const { generalLimiter } = require('./src/middleware/rateLimiters');
const { requestLog } = require('./src/utils/requestLog');
const authRoutes = require('./src/routes/auth.routes');
const apiRoutes = require('./src/routes/api.routes');
const notFound = require('./src/middleware/notFound');
const errorHandler = require('./src/middleware/errorHandler');

const app = express();

// Trust reverse proxy headers (e.g. Nginx, Heroku, Cloudflare) for accurate rate limiting and secure cookies
app.set('trust proxy', 1);

// Security Headers with Helmet
app.use(
  helmet({
    contentSecurityPolicy: {
      directives: {
        defaultSrc: ["'self'"],
        scriptSrc: ["'self'"],
        styleSrc: ["'self'", "'unsafe-inline'", 'https://fonts.googleapis.com'],
        fontSrc: ["'self'", 'https://fonts.gstatic.com'],
        imgSrc: [
          "'self'",
          'data:',
          'https://avatars.githubusercontent.com',
          'https://*.githubusercontent.com',
          'https://flagcdn.com',
          'https://upload.wikimedia.org'
        ],
        connectSrc: ["'self'"]
      }
    },
    crossOriginEmbedderPolicy: false
  })
);

// Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) with RateLimit and Cache headers exposed
app.use(
  cors({
    origin: CLIENT_ORIGIN,
    credentials: true,
    methods: ['GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'DELETE', 'OPTIONS'],
    exposedHeaders: [
      'RateLimit-Limit',
      'RateLimit-Remaining',
      'RateLimit-Reset',
      'RateLimit-Policy',
      'Retry-After',
      'X-Cache'
    ]
  })
);

// HTTP Request Logger
if (NODE_ENV !== 'test') {
  app.use(morgan(NODE_ENV === 'production' ? 'combined' : 'dev'));
}

// Body parsers
app.use(express.json());
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true }));

// Session Management with express-session
app.use(
  session({
    name: 'citypulse.sid',
    secret: SESSION_SECRET,
    resave: false,
    saveUninitialized: false,
    cookie: {
      httpOnly: true, // Prevents client-side scripts from reading the cookie (anti-XSS)
      sameSite: 'lax', // CSRF defense while permitting OAuth redirect flow
      secure: NODE_ENV === 'production', // Requires HTTPS in production
      maxAge: 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000 // 24 hours
    }
  })
);

// Passport Authentication Middleware
app.use(passport.initialize());
app.use(passport.session());

// Ring-buffer request logger for authenticated /api requests
app.use('/api', (req, res, next) => {
  const start = Date.now();
  res.on('finish', () => {
    if (req.user?.id) {
      const sanitizedPath = (req.originalUrl || req.url || '').split('?')[0];

      // Avoid recording the request log polling endpoint itself
      if (sanitizedPath === '/api/request-log') return;

      const durationMs = Date.now() - start;
      requestLog.addEntry(req.user.id, {
        method: req.method,
        path: sanitizedPath,
        statusCode: res.statusCode,
        durationMs,
        cache: res.get('X-Cache') || 'none'
      });
    }
  });
  next();
});

// Static Files (Frontend UI)
app.use(express.static(path.join(__dirname, 'public')));

// General API Rate Limiting applied to /api/*
app.use('/api', generalLimiter);

// Route Mounting
app.use('/auth', authRoutes);
app.use('/api', apiRoutes);

// Catch-All 404 for undefined endpoints
app.use(notFound);

// Centralized Error Handler
app.use(errorHandler);

module.exports = app;

/**
 * Server Entrypoint.
 * Boots the Express server on configured PORT.
 */

const app = require('./app');
const { PORT, NODE_ENV } = require('./src/config/env');

const server = app.listen(PORT, () => {
  console.log('======================================================================');
  console.log(`🚀 CityPulse Dashboard running in [${NODE_ENV}] mode`);
  console.log(`🌐 Server URL: http://localhost:${PORT}`);
  console.log(`📋 Health check: http://localhost:${PORT}/api/health`);
  console.log('======================================================================');
});

// Graceful shutdown handling
function gracefulShutdown(signal) {
  console.log(`\n[${signal}] Received shutdown signal. Closing HTTP server gracefully...`);
  server.close(() => {
    console.log('HTTP server closed. Exiting process.');
    process.exit(0);
  });

  // Force exit after 5 seconds if connections fail to close
  setTimeout(() => {
    console.error('Forcefully terminating process after 5s timeout.');
    process.exit(1);
  }, 5000);
}

process.on('SIGTERM', () => gracefulShutdown('SIGTERM'));
process.on('SIGINT', () => gracefulShutdown('SIGINT'));

# 🌐 CityPulse Dashboard — Full-Stack API Showcase & OAuth 2.0 Integration

[![Node.js Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-v20%2B-green.svg)](https://nodejs.org/)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-ISC-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Task Level](https://img.shields.io/badge/Cognifyz-Level%204%20(Expert)-orange.svg)](https://cognifyz.com/)
[![Tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tests-29%20Passing-brightgreen.svg)]()

**CityPulse Dashboard** is an enterprise-grade full-stack project built for **Task 7 (Level 4: Expert)** of the Cognifyz Technologies Full Stack Development internship: *"Advanced API Usage and External API Integration."*

This upgraded **API Showcase** turns the dashboard into a visual, interactive demonstration where an examiner or reviewer can visibly witness all three required internship steps working in real time:
- **Step 1**: Investigate concepts like OAuth for secure API authentication (GitHub OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Grant, CSRF `state` protection, server-side token usage for GitHub User & Repo APIs).
- **Step 2**: Integrate external APIs (Open-Meteo Geocoding & 5-Day Forecast, REST Countries Geopolitical Metadata, and GitHub REST API).
- **Step 3**: Implement advanced API features (dual-tier rate limiting with 25-request burst testing, in-memory LRU TTL caching with sub-millisecond `X-Cache: HIT` telemetry, on-demand controlled error simulations, and an authenticated 25-request ring buffer log).

| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **OAuth 2.0 Usage** | Used only for initial login | Stored server-side in session to actively query **GitHub Profile API** and **GitHub Repositories API** |
| **Token Security** | Minimal session serialization | Hardened invariant: Access token **NEVER** reaches browser, devtools, or logs |
| **Rate Limiting** | Passive background middleware | Live quota progress meters + **25-Request Concurrent Burst Test Button** saturating limits to trigger HTTP 429 with `Retry-After` countdown |
| **Error Handling** | Only triggered on broken inputs | **Interactive 5-Error Simulation Console** (`400 Bad Input`, `404 Not Found`, `504 Timeout`, `502 Upstream Crash`, `503 Rate Limit`) |
| **Request Observability** | Console logs only | Authenticated **In-Memory Ring Buffer (last 25 calls)** table showing timestamp, path, status badge, latency (ms), and cache state |
| **UI Experience** | Simple weather cards | Responsive **5-Panel Sticky Showcase** with visual OAuth flow diagram, responsive meters, and cache badges |

---

## 🔒 Why Server-Side OAuth Tokens are Essential

A common security vulnerability in novice OAuth implementations is passing the OAuth access token to the browser (e.g. storing it in `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, or frontend state).

### The Risks of Client-Side Tokens:
1. **Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability**: Any compromised third-party npm package, CDN script, or injection bug can read `localStorage` or `document.cookie` and exfiltrate the user's GitHub token to an attacker's command-and-control server.
2. **Permanent Scope Hijacking**: Once an attacker steals a client token, they can impersonate the user against the GitHub API directly from any machine until the token is revoked.

### The CityPulse Server-Side Defense:
- **Delegated Confidential Client Flow**: The OAuth Authorization Code is exchanged for the access token solely over a secure back-channel connection (`POST https://github.com/login/oauth/access_token`) between CityPulse's Express server and GitHub.
- **Session-Only Confinement**: The token is stored exclusively inside the server's encrypted session memory (`express-session`). The client browser receives only a cryptographically signed, random session identifier (`citypulse.sid`) marked:
  - `httpOnly: true`: Unreadable by client JavaScript (`document.cookie` returns nothing).
  - `sameSite: 'lax'`: Defends against Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF).
  - `secure: true`: Enforced automatically over HTTPS in production.
- **Zero Token Leakage Guarantee**: The access token is completely absent from all API endpoints (`/api/me`, `/api/github/profile`, `/api/github/repos`, error handlers, and request logs).

## 📊 Complete API Documentation Table

All endpoints return a uniform JSON shape:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {},
  "message": "Optional human description",
  "errors": null
}
```

| Method | Endpoint | Auth | Purpose | Success (200) | Handled Errors |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `GET` | `/api/health` | ❌ Public | Uptime & cache statistics | `{ uptime, cache: { hits, misses, hitRate, size } }` | `500` |
| `GET` | `/api/config` | ❌ Public | Client UI feature flags | `{ demoMode: boolean, isOAuthConfigured: boolean }` | `500` |
| `GET` | `/auth/github` | ❌ Public | Initiates GitHub OAuth code flow | Redirects 302 to GitHub consent screen | `503` (if unconfigured) |
| `GET` | `/auth/github/callback` | ❌ Public | Code exchange & session setup | Redirects 302 to `/dashboard.html` | `401 / 503` |
| `POST` | `/auth/demo-login` | ❌ Public | Testing session (disabled in prod) | `{ id, username, displayName }` | `403` (in production) |
| `POST` | `/auth/logout` | ✅ Yes | Terminates session & clears cookie | `{ success: true, message: "Logged out" }` | `500` |
| `GET` | `/api/me` | ✅ Yes | Current authenticated user | `{ id, username, displayName, avatarUrl }` | `401` |
| `GET` | `/api/github/profile` | ✅ Yes | User profile via OAuth token | `{ login, name, bio, publicRepos, followers, scopes }` | `401, 503` |
| `GET` | `/api/github/repos` | ✅ Yes | 6 public repos via OAuth token | `[ { name, description, language, stars, url } ]` | `401, 503` |
| `GET` | `/api/limits` | ✅ Yes | Active quota state | `{ general: { limit, remaining }, strict: { limit, remaining } }` | `401` |
| `GET` | `/api/demo/error` | ✅ Yes | Controlled error simulation | Triggers specific production error | `400, 404, 502, 503, 504` |
| `GET` | `/api/request-log` | ✅ Yes | Ring buffer of last 25 calls | `[ { method, path, statusCode, durationMs, cache } ]` | `401` |
| `GET` | `/api/search-history` | ✅ Yes | Last 10 session searches | `[ { city, country, searchedAt } ]` | `401` |
| `GET` | `/api/weather` | ✅ Yes | Geocoding, weather & country | `{ city, coordinates, current, forecast, country }` | `400, 401, 404, 429, 502, 504` |
| `GET` | `/api/country/:code` | ✅ Yes | Standalone country metadata | `{ name, capital, population, currencies, flag }` | `400, 401, 404, 429` |

## 🔑 How to Register a GitHub OAuth App

1. Visit [GitHub Developer Settings > OAuth Apps](https://github.com/settings/developers).
2. Click **New OAuth App**:
   - **Application name**: `CityPulse Dashboard`
   - **Homepage URL**: `http://localhost:3000`
   - **Authorization callback URL**: `http://localhost:3000/auth/github/callback`
3. Click **Register application**.
4. Copy your **Client ID** and click **Generate a new client secret** to copy your **Client Secret**.
5. Paste them into `task-7-oauth-external-api/.env`:
   ```env
   GITHUB_CLIENT_ID=your_github_client_id_here
   GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET=your_github_client_secret_here
   ```
6. Restart the server (`npm start`).

- **Advanced Telemetry (Tests 11, 14, 16, 19, 21)**: Rate limit saturation (429), `/api/limits`, `/api/health`, sanitized request log ring buffer.

DEMO_MODE=true

  <script type="module">
    import { fetchConfig, fetchCurrentUser } from '/js/api.js';

    // Check if user is already logged in; if so, redirect immediately to dashboard
    (async () => {
      try {
        const userRes = await fetchCurrentUser();
        if (userRes.success && userRes.data) {
          window.location.href = '/dashboard.html';
          return;
        }
      } catch (_) {
        // Not authenticated, stay on landing page
      }

      // Check config to conditionally reveal demo login
      try {
        const configRes = await fetchConfig();
        if (configRes.success && configRes.data?.demoMode) {
          const demoSection = document.getElementById('demo-section');
          if (demoSection) {
            demoSection.classList.remove('hidden');
          }
        }
      } catch (_) {}

      // Check URL search params for errors (e.g. ?error=auth_failed)
      const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const error = urlParams.get('error');
      if (error) {
        const alertBanner = document.getElementById('alert-banner');
        alertBanner.textContent = 'Authentication was canceled or encountered an error. Please try again.';
        alertBanner.classList.remove('hidden');
      }
    })();
  </script>

/**
 * Frontend API Service (ES Module).
 * Encapsulates all AJAX communications with the backend Express server using native fetch.
 *
 * Security:
 * The frontend NEVER handles, stores, or receives the GitHub OAuth access token.
 * All third-party API interactions are proxied and secured by the server.
 */

/**
 * Handle JSON API response parsing, header telemetry, and uniform error structures.
 */
async function parseResponse(response, startTime = 0) {
  const durationMs = startTime > 0 ? Math.max(1, Math.round(performance.now() - startTime)) : 0;
  const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type') || '';
  const isJson = contentType.includes('application/json');

  let data = null;
  if (isJson) {
    try {
      data = await response.json();
    } catch (_) {
      data = null;
    }
  }

  const xCache = response.headers.get('x-cache') || response.headers.get('X-Cache') || 'MISS';
  const retryAfterHeader = response.headers.get('retry-after');

  // Parse RateLimit-* headers if available
  const rateLimitLimit = response.headers.get('ratelimit-limit');
  const rateLimitRemaining = response.headers.get('ratelimit-remaining');
  const rateLimitReset = response.headers.get('ratelimit-reset');

  const rateLimitInfo = {
    limit: rateLimitLimit ? parseInt(rateLimitLimit, 10) : null,
    remaining: rateLimitRemaining ? parseInt(rateLimitRemaining, 10) : null,
    reset: rateLimitReset ? parseInt(rateLimitReset, 10) : null
  };

  if (!response.ok) {
    const errorObj = new Error(data?.message || `Request failed with HTTP status ${response.status}`);
    errorObj.status = response.status;
    errorObj.errors = data?.errors || [];
    errorObj.rawJson = data;
    errorObj.retryAfter = data?.retryAfter || (retryAfterHeader ? parseInt(retryAfterHeader, 10) : null);
    errorObj.xCache = xCache;
    errorObj.durationMs = durationMs;
    errorObj.rateLimit = rateLimitInfo;
    throw errorObj;
  }

  return {
    ...data,
    xCache,
    durationMs,
    rateLimit: rateLimitInfo
  };
}

/**
 * Retrieve public app configuration (demo mode status, OAuth status).
 */
export async function fetchConfig() {
  const t0 = performance.now();
  const response = await fetch('/api/config', {
    headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' }
  });
  return parseResponse(response, t0);
}

/**
 * Fetch weather forecast and country data for a city.
 * @param {string} city - Target city name
 * @param {string} [units='metric'] - 'metric' or 'imperial'
 */
export async function fetchWeather(city, units = 'metric') {
  const t0 = performance.now();
  const query = new URLSearchParams({ city, units });
  const response = await fetch(`/api/weather?${query.toString()}`, {
    headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' }
  });
  return parseResponse(response, t0);
}

/**
 * Dashboard Controller (ES Module).
 * Coordinates Step 1 (OAuth & GitHub), Step 2 (External APIs), and Step 3 (Limits, Errors, Cache, Logs).
 */

import {
  fetchCurrentUser,
  fetchConfig,
  fetchGitHubProfile,
  fetchGitHubRepos,
  fetchWeather,
  fetchSearchHistory,
  fetchLimits,
  fetchHealth,
  fetchRequestLog,
  triggerDemoError,
  logout
} from './api.js';

import {
  renderUserProfile,
  renderGitHubProfile,
  renderGitHubRepos,
  renderWeatherAndCountry,
  renderSearchHistory,
  renderRateLimits,
  renderBurstTestResults,
  renderErrorInspector,
  renderCacheMetrics,
  renderRequestLogTable,
  showAlert,
  clearAlerts
} from './ui.js';

let currentSearchedCity = 'London';
let isExecutingBurst = false;

/**
 * Execute weather search for a city and selected units.
 */
async function performSearch(city, explicitUnits = null) {
  const cleanCity = (city || '').trim();
  if (!cleanCity) {
    showAlert('Please enter a valid city name.', 'error');
    return;
  }

  const units =
    explicitUnits ||
    document.querySelector('input[name="units"]:checked')?.value ||
    'metric';

  const btn = document.getElementById('search-btn');
  const btnText = document.getElementById('btn-text');
  const btnSpinner = document.getElementById('btn-spinner');

  if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
  if (btnText) btnText.textContent = 'Fetching...';
  if (btnSpinner) btnSpinner.classList.remove('hidden');

  try {
    const response = await fetchWeather(cleanCity, units);
    currentSearchedCity = cleanCity;
    renderWeatherAndCountry(response.data, response.xCache, response.durationMs);

    // Refresh telemetry and logs
    refreshAuxiliaryData();
  } catch (error) {
    handleSearchError(error);
  } finally {
    if (btn) btn.disabled = false;
    if (btnText) btnText.textContent = 'Explore City';
    if (btnSpinner) btnSpinner.classList.add('hidden');
  }
}

/**
 * Maps search errors to user-friendly notifications.
 */
function handleSearchError(error) {
  const status = error.status;

  if (status === 401) {
    window.location.href = '/index.html?error=session_expired';
    return;
  }

  if (status === 400) {
    const errorDetails =
      Array.isArray(error.errors) && error.errors.length > 0
        ? error.errors.join(' ')
        : error.message;
    showAlert(`Input validation error: ${errorDetails}`, 'error');
    return;
  }

  if (status === 404) {
    showAlert(`City not found: ${error.message || 'Please check spelling and try again.'}`, 'error');
    return;
  }

  if (status === 429) {
    const retrySec = error.retryAfter || 60;
    showAlert(
      `Rate limit exceeded: ${error.message || 'Maximum 20 weather queries per minute.'}`,
      'rate-limit',
      retrySec
    );
    return;
  }

  if (status === 504) {
    showAlert('Upstream Open-Meteo API timed out after 5000ms (504 Gateway Timeout).', 'error');
    return;
  }

  if (status === 502) {
    showAlert('Upstream Open-Meteo service returned an invalid response (502 Bad Gateway).', 'error');
    return;
  }

  if (status === 503) {
    const retrySec = error.retryAfter || 30;
    showAlert(
      `Upstream service rate limit reached (503 Service Unavailable).`,
      'rate-limit',
      retrySec
    );
    return;
  }

  showAlert(error.message || 'An error occurred contacting the server.', 'error');
}

/**
 * Load Step 1 GitHub profile and public repositories using stored OAuth token.
 */
async function loadGitHubData() {
  try {
    const profileRes = await fetchGitHubProfile();
    if (profileRes.success && profileRes.data) {
      renderGitHubProfile(profileRes.data, profileRes.xCache);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    const loading = document.getElementById('github-profile-loading');
    if (loading) {
      loading.textContent = `Failed to load GitHub profile: ${err.message}`;
    }
  }

  try {
    const reposRes = await fetchGitHubRepos();
    if (reposRes.success && reposRes.data) {
      renderGitHubRepos(reposRes.data, reposRes.xCache);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    const loading = document.getElementById('github-repos-loading');
    if (loading) {
      loading.textContent = `Failed to load GitHub repositories: ${err.message}`;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Refresh auxiliary data (rate limits, cache health, request log, search history).
 */
async function refreshAuxiliaryData() {
  // 1. Rate limits
  try {
    const limitsRes = await fetchLimits();
    if (limitsRes.success) {
      renderRateLimits(limitsRes.data);
    }
  } catch (_) {}

  // 2. Cache health
  try {
    const healthRes = await fetchHealth();
    if (healthRes.success) {
      renderCacheMetrics(healthRes.data);
    }
  } catch (_) {}

  // 3. Request log
  try {
    const logRes = await fetchRequestLog();
    if (logRes.success) {
      renderRequestLogTable(logRes.data);
    }
  } catch (_) {}

  // 4. Search history
  try {
    const histRes = await fetchSearchHistory();
    if (histRes.success && histRes.data) {
      renderSearchHistory(histRes.data, (selectedCity) => {
        const input = document.getElementById('city-input');
        if (input) input.value = selectedCity;
        performSearch(selectedCity);
      });
    }
  } catch (_) {}
}

/**
 * Execute 25-request burst test on strict rate limiter.
 */
async function executeBurstTest() {
  if (isExecutingBurst) return;
  isExecutingBurst = true;

  const btn = document.getElementById('run-burst-btn');
  const btnText = document.getElementById('burst-btn-text');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('burst-spinner');

  if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
  if (btnText) btnText.textContent = 'Firing 25 Parallel Requests...';
  if (spinner) spinner.classList.remove('hidden');

  let okCount = 0;
  let rateLimitedCount = 0;
  let cacheHitCount = 0;

  // Dispatch 25 parallel requests to strict rate limiter (/api/weather)
  const burstPromises = Array.from({ length: 25 }, async () => {
    try {
      const res = await fetchWeather('London', 'metric');
      okCount += 1;
      if (String(res.xCache).toUpperCase() === 'HIT') {
        cacheHitCount += 1;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      if (err.status === 429) {
        rateLimitedCount += 1;
      }
    }
  });

  await Promise.all(burstPromises);

  renderBurstTestResults({
    total: 25,
    okCount,
    rateLimitedCount,
    cacheHitCount
  });

  if (btn) btn.disabled = false;
  if (btnText) btnText.textContent = '🚀 Fire 25 Concurrent Requests Again';
  if (spinner) spinner.classList.add('hidden');
  isExecutingBurst = false;

  // Refresh rate limits and log table
  refreshAuxiliaryData();
}

/**
 * Execute controlled error simulation button click.
 */
async function executeErrorSimulation(type) {
  clearAlerts();

  try {
    const res = await triggerDemoError(type);
    // Unexpected 200 on an error trigger
    renderErrorInspector(200, 'Request unexpectedly succeeded.', res);
  } catch (err) {
    renderErrorInspector(err.status, err.message, err.rawJson || {
      success: false,
      message: err.message,
      errors: err.errors || [err.message]
    });
  }

  // Refresh logs and limits to show the recorded error status code
  refreshAuxiliaryData();
}

/**
 * Initialize Showcase Dashboard.
 */
async function init() {
  // 1. Authenticate user
  let currentUser = null;
  try {
    const userRes = await fetchCurrentUser();
    if (!userRes.success || !userRes.data) {
      window.location.href = '/index.html?error=unauthorized';
      return;
    }
    currentUser = userRes.data;
  } catch (_) {
    window.location.href = '/index.html?error=unauthorized';
    return;
  }

  // 2. Check config for DEMO_MODE badge
  let isDemoMode = false;
  try {
    const configRes = await fetchConfig();
    isDemoMode = Boolean(configRes.data?.demoMode);
  } catch (_) {}

  renderUserProfile(currentUser, isDemoMode);

  // 3. Load Step 1 GitHub Data
  loadGitHubData();

  // 4. Initial search (Step 2)
  const cityInput = document.getElementById('city-input');
  if (cityInput) {
    cityInput.value = 'London';
    performSearch('London');
  }

  // 5. Initial auxiliary telemetry (Step 3)
  refreshAuxiliaryData();

  // 6. Bind search form
  const form = document.getElementById('search-form');
  if (form) {
    form.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      performSearch(cityInput.value);
    });
  }

  // 7. Bind units toggle
  const unitRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="units"]');
  unitRadios.forEach((radio) => {
    radio.addEventListener('change', () => {
      if (currentSearchedCity) {
        performSearch(currentSearchedCity, radio.value);
      }
    });
  });

  // 8. Bind quick chips
  const quickChips = document.querySelectorAll('.chip-btn[data-city]');
  quickChips.forEach((chip) => {
    chip.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const city = chip.getAttribute('data-city');
      if (city) {
        if (cityInput) cityInput.value = city;
        performSearch(city);
      }
    });
  });

  // 9. Bind burst test button
  const burstBtn = document.getElementById('run-burst-btn');
  if (burstBtn) {
    burstBtn.addEventListener('click', executeBurstTest);
  }

  // 10. Bind error simulation buttons
  const errorBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.btn-error-sim[data-error]');
  errorBtns.forEach((btn) => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const type = btn.getAttribute('data-error');
      if (type) executeErrorSimulation(type);
    });
  });

  // 11. Bind real 404 test button
  const real404Btn = document.getElementById('test-real-404-btn');
  if (real404Btn) {
    real404Btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      try {
        await fetchWeather('NonExistentCityXYZ', 'metric');
      } catch (err) {
        renderErrorInspector(err.status, err.message, err.rawJson || {
          success: false,
          message: err.message,
          errors: err.errors || [err.message]
        });
      }
      refreshAuxiliaryData();
    });
  }

  // 12. Bind manual refresh buttons
  document.getElementById('refresh-limits-btn')?.addEventListener('click', refreshAuxiliaryData);
  document.getElementById('refresh-cache-btn')?.addEventListener('click', refreshAuxiliaryData);
  document.getElementById('refresh-log-btn')?.addEventListener('click', refreshAuxiliaryData);

  // 13. Bind logout
  document.getElementById('logout-btn')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    try {
      await logout();
    } catch (_) {}
    window.location.href = '/index.html';
  });
}

// Start application when DOM is ready
if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
} else {
  init();
}

/**
 * UI Renderer and DOM Manipulation Module (ES Module).
 *
 * Security Invariant:
 * All dynamic data received from external APIs (GitHub, Open-Meteo, REST Countries) and user
 * inputs are strictly populated into the DOM via `element.textContent` or explicit DOM node
 * construction (`document.createElement`).
 * We NEVER use `innerHTML` for dynamic external content to prevent Cross-Site Scripting (DOM XSS).
 * Even if an attacker places a malicious payload in a GitHub username or city name, `textContent`
 * ensures the browser treats it exclusively as literal text.
 */

let activeRateLimitTimer = null;

/**
 * Update top navbar user profile and demo badge.
 */
export function renderUserProfile(user, isDemoMode = false) {
  const avatarEl = document.getElementById('user-avatar');
  const nameEl = document.getElementById('user-display-name');
  const handleEl = document.getElementById('user-username');
  const demoBadge = document.getElementById('demo-mode-badge');

  if (avatarEl && user.avatarUrl) {
    avatarEl.src = user.avatarUrl;
  }
  if (nameEl) {
    nameEl.textContent = user.displayName || user.username || 'Explorer';
  }
  if (handleEl) {
    handleEl.textContent = `@${user.username || 'user'}`;
  }
  if (demoBadge) {
    if (isDemoMode) {
      demoBadge.classList.remove('hidden');
    } else {
      demoBadge.classList.add('hidden');
    }
  }
}

/**
 * PANEL 1: Render GitHub User Profile (via OAuth Access Token).
 */
export function renderGitHubProfile(profile, xCache = 'MISS') {
  const loading = document.getElementById('github-profile-loading');
  const content = document.getElementById('github-profile-content');
  const cacheBadge = document.getElementById('github-profile-cache');

  if (loading) loading.classList.add('hidden');
  if (content) content.classList.remove('hidden');

  if (cacheBadge) {
    const isHit = String(xCache).toUpperCase() === 'HIT';
    cacheBadge.textContent = isHit ? '⚡ CACHE HIT' : '🌐 MISS';
    cacheBadge.className = `badge-cache ${isHit ? 'hit' : 'miss'}`;
  }

  const avatar = document.getElementById('gh-avatar');
  if (avatar && profile.avatarUrl) avatar.src = profile.avatarUrl;

  document.getElementById('gh-name').textContent = profile.name || profile.login;

  const loginLink = document.getElementById('gh-login');
  loginLink.textContent = `@${profile.login}`;
  loginLink.href = profile.profileUrl || '#';

  document.getElementById('gh-bio').textContent = profile.bio || 'No bio provided.';
  document.getElementById('gh-repos-count').textContent = profile.publicRepos ?? 0;
  document.getElementById('gh-followers').textContent = profile.followers ?? 0;
  document.getElementById('gh-following').textContent = profile.following ?? 0;

  // Render granted OAuth scopes
  const scopesContainer = document.getElementById('gh-scopes-badges');
  if (scopesContainer) {
    scopesContainer.innerHTML = '';
    const scopes = Array.isArray(profile.scopes) ? profile.scopes : ['read:user'];
    scopes.forEach((scope) => {
      const pill = document.createElement('span');
      pill.className = 'scope-pill';
      pill.textContent = scope;
      scopesContainer.appendChild(pill);
    });
  }
}

/**
 * PANEL 2: Render Weather & Country Enriched Data.
 */
export function renderWeatherAndCountry(data, xCache = 'MISS', durationMs = 0) {
  // Update telemetry bar
  const heading = document.getElementById('result-city-heading');
  const cacheBadge = document.getElementById('weather-cache-badge');
  const latencyPill = document.getElementById('weather-response-time');

  if (heading) {
    heading.textContent = `${data.city}, ${data.country?.name?.common || data.countryCode}`;
  }

  if (cacheBadge) {
    const isHit = String(xCache).toUpperCase() === 'HIT';
    cacheBadge.textContent = isHit ? '⚡ CACHE HIT' : '🌐 CACHE MISS';
    cacheBadge.className = `badge-cache ${isHit ? 'hit' : 'miss'}`;
  }

  if (latencyPill) {
    latencyPill.textContent = `Response Time: ${durationMs} ms`;
  }

  // Current weather
  const current = data.current || {};
  const units = data.units || { temperature: '°C', windSpeed: 'km/h' };

  document.getElementById('weather-emoji').textContent = current.emoji || '☀️';
  document.getElementById('current-temp').textContent =
    current.temperature !== null ? Math.round(current.temperature) : '--';
  document.getElementById('current-temp-unit').textContent = units.temperature || '°C';
  document.getElementById('weather-desc').textContent = current.description || 'Clear';
  document.getElementById('current-feels-like').textContent =
    current.feelsLike !== null ? Math.round(current.feelsLike) : '--';
  document.getElementById('feels-unit').textContent = units.temperature || '°C';

  document.getElementById('current-humidity').textContent =
    current.humidity !== null ? `${current.humidity}%` : '--%';
  document.getElementById('current-wind').textContent =
    current.windSpeed !== null ? `${current.windSpeed} ${units.windSpeed}` : '--';

  const coords = data.coordinates || {};
  document.getElementById('geo-lat').textContent =
    coords.latitude !== undefined ? Number(coords.latitude).toFixed(4) : '--';
  document.getElementById('geo-lon').textContent =
    coords.longitude !== undefined ? Number(coords.longitude).toFixed(4) : '--';

  // Country metadata (handles graceful degradation if null)
  const countryContent = document.getElementById('country-content');
  const countryUnavailable = document.getElementById('country-unavailable');
  const country = data.country;

  if (country) {
    countryContent.classList.remove('hidden');
    countryUnavailable.classList.add('hidden');

    document.getElementById('country-flag-emoji').textContent = country.flagEmoji || '🏳️';
    const flagImg = document.getElementById('country-flag-img');
    if (country.flagUrl) {
      flagImg.src = country.flagUrl;
      flagImg.alt = country.flagAlt || `Flag of ${country.name?.common || 'country'}`;
      flagImg.classList.remove('hidden');
    } else {
      flagImg.classList.add('hidden');
    }

    document.getElementById('country-common-name').textContent = country.name?.common || data.countryCode;
    document.getElementById('country-official-name').textContent = country.name?.official || '';
    document.getElementById('country-capital').textContent = country.capital || 'N/A';
    document.getElementById('country-region').textContent = country.subregion
      ? `${country.region} (${country.subregion})`
      : country.region || 'N/A';
    document.getElementById('country-population').textContent =
      typeof country.population === 'number' ? country.population.toLocaleString() : 'N/A';

    const currenciesStr = Array.isArray(country.currencies) && country.currencies.length > 0
      ? country.currencies.map((c) => `${c.name} (${c.symbol || c.code})`).join(', ')
      : 'N/A';
    document.getElementById('country-currencies').textContent = currenciesStr;

    const languagesStr = Array.isArray(country.languages) && country.languages.length > 0
      ? country.languages.join(', ')
      : 'N/A';
    document.getElementById('country-languages').textContent = languagesStr;
  } else {
    // Degraded state: country metadata failed upstream
    countryContent.classList.add('hidden');
    countryUnavailable.classList.remove('hidden');
  }

  // 5-Day forecast cards
  const forecastContainer = document.getElementById('forecast-cards-container');
  if (forecastContainer) {
    forecastContainer.innerHTML = '';
    const forecastList = Array.isArray(data.forecast) ? data.forecast : [];

    forecastList.forEach((day) => {
      const card = document.createElement('div');
      card.className = 'forecast-card';

      let formattedDate = day.date;
      try {
        const d = new Date(day.date + 'T00:00:00');
        formattedDate = d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { weekday: 'short', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
      } catch (_) {}

      const dateEl = document.createElement('span');
      dateEl.className = 'forecast-date';
      dateEl.textContent = formattedDate;

      const emojiEl = document.createElement('span');
      emojiEl.className = 'forecast-emoji';
      emojiEl.textContent = day.emoji || '☀️';

      const descEl = document.createElement('span');
      descEl.className = 'forecast-desc';
      descEl.textContent = day.description || 'Clear';

      const tempsEl = document.createElement('div');
      tempsEl.className = 'forecast-temps';

      const maxSpan = document.createElement('span');
      maxSpan.className = 'forecast-max';
      maxSpan.textContent = day.tempMax !== null ? `↑ ${Math.round(day.tempMax)}${units.temperature}` : '--';

      const minSpan = document.createElement('span');
      minSpan.className = 'forecast-min';
      minSpan.textContent = day.tempMin !== null ? `↓ ${Math.round(day.tempMin)}${units.temperature}` : '--';

      tempsEl.appendChild(maxSpan);
      tempsEl.appendChild(minSpan);

      card.appendChild(dateEl);
      card.appendChild(emojiEl);
      card.appendChild(descEl);
      card.appendChild(tempsEl);

      forecastContainer.appendChild(card);
    });
  }
}

/**
 * PANEL 3: Render Live Rate Limit Gauges.
 */
export function renderRateLimits(limits) {
  if (!limits) return;

  // 1. Strict Limiter (Max 20/min)
  const strict = limits.strict || { limit: 20, remaining: 20, resetSeconds: 60 };
  const strictPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (strict.remaining / strict.limit) * 100));

  const strictBar = document.getElementById('strict-progress-bar');
  const strictText = document.getElementById('strict-quota-text');
  const strictReset = document.getElementById('strict-reset-text');

  if (strictBar) {
    strictBar.style.width = `${strictPct}%`;
    strictBar.className = `progress-bar-fill ${strictPct > 40 ? 'fill-green' : strictPct > 15 ? 'fill-amber' : 'fill-red'}`;
  }
  if (strictText) {
    strictText.textContent = `${strict.remaining} / ${strict.limit} remaining`;
  }
  if (strictReset) {
    strictReset.textContent = `Reset in: ${strict.resetSeconds}s`;
  }

  // 2. General Limiter (Max 100/15min)
  const general = limits.general || { limit: 100, remaining: 100, resetSeconds: 900 };
  const generalPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (general.remaining / general.limit) * 100));

  const generalBar = document.getElementById('general-progress-bar');
  const generalText = document.getElementById('general-quota-text');
  const generalReset = document.getElementById('general-reset-text');

  if (generalBar) {
    generalBar.style.width = `${generalPct}%`;
    generalBar.className = `progress-bar-fill ${generalPct > 40 ? 'fill-blue' : generalPct > 15 ? 'fill-amber' : 'fill-red'}`;
  }
  if (generalText) {
    generalText.textContent = `${general.remaining} / ${general.limit} remaining`;
  }
  if (generalReset) {
    generalReset.textContent = `Reset in: ${general.resetSeconds}s`;
  }
}

/**
 * PANEL 5: Render Live Request Ring Buffer Table.
 */
export function renderRequestLogTable(logs) {
  const tbody = document.getElementById('log-table-body');
  if (!tbody) return;
  tbody.innerHTML = '';

  if (!Array.isArray(logs) || logs.length === 0) {
    const row = document.createElement('tr');
    const cell = document.createElement('td');
    cell.colSpan = 6;
    cell.className = 'table-empty';
    cell.textContent = 'No API calls recorded in this session yet.';
    row.appendChild(cell);
    tbody.appendChild(row);
    return;
  }

  logs.forEach((item) => {
    const tr = document.createElement('tr');

    // Time (HH:MM:SS)
    const tdTime = document.createElement('td');
    tdTime.className = 'mono-text';
    tdTime.textContent = item.timestamp ? new Date(item.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString() : '--';

    // Method
    const tdMethod = document.createElement('td');
    const methodBadge = document.createElement('span');
    methodBadge.className = 'badge-subtle';
    methodBadge.textContent = item.method;
    tdMethod.appendChild(methodBadge);

    // Path
    const tdPath = document.createElement('td');
    tdPath.className = 'mono-text';
    tdPath.textContent = item.path;

    // Status
    const tdStatus = document.createElement('td');
    const statusBadge = document.createElement('span');
    statusBadge.className = `badge-status status-${item.statusCode}`;
    statusBadge.textContent = item.statusCode;
    tdStatus.appendChild(statusBadge);

    // Latency
    const tdLatency = document.createElement('td');
    tdLatency.className = 'mono-text';
    tdLatency.textContent = `${item.durationMs}ms`;

    // Cache
    const tdCache = document.createElement('td');
    const cacheBadge = document.createElement('span');
    const cacheVal = String(item.cache || 'none').toUpperCase();
    if (cacheVal === 'HIT') {
      cacheBadge.className = 'badge-cache hit';
      cacheBadge.textContent = 'HIT';
    } else if (cacheVal === 'MISS') {
      cacheBadge.className = 'badge-cache miss';
      cacheBadge.textContent = 'MISS';
    } else {
      cacheBadge.className = 'badge-subtle';
      cacheBadge.textContent = '-';
    }
    tdCache.appendChild(cacheBadge);

    tr.appendChild(tdTime);
    tr.appendChild(tdMethod);
    tr.appendChild(tdPath);
    tr.appendChild(tdStatus);
    tr.appendChild(tdLatency);
    tr.appendChild(tdCache);

    tbody.appendChild(tr);
  });
}

/**
 * Display alert banner with live countdown for HTTP 429.
 */
export function showAlert(message, type = 'error', retryAfterSeconds = null) {
  const container = document.getElementById('status-container');
  if (!container) return;

  if (activeRateLimitTimer) {
    clearInterval(activeRateLimitTimer);
    activeRateLimitTimer = null;
  }
  container.innerHTML = '';

  const banner = document.createElement('div');
  banner.className = `alert-banner ${type === 'rate-limit' ? 'rate-limit' : type === 'warning' ? 'warning' : 'error'}`;

  const messageSpan = document.createElement('span');
  messageSpan.textContent = message;
  banner.appendChild(messageSpan);

  if (type === 'rate-limit' && retryAfterSeconds && retryAfterSeconds > 0) {
    let remaining = retryAfterSeconds;
    const timerBadge = document.createElement('span');
    timerBadge.className = 'rate-limit-timer';
    timerBadge.textContent = `Retry available in ${remaining}s`;
    banner.appendChild(timerBadge);

    activeRateLimitTimer = setInterval(() => {
      remaining -= 1;
      if (remaining <= 0) {
        clearInterval(activeRateLimitTimer);
        activeRateLimitTimer = null;
        timerBadge.textContent = 'Limit reset! You may retry now.';
        timerBadge.style.color = '#34d399';
      } else {
        timerBadge.textContent = `Retry available in ${remaining}s`;
      }
    }, 1000);
  }

  const closeBtn = document.createElement('button');
  closeBtn.type = 'button';
  closeBtn.className = 'chip-btn';
  closeBtn.textContent = '✕';
  closeBtn.style.marginLeft = 'auto';
  closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (activeRateLimitTimer) {
      clearInterval(activeRateLimitTimer);
      activeRateLimitTimer = null;
    }
    banner.remove();
  });
  banner.appendChild(closeBtn);

  container.appendChild(banner);
}

export function clearAlerts() {
  const container = document.getElementById('status-container');
  if (container) {
    if (activeRateLimitTimer) {
      clearInterval(activeRateLimitTimer);
      activeRateLimitTimer = null;
    }
    container.innerHTML = '';
  }
}

/**
 * Environment configuration and startup validation.
 * Centralizes all environment variable access and enforces safety invariants.
 */
const path = require('path');
const dotenv = require('dotenv');

// Load .env from project root
dotenv.config({ path: path.resolve(__dirname, '../../.env') });

const NODE_ENV = process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development';
const PORT = parseInt(process.env.PORT, 10) || 3000;
const CLIENT_ORIGIN = process.env.CLIENT_ORIGIN || `http://localhost:${PORT}`;
const GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL =
  process.env.GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL || `http://localhost:${PORT}/auth/github/callback`;

// 1. SESSION_SECRET Validation:
// In production and development alike, weak session secrets make session forgery and HMAC bypass trivial.
// We strictly enforce a minimum length of 32 characters.
const SESSION_SECRET = process.env.SESSION_SECRET;
if (!SESSION_SECRET || SESSION_SECRET.trim().length < 32) {
  const errMsg =
    '[FATAL CONFIG ERROR] SESSION_SECRET must be defined in .env and be at least 32 characters long for secure HMAC signing.';
  // In tests, if not set, we can allow a default only if NODE_ENV === 'test'
  if (NODE_ENV === 'test') {
    process.env.SESSION_SECRET = 'test_default_session_secret_at_least_32_characters_long_for_safety';
  } else {
    console.error(errMsg);
    throw new Error(errMsg);
  }
}

// 2. GitHub OAuth Credentials Check:
// If missing, we do NOT crash the app — this allows running tests and local demos without registering an app first.
const GITHUB_CLIENT_ID = process.env.GITHUB_CLIENT_ID ? process.env.GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.trim() : '';
const GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET = process.env.GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET ? process.env.GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.trim() : '';
const isOAuthConfigured = Boolean(
  GITHUB_CLIENT_ID &&
  GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET &&
  !GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.includes('your_github') &&
  !GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.includes('your_github')
);

if (!isOAuthConfigured && NODE_ENV !== 'test') {
  console.warn('\x1b[33m%s\x1b[0m', '----------------------------------------------------------------------');
  console.warn('\x1b[33m%s\x1b[0m', '[NOTICE] GitHub OAuth is NOT fully configured (GITHUB_CLIENT_ID or GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET missing).');
  console.warn('\x1b[33m%s\x1b[0m', '  - Real /auth/github calls will respond with a friendly HTTP 503.');
  console.warn('\x1b[33m%s\x1b[0m', '  - Use DEMO_MODE=true for testing the dashboard without GitHub credentials.');
  console.warn('\x1b[33m%s\x1b[0m', '  - See README.md for instructions on registering a GitHub OAuth App.');
  console.warn('\x1b[33m%s\x1b[0m', '----------------------------------------------------------------------');
}

// 3. Demo Mode Configuration:
// Demo mode is explicitly disabled in production for security.
let DEMO_MODE = process.env.DEMO_MODE === 'true';
if (DEMO_MODE && NODE_ENV === 'production') {
  console.warn('[SECURITY WARNING] DEMO_MODE=true was requested, but refused because NODE_ENV=production. Demo mode disabled.');
  DEMO_MODE = false;
}

module.exports = {
  NODE_ENV,
  PORT,
  SESSION_SECRET: process.env.SESSION_SECRET || SESSION_SECRET,
  GITHUB_CLIENT_ID,
  GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET,
  GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL,
  CLIENT_ORIGIN,
  DEMO_MODE,
  isOAuthConfigured
};

/**
 * Passport.js Configuration for GitHub OAuth 2.0.
 *
 * OAuth 2.0 State Parameter & CSRF Protection:
 * During the OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code flow, the client redirects the user to GitHub.
 * An attacker could trick a victim into submitting the attacker's authorization code,
 * linking the victim's local session to the attacker's GitHub account (OAuth Login CSRF).
 *
 * By enabling `state: true` in passport-github2, Passport generates a cryptographically
 * random, unguessable state token, stores it in the user's session cookie, and includes it
 * in the authorization request to GitHub.
 * When GitHub redirects back to `/auth/github/callback?code=...&state=...`, Passport compares
 * the returned state parameter against the one stored in the user's session.
 * If they do not match, the callback fails immediately, defeating OAuth CSRF attacks.
 *
 * Token Security:
 * The raw GitHub access token is stored ONLY in the server-side session.
 * It is NEVER transmitted to the client browser or exposed in client responses.
 */

const passport = require('passport');
const GitHubStrategy = require('passport-github2').Strategy;
const {
  GITHUB_CLIENT_ID,
  GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET,
  GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL,
  isOAuthConfigured
} = require('./env');

/**
 * Session serialization:
 * Stores sanitized user profile and the access token in the server-side session store.
 */
passport.serializeUser((user, done) => {
  done(null, {
    id: user.id,
    username: user.username,
    displayName: user.displayName || user.username,
    avatarUrl: user.avatarUrl || user._json?.avatar_url || '',
    accessToken: user.accessToken || null
  });
});

/**
 * Session deserialization:
 * Restores the user object from the serialized session store into req.user.
 */
passport.deserializeUser((serializedUser, done) => {
  done(null, serializedUser);
});

// Conditionally register GitHubStrategy only if valid credentials are provided
if (isOAuthConfigured) {
  passport.use(
    new GitHubStrategy(
      {
        clientID: GITHUB_CLIENT_ID,
        clientSecret: GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET,
        callbackURL: GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL,
        // Only request 'read:user' as required by Task 7 specification
        scope: ['read:user'],
        // `state: true` instructs Passport to use session-backed state tokens to prevent CSRF attacks
        state: true
      },
      (accessToken, refreshToken, profile, done) => {
        // Extract clean user information from GitHub profile and attach token for server-side API calls
        const user = {
          id: profile.id,
          username: profile.username,
          displayName: profile.displayName || profile.username,
          avatarUrl:
            profile.photos && profile.photos[0]
              ? profile.photos[0].value
              : profile._json?.avatar_url || '',
          accessToken
        };
        return done(null, user);
      }
    )
  );
}

module.exports = passport;

/**
 * Country Controller.

/**
 * Demo & Error Simulation Controller.
 * Provides on-demand error simulation through the REAL production error-handling pipeline.
 *
 * Security:
 * Strictly disabled when NODE_ENV === 'production' unless explicitly enabled via DEMO_MODE=true.
 */

const AppError = require('../utils/AppError');
const { DEMO_MODE, NODE_ENV } = require('../config/env');

/**
 * GET /api/demo/error?type=timeout|upstream500|upstream429|notfound|badinput
 */
function triggerError(req, res, next) {
  // Guard against production execution if demo mode is off
  if (NODE_ENV === 'production' && !DEMO_MODE) {
    return next(new AppError('Error simulation is disabled in production mode.', 403));
  }

  const { type } = req.query;

  switch (type) {
    case 'timeout':
      // Simulates client-side request abort after 5000ms timeout
      return next(
        new AppError('Open-Meteo request timed out after 5000ms. Please try again.', 504)
      );

    case 'upstream500':
      // Simulates upstream service internal 500 crash
      return next(
        new AppError(
          'Open-Meteo is currently experiencing issues (HTTP 500). Upstream unavailable.',
          502
        )
      );

    case 'upstream429':
      // Simulates upstream service rate limit rejection
      return next(
        new AppError(
          'Open-Meteo rate limit exceeded. Please wait a moment before trying again.',
          503,
          null,
          30 // 30-second retryAfter
        )
      );

    case 'notfound':
      // Simulates resource not found
      return next(
        new AppError("City 'NonExistentCityXYZ' not found. Please verify spelling.", 404)
      );

    case 'badinput':
      // Simulates express-validator rejection
      return next(
        new AppError('Invalid request input parameters.', 400, [
          'city: City name must be between 2 and 60 characters.'
        ])
      );

    default:
      return next(
        new AppError(
          `Invalid error type '${type || ''}'. Valid types: timeout, upstream500, upstream429, notfound, badinput`,
          400
        )
      );
  }
}

module.exports = {
  triggerError
};

/**
 * Weather Controller.
 * Coordinates Open-Meteo weather lookups, REST Countries enrichment, session history, and caching headers.
 */

const weatherService = require('../services/weather.service');
const countryService = require('../services/country.service');

/**
 * GET /api/weather?city=London&units=metric
 *
 * Fetches current weather and 5-day forecast.
 * Gracefully attempts to enrich with country metadata; if REST Countries fails,
 * weather data is still returned with country: null and a warning.
 */
async function getWeather(req, res) {
  const { city, units = 'metric' } = req.query;

  // 1. Fetch weather from Open-Meteo (or in-memory cache)
  const { data: weatherData, fromCache } = await weatherService.getWeatherForCity(city, units);

  // Set X-Cache response header
  res.set('X-Cache', fromCache ? 'HIT' : 'MISS');

  // 2. Graceful country enrichment via REST Countries
  let countryDetails = null;
  const warnings = [];

  if (weatherData.countryCode) {
    try {
      const countryResult = await countryService.getCountryByCode(weatherData.countryCode);
      countryDetails = countryResult.data;
    } catch (countryError) {
      // Graceful degradation: we log the warning on server but do not fail the request
      countryDetails = null;
      warnings.push('Country information from REST Countries is temporarily unavailable.');
    }
  }

  // 3. Record search in session history (last 10 unique searches)
  if (req.session) {
    if (!Array.isArray(req.session.searchHistory)) {
      req.session.searchHistory = [];
    }

    const newEntry = {
      city: weatherData.city,
      country: weatherData.country,
      countryCode: weatherData.countryCode,
      searchedAt: new Date().toISOString()
    };

    // Deduplicate and prepend
    req.session.searchHistory = [
      newEntry,
      ...req.session.searchHistory.filter(
        (item) => item.city.toLowerCase() !== weatherData.city.toLowerCase()
      )
    ].slice(0, 10);
  }

  const responsePayload = {
    success: true,
    data: {
      ...weatherData,
      country: countryDetails
    }
  };

  if (warnings.length > 0) {
    responsePayload.warnings = warnings;
  }

  return res.status(200).json(responsePayload);
}

module.exports = {
  getWeather
};

/**
 * Central Error Handling Middleware.
 *
 * Security & Reliability Best Practices:
 * 1. Information Disclosure Prevention:
 *    NEVER leak stack traces, internal database details, third-party authentication tokens,
 *    or raw upstream URLs to the client.
 * 2. Audit & Observability:
 *    Logs full diagnostic stack traces to server logs (stdout/stderr) for developer debugging.
 * 3. Uniform Response Contract:
 *    Always returns standard JSON shape: { success: false, message: "...", errors: [...] }
 */

// eslint-disable-next-line no-unused-vars
function errorHandler(err, req, res, next) {
  const statusCode = err.statusCode || 500;
  const isProduction = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production';

  // Server-side logging for operational monitoring
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'test') {
    const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
    console.error(`[${timestamp}] [ERROR] ${req.method} ${req.originalUrl} - Status: ${statusCode}`);
    if (err.stack) {
      console.error(err.stack);
    } else {
      console.error(err);
    }
  }

  // Determine safe user-facing message
  let clientMessage = err.message || 'An internal server error occurred.';
  if (statusCode === 500 && isProduction) {
    clientMessage = 'An unexpected internal error occurred on our server. Please try again later.';
  }

  // Response payload adhering strictly to client contract without stack traces
  const responseBody = {
    success: false,
    message: clientMessage,
    errors: Array.isArray(err.errors) ? err.errors : [clientMessage]
  };

  // Include Retry-After header and body property if present (429 or 503)
  if (err.retryAfter) {
    res.set('Retry-After', String(err.retryAfter));
    responseBody.retryAfter = err.retryAfter;
  }

  res.status(statusCode).json(responseBody);
}

module.exports = errorHandler;

/**
 * Rate Limiting Middleware using express-rate-limit.
 *
 * Why Rate Limiting is Critical:
 * 1. Denial-of-Service (DoS) and Brute-Force Defense:
 *    Prevents malicious actors or buggy clients from overwhelming the Node.js event loop
 *    with excessive concurrent requests.
 * 2. Third-Party API Quota & Cost Protection:
 *    Even though Open-Meteo and REST Countries are free, upstream providers enforce burst
 *    and daily consumption thresholds (e.g. 10,000 calls/day or 60 calls/min).
 *    Rate limiting our own endpoints protects upstream infrastructure from cascading failures
 *    and prevents our server IP from being blocked or blacklisted.
 * 3. Fair Resource Allocation:
 *    Ensures a single aggressive user or script cannot starve out legitimate users.
 */

const rateLimit = require('express-rate-limit');

/**
 * Standard 429 JSON Error Handler
 */
function createRateLimitHandler(customMessage = 'Too many requests. Please slow down.') {
  return (req, res /* , next, options */) => {
    // Calculate remaining seconds until reset
    const resetTime = req.rateLimit?.resetTime
      ? Math.max(1, Math.ceil((new Date(req.rateLimit.resetTime).getTime() - Date.now()) / 1000))
      : 60;

    res.set('Retry-After', String(resetTime));

    res.status(429).json({
      success: false,
      message: customMessage,
      retryAfter: resetTime,
      errors: ['Rate limit exceeded']
    });
  };
}

/**
 * General API Rate Limiter:
 * Allows up to 100 requests per 15 minutes per IP address across all general endpoints.
 */
const generalLimiter = rateLimit({
  windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000, // 15 minutes
  max: 100, // limit each IP to 100 requests per window
  standardHeaders: true, // Return standard RateLimit-* headers (RFC draft)
  legacyHeaders: false, // Disable the X-RateLimit-* headers
  handler: createRateLimitHandler('General API rate limit reached. Maximum 100 requests per 15 minutes.'),
  skip: (req) => process.env.NODE_ENV === 'test' && !req.headers['x-test-rate-limit']
});

/**
 * Strict External API Rate Limiter:
 * Applied to endpoints that trigger outbound network traffic to third parties (/api/weather, /api/country, /api/demo/error).
 * Limits to 20 requests per 1-minute window per user (or IP if unauthenticated).
 */
const externalApiLimiter = rateLimit({
  windowMs: 1 * 60 * 1000, // 1 minute
  max: 20, // limit to 20 requests per minute
  standardHeaders: true,
  legacyHeaders: false,
  keyGenerator: (req) => {
    // Key by authenticated user ID if available, otherwise fallback to IP
    return req.user?.id ? `user_${req.user.id}` : (req.ip || 'unknown_client');
  },
  handler: createRateLimitHandler(
    'External API rate limit reached. Maximum 20 weather/country queries per minute.'
  ),
  skip: (req) => process.env.NODE_ENV === 'test' && !req.headers['x-test-rate-limit']
});

/**
 * Retrieve active limiter counters for a given request.
 *
 * @param {import('express').Request} req
 * @returns {Promise<Object>} { general: { limit, remaining, resetSeconds }, strict: { limit, remaining, resetSeconds } }
 */
async function getLimiterState(req) {
  const strictKey = req.user?.id ? `user_${req.user.id}` : (req.ip || 'unknown_client');
  const generalKey = req.ip || 'unknown_client';

  let strictHits = 0;
  let strictResetTime = null;
  if (externalApiLimiter.store && typeof externalApiLimiter.store.get === 'function') {
    try {
      const record = await externalApiLimiter.store.get(strictKey);
      if (record) {
        strictHits = record.totalHits || 0;
        strictResetTime = record.resetTime;
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  let generalHits = 0;
  let generalResetTime = null;
  if (generalLimiter.store && typeof generalLimiter.store.get === 'function') {
    try {
      const record = await generalLimiter.store.get(generalKey);
      if (record) {
        generalHits = record.totalHits || 0;
        generalResetTime = record.resetTime;
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  const now = Date.now();
  const strictResetSeconds = strictResetTime
    ? Math.max(0, Math.ceil((new Date(strictResetTime).getTime() - now) / 1000))
    : 60;

  const generalResetSeconds = generalResetTime
    ? Math.max(0, Math.ceil((new Date(generalResetTime).getTime() - now) / 1000))
    : 900;

  return {
    general: {
      limit: 100,
      remaining: Math.max(0, 100 - generalHits),
      resetSeconds: generalResetSeconds
    },
    strict: {
      limit: 20,
      remaining: Math.max(0, 20 - strictHits),
      resetSeconds: strictResetSeconds
    }
  };
}

module.exports = {
  generalLimiter,
  externalApiLimiter,
  getLimiterState
};

/**
 * Authentication Gatekeeper Middleware.
 * Ensures that incoming requests to protected routes possess an active, valid session.
 */
function requireAuth(req, res, next) {
  // Passport provides req.isAuthenticated()
  if (req.isAuthenticated && req.isAuthenticated()) {
    return next();
  }

  // Support direct req.user check if set by session or demo login
  if (req.user) {
    return next();
  }

  return res.status(401).json({
    success: false,
    message: 'Authentication required. Please log in with GitHub to access this resource.',
    errors: ['Unauthorized']
  });
}

module.exports = requireAuth;
