/**
 * OpsDesk Server Dashboard - Client Application
 *
 * ============================================================================
 * SECURITY ARCHITECTURE NOTE:
 * ============================================================================
 * In accordance with enterprise secure coding guidelines, this dashboard
 * NEVER uses raw `.innerHTML` to insert dynamic or untrusted data.
 * All DOM updates are executed strictly via safe APIs:
 * - `element.textContent`
 * - `document.createElement`
 * - `element.appendChild`
 * This ensures absolute immunity against Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vectors.
 * ============================================================================
 */

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  // --- DOM Elements ---
  const modeBadge = document.getElementById('modeBadge');
  const uptimeVal = document.getElementById('uptimeVal');
  const queueVal = document.getElementById('queueVal');
  const cacheRatioVal = document.getElementById('cacheRatioVal');

  // Step 1: Middleware
  const btnSendTestRequest = document.getElementById('btnSendTestRequest');
  const btnRefreshLogs = document.getElementById('btnRefreshLogs');
  const hdrRequestId = document.getElementById('hdrRequestId');
  const hdrResponseTime = document.getElementById('hdrResponseTime');
  const hdrStatus = document.getElementById('hdrStatus');
  const hdrClientTime = document.getElementById('hdrClientTime');
  const logWindow = document.getElementById('logWindow');

  // Step 2: Background Jobs
  const btnQueueEmail = document.getElementById('btnQueueEmail');
  const btnQueueFailingEmail = document.getElementById('btnQueueFailingEmail');
  const btnQueueReport = document.getElementById('btnQueueReport');
  const jobsTableBody = document.getElementById('jobsTableBody');

  // Step 3: Cache
  const btnFetchProducts = document.getElementById('btnFetchProducts');
  const btnFetchTwice = document.getElementById('btnFetchTwice');
  const btnStampedeTest = document.getElementById('btnStampedeTest');
  const btnInvalidateCreate = document.getElementById('btnInvalidateCreate');
  const btnClearCache = document.getElementById('btnClearCache');
  const statHits = document.getElementById('statHits');
  const statMisses = document.getElementById('statMisses');
  const statKeys = document.getElementById('statKeys');
  const lastCacheBadge = document.getElementById('lastCacheBadge');
  const cacheResultsWindow = document.getElementById('cacheResultsWindow');

  // Local state tracking
  let trackedJobIds = new Set();

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // UTILITY HELPERS
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  function formatUptime(seconds) {
    const s = Math.floor(seconds);
    const m = Math.floor(s / 60);
    const h = Math.floor(m / 60);
    if (h > 0) return `${h}h ${m % 60}m ${s % 60}s`;
    if (m > 0) return `${m}m ${s % 60}s`;
    return `${s}s`;
  }

  function clearElement(element) {
    while (element.firstChild) {
      element.removeChild(element.firstChild);
    }
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // STEP 1: SYSTEM & MIDDLEWARE INSPECTION
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  async function refreshSystemStatus() {
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/health');
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
      const json = await res.json();
      const data = json.data;

      // Update Mode Badge
      modeBadge.textContent = (data.mode || 'MEMORY').toUpperCase();
      modeBadge.className = data.mode === 'redis' ? 'badge badge-redis' : 'badge badge-memory';

      // Update Uptime & Metrics
      uptimeVal.textContent = formatUptime(data.uptime);
      const active = data.queue?.counts?.active || 0;
      const waiting = data.queue?.counts?.waiting || 0;
      queueVal.textContent = `${active} / ${waiting}`;

      cacheRatioVal.textContent = data.cache?.hitRatio !== undefined ? data.cache.hitRatio.toFixed(2) : '0.00';
      statHits.textContent = String(data.cache?.hits || 0);
      statMisses.textContent = String(data.cache?.misses || 0);
      statKeys.textContent = String(data.cache?.keysCount || 0);
    } catch (err) {
      modeBadge.textContent = 'OFFLINE';
      modeBadge.className = 'badge';
    }
  }

  async function refreshAccessLogs() {
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/logs/tail?lines=25');
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
      const json = await res.json();
      const lines = json.data?.lines || [];

      if (lines.length === 0) {
        logWindow.textContent = 'No log entries recorded yet.';
      } else {
        logWindow.textContent = lines.join('\n');
      }
      logWindow.scrollTop = logWindow.scrollHeight;
    } catch (err) {
      logWindow.textContent = `Failed to load logs: ${err.message}`;
    }
  }

  async function handleSendTestRequest() {
    btnSendTestRequest.disabled = true;
    hdrRequestId.textContent = 'Measuring...';
    hdrResponseTime.textContent = 'Measuring...';
    hdrStatus.textContent = '...';
    hdrClientTime.textContent = '...';

    const t0 = performance.now();
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/health', {
        headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' }
      });
      const t1 = performance.now();

      const serverReqId = res.headers.get('x-request-id') || 'Not received';
      const serverResTime = res.headers.get('x-response-time') || 'Not received';

      hdrRequestId.textContent = serverReqId;
      hdrResponseTime.textContent = serverResTime;
      hdrStatus.textContent = `${res.status} ${res.statusText}`;
      hdrClientTime.textContent = `${(t1 - t0).toFixed(2)}ms (client round-trip)`;

      // Refresh log tail after small delay so log stream flushed
      setTimeout(refreshAccessLogs, 300);
    } catch (err) {
      hdrStatus.textContent = 'Request failed';
      hdrClientTime.textContent = err.message;
    } finally {
      btnSendTestRequest.disabled = false;
    }
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // STEP 2: BACKGROUND JOBS MANAGEMENT
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  async function enqueueJob(url, body) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(url, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(body),
      });

      const json = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) {
        alert(`Error enqueuing job: ${json.message}`);
        return null;
      }

      const jobId = json.data?.jobId;
      if (jobId) {
        trackedJobIds.add(jobId);
      }
      await refreshJobsTable();
      return json.data;
    } catch (err) {
      alert(`Network error enqueuing job: ${err.message}`);
      return null;
    }
  }

  async function refreshJobsTable() {
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/jobs?limit=15');
      if (!res.ok) return;
      const json = await res.json();
      const jobs = json.data?.jobs || [];

      clearElement(jobsTableBody);

      if (jobs.length === 0) {
        const tr = document.createElement('tr');
        const td = document.createElement('td');
        td.colSpan = 6;
        td.className = 'empty-cell';
        td.textContent = 'No jobs triggered yet. Click one of the buttons above to enqueue!';
        tr.appendChild(td);
        jobsTableBody.appendChild(tr);
        return;
      }

      jobs.forEach((job) => {
        const tr = document.createElement('tr');

        // Column 1: Job ID (shortened)
        const tdId = document.createElement('td');
        const shortId = job.id.length > 12 ? `${job.id.substring(0, 10)}...` : job.id;
        tdId.textContent = shortId;
        tdId.title = job.id;
        tr.appendChild(tdId);

        // Column 2: Name
        const tdName = document.createElement('td');
        tdName.textContent = job.name;
        tr.appendChild(tdName);

        // Column 3: State Badge
        const tdState = document.createElement('td');
        const stateBadge = document.createElement('span');
        stateBadge.className = `state-badge state-${job.state}`;
        stateBadge.textContent = job.state;
        tdState.appendChild(stateBadge);
        tr.appendChild(tdState);

        // Column 4: Attempts Made
        const tdAttempts = document.createElement('td');
        tdAttempts.textContent = `${job.attemptsMade} / ${job.maxAttempts}`;
        tr.appendChild(tdAttempts);

        // Column 5: Progress Bar
        const tdProgress = document.createElement('td');
        const pContainer = document.createElement('div');
        pContainer.className = 'progress-bar-container';
        const pFill = document.createElement('div');
        pFill.className = 'progress-bar-fill';
        pFill.style.width = `${job.progress || 0}%`;
        pContainer.appendChild(pFill);
        tdProgress.appendChild(pContainer);

        const pText = document.createElement('span');
        pText.textContent = `${job.progress || 0}%`;
        tdProgress.appendChild(pText);
        tr.appendChild(tdProgress);

        // Column 6: Result / Error
        const tdResult = document.createElement('td');
        if (job.state === 'failed') {
          tdResult.textContent = job.failedReason || 'Failed';
          tdResult.className = 'text-warning';
        } else if (job.state === 'completed') {
          if (job.name === 'welcome-email') {
            tdResult.textContent = `Sent: ${job.result?.recipient}`;
          } else if (job.name === 'generate-report') {
            tdResult.textContent = job.result?.calculatedMetric || 'Success';
          } else {
            tdResult.textContent = 'Completed';
          }
          tdResult.className = 'text-success';
        } else {
          tdResult.textContent = 'Processing...';
        }
        tr.appendChild(tdResult);

        jobsTableBody.appendChild(tr);
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Jobs refresh failed:', err);
    }
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // STEP 3: CACHING & STAMPEDE BENCHMARKS
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  async function fetchProductsOnce() {
    btnFetchProducts.disabled = true;
    cacheResultsWindow.textContent = 'Fetching /api/products (simulating 2-second DB query if uncached)...';

    const t0 = performance.now();
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/products?page=1&limit=5');
      const t1 = performance.now();
      const latency = (t1 - t0).toFixed(2);
      const cacheHeader = res.headers.get('x-cache') || 'MISS';
      const json = await res.json();

      lastCacheBadge.textContent = `${cacheHeader} (${latency}ms)`;
      lastCacheBadge.className = cacheHeader === 'HIT' ? 'metric-value cache-badge-hit' : 'metric-value cache-badge-miss';

      cacheResultsWindow.textContent = [
        `URL: GET /api/products?page=1&limit=5`,
        `HTTP Status: ${res.status}`,
        `X-Cache Header: ${cacheHeader}`,
        `Total Latency: ${latency}ms`,
        `Products Retrieved: ${json.data?.products?.length || 0} items`,
        `First Item: ${json.data?.products?.[0]?.name || 'N/A'}`
      ].join('\n');

      await refreshSystemStatus();
    } catch (err) {
      cacheResultsWindow.textContent = `Request failed: ${err.message}`;
    } finally {
      btnFetchProducts.disabled = false;
    }
  }

  async function fetchProductsTwice() {
    btnFetchTwice.disabled = true;
    cacheResultsWindow.textContent = 'Executing Sequential Calls (Call 1: Cold/Existing, Call 2: Guaranteed Cache Hit)...\n';

    try {
      // Call 1
      const t0 = performance.now();
      const res1 = await fetch('/api/products?page=1&limit=5');
      const t1 = performance.now();
      const latency1 = (t1 - t0).toFixed(2);
      const cache1 = res1.headers.get('x-cache') || 'MISS';

      // Call 2
      const t2 = performance.now();
      const res2 = await fetch('/api/products?page=1&limit=5');
      const t3 = performance.now();
      const latency2 = (t3 - t2).toFixed(2);
      const cache2 = res2.headers.get('x-cache') || 'HIT';

      const speedup = (parseFloat(latency1) / Math.max(parseFloat(latency2), 0.1)).toFixed(1);

      cacheResultsWindow.textContent = [
        `=============================================================`,
        `  SEQUENTIAL FETCH SPEED BENCHMARK`,
        `=============================================================`,
        `Call 1 (Primary):    ${latency1}ms  |  X-Cache: ${cache1}`,
        `Call 2 (Cached):     ${latency2}ms  |  X-Cache: ${cache2}`,
        `-------------------------------------------------------------`,
        `Performance Boost:   ${speedup}x faster response on Cache HIT!`,
        `Note: Call 2 returned in milliseconds directly from memory/Redis.`
      ].join('\n');

      await refreshSystemStatus();
    } catch (err) {
      cacheResultsWindow.textContent = `Comparison failed: ${err.message}`;
    } finally {
      btnFetchTwice.disabled = false;
    }
  }

  async function testCacheStampede() {
    btnStampedeTest.disabled = true;
    cacheResultsWindow.textContent = 'Firing 10 concurrent requests to a brand new cache key...\nTesting Single-Flight Request Coalescing...';

    // Unique URL to guarantee cold cache
    const testUrl = `/api/products?stampedeTestKey=${Date.now()}`;

    try {
      const overallStart = performance.now();

      // Launch 10 concurrent requests simultaneously
      const promises = Array.from({ length: 10 }, async (_, index) => {
        const reqStart = performance.now();
        const res = await fetch(testUrl);
        const reqEnd = performance.now();
        return {
          index: index + 1,
          latency: (reqEnd - reqStart).toFixed(2),
          cache: res.headers.get('x-cache') || 'UNKNOWN',
          status: res.status
        };
      });

      const results = await Promise.all(promises);
      const overallEnd = performance.now();
      const totalWallTime = (overallEnd - overallStart).toFixed(2);

      const missCount = results.filter((r) => r.cache === 'MISS').length;
      const hitCount = results.filter((r) => r.cache === 'HIT').length;

      const lines = [
        `=============================================================`,
        `  CACHE STAMPEDE PROTECTION RESULTS (10 CONCURRENT REQUESTS) `,
        `=============================================================`,
        `Target URL: GET ${testUrl}`,
        `Total Concurrent Wall-Clock Time: ${totalWallTime}ms`,
        `Origin Calls (Cache MISS): ${missCount} (Expect exactly 1)`,
        `Coalesced Responses (Cache HIT): ${hitCount} (Expect 9)`,
        `-------------------------------------------------------------`,
        `Individual Request Breakdown:`,
        ...results.map((r) => `  Request #${r.index.toString().padStart(2, '0')}: Latency = ${r.latency.padStart(7, ' ')}ms | X-Cache: ${r.cache}`),
        `-------------------------------------------------------------`,
        missCount === 1
          ? `SUCCESS: Only 1 request hit the slow database service! Remaining 9 were coalesced in-flight.`
          : `Note: Completed with ${missCount} misses.`
      ];

      cacheResultsWindow.textContent = lines.join('\n');
      await refreshSystemStatus();
    } catch (err) {
      cacheResultsWindow.textContent = `Stampede test error: ${err.message}`;
    } finally {
      btnStampedeTest.disabled = false;
    }
  }

  async function handleInvalidateByCreate() {
    btnInvalidateCreate.disabled = true;
    cacheResultsWindow.textContent = 'Posting new product to trigger server-side cache invalidation...';

    try {
      const dummyProduct = {
        name: `Server Rack Shelf Model ${Math.floor(Math.random() * 900 + 100)}`,
        category: 'electronics',
        price: 89.99,
        stock: 25,
        description: 'Auto-generated product to demonstrate automatic cache eviction upon mutation.'
      };

      const res = await fetch('/api/products', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(dummyProduct)
      });

      const json = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(json.message);

      cacheResultsWindow.textContent = [
        `[CACHE INVALIDATION TRIGGERED]`,
        `Created product ID: ${json.data?.id} - "${json.data?.name}"`,
        `Server invalidated all keys matching prefix: "cache:GET:/api/products*"`,
        `Subsequent GET /api/products will now result in a fresh Cache MISS.`
      ].join('\n');

      await refreshSystemStatus();
    } catch (err) {
      cacheResultsWindow.textContent = `Invalidation error: ${err.message}`;
    } finally {
      btnInvalidateCreate.disabled = false;
    }
  }

  async function handleClearAllCache() {
    btnClearCache.disabled = true;
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/cache', { method: 'DELETE' });
      const json = await res.json();

      cacheResultsWindow.textContent = `All cache keys purged. ${json.message}`;
      lastCacheBadge.textContent = 'PURGED';
      lastCacheBadge.className = 'metric-value';

      await refreshSystemStatus();
    } catch (err) {
      cacheResultsWindow.textContent = `Flush cache error: ${err.message}`;
    } finally {
      btnClearCache.disabled = false;
    }
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // EVENT LISTENERS
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  btnSendTestRequest.addEventListener('click', handleSendTestRequest);
  btnRefreshLogs.addEventListener('click', refreshAccessLogs);

  btnQueueEmail.addEventListener('click', () => {
    enqueueJob('/api/jobs/email', {
      name: 'Sarah Connor',
      email: 'sarah.connor@cyberdyne.org'
    });
  });

  btnQueueFailingEmail.addEventListener('click', () => {
    enqueueJob('/api/jobs/email', {
      name: 'Intentional Failure Tester',
      email: 'simulate-fail-retry@domain.internal'
    });
  });

  btnQueueReport.addEventListener('click', () => {
    enqueueJob('/api/jobs/report', {
      type: 'sales',
      rows: 2500
    });
  });

  btnFetchProducts.addEventListener('click', fetchProductsOnce);
  btnFetchTwice.addEventListener('click', fetchProductsTwice);
  btnStampedeTest.addEventListener('click', testCacheStampede);
  btnInvalidateCreate.addEventListener('click', handleInvalidateByCreate);
  btnClearCache.addEventListener('click', handleClearAllCache);

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // INITIAL LOAD & POLLING INTERVALS
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  refreshSystemStatus();
  refreshAccessLogs();
  refreshJobsTable();

  // Poll system status every 3 seconds
  setInterval(refreshSystemStatus, 3000);

  // Poll jobs table every 1 second
  setInterval(refreshJobsTable, 1000);
});

const Redis = require('ioredis');
const env = require('./env');

let cachedMode = null;
let probeClient = null;

/**
 * Creates an ioredis instance with appropriate configuration
 * for BullMQ (maxRetriesPerRequest: null) and general usage.
 * @param {object} [customOptions={}]
 * @returns {Redis}
 */
function createRedisClient(customOptions = {}) {
  const url = env.redisUrl || 'redis://127.0.0.1:6379';
  return new Redis(url, {
    maxRetriesPerRequest: null,
    enableReadyCheck: true,
    connectTimeout: 2000,
    retryStrategy(times) {
      // Reconnect with backoff capped at 2 seconds
      return Math.min(times * 100, 2000);
    },
    ...customOptions,
  });
}

/**
 * Checks whether Redis is configured and reachable.
 * Times out after 1500ms to ensure fast application startup even if Redis is offline.
 * @returns {Promise<{ mode: 'redis' | 'memory', client: Redis|null, url: string|null }>}
 */
async function detectRedisMode() {
  if (cachedMode) {
    return cachedMode;
  }

  // If REDIS_URL is explicitly empty or null, run in memory mode immediately
  if (!env.redisUrl) {
    console.log('[System] REDIS_URL not configured. Running in MEMORY mode.');
    cachedMode = { mode: 'memory', client: null, url: null };
    return cachedMode;
  }

  // Attempt a ping test with a fast timeout
  const testClient = new Redis(env.redisUrl, {
    connectTimeout: 1500,
    maxRetriesPerRequest: 1,
    retryStrategy: () => null, // Do not auto-retry during probe
    lazyConnect: true,
  });

  try {
    const pingPromise = (async () => {
      await testClient.connect();
      const res = await testClient.ping();
      return res === 'PONG';
    })();

    const timeoutPromise = new Promise((_, reject) =>
      setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Redis probe timed out (1500ms)')), 1500)
    );

    const ok = await Promise.race([pingPromise, timeoutPromise]);
    if (ok) {
      console.log(`[System] Connected to Redis at ${env.redisUrl}. Running in REDIS mode.`);
      cachedMode = { mode: 'redis', client: testClient, url: env.redisUrl };
      probeClient = testClient;
      return cachedMode;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    try {
      testClient.disconnect();
    } catch (_) {}
    console.warn(`[System] Redis not available (${err.message}), running in MEMORY mode.`);
  }

  cachedMode = { mode: 'memory', client: null, url: null };
  return cachedMode;
}

/**
 * Resets cached detection result (useful for test suites or reconnection)
 */
function resetModeCache() {
  if (probeClient) {
    try {
      probeClient.disconnect();
    } catch (_) {}
    probeClient = null;
  }
  cachedMode = null;
}

module.exports = {
  createRedisClient,
  detectRedisMode,
  resetModeCache,
};

/**
 * Controller: Enqueue Welcome Email Job
 * POST /api/jobs/email
 */
const enqueueEmailJob = asyncHandler(async (req, res) => {
  const { name, email } = req.body;
  const idempotencyKey = req.headers['idempotency-key'];

  const job = await queueService.addJob(
    'welcome-email',
    { name, email },
    { jobId: idempotencyKey }
  );

  res.status(202).json({
    success: true,
    data: {
      jobId: job.id,
      name: job.name,
      status: job.status,
      isDuplicate: Boolean(job.isDuplicate),
      statusUrl: `/api/jobs/${job.id}`,
    },
    message: job.isDuplicate
      ? 'Existing job returned due to Idempotency-Key'
      : 'Welcome email job accepted and queued for processing',
    errors: [],
  });
});

/**
 * Controller: Access log tail reader
 * GET /api/logs/tail?lines=20
 */
const getLogTail = asyncHandler(async (req, res) => {
  const linesRequested = parseInt(req.query.lines, 10) || 20;
  const maxLines = Math.min(Math.max(1, linesRequested), 100);

  let lines = [];
  try {
    if (fs.existsSync(logFile)) {
      const content = await fs.promises.readFile(logFile, 'utf8');
      const allLines = content
        .split(/\r?\n/)
        .map((l) => l.trim())
        .filter(Boolean);
      lines = allLines.slice(-maxLines);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[LogTail] Could not read access log:', err.message);
  }

  res.status(200).json({
    success: true,
    data: {
      count: lines.length,
      lines,
    },
    message: `Retrieved last ${lines.length} log lines`,
    errors: [],
  });
});

const processEmailJob = require('./email.job');
const processReportJob = require('./report.job');

/**
 * Registry mapping job names to handler functions.
 * Shared directly across both MemoryDriver and BullMQDriver.
 */
const jobProcessors = {
  'welcome-email': async (data, onProgress) => {
    return processEmailJob(data);
  },
  'generate-report': async (data, onProgress) => {
    return processReportJob(data, onProgress);
  },
};

/**
 * Executes a job by name
 * @param {string} jobName
 * @param {object} data
 * @param {Function} onProgress
 */
async function executeJob(jobName, data, onProgress = () => {}) {
  const handler = jobProcessors[jobName];
  if (!handler) {
    throw new Error(`No processor registered for job type "${jobName}"`);
  }
  return handler(data, onProgress);
}

module.exports = {
  jobProcessors,
  executeJob,
};

const express = require('express');

/**
 * Custom error handler specifically for body-parser syntax and limit exceptions
 */
function handleBodyParserError(err, req, res, next) {
  // Malformed JSON syntax error
  if (err instanceof SyntaxError && err.status === 400 && 'body' in err) {
    return res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      data: null,
      message: 'Malformed JSON payload in request body',
      errors: [{ message: err.message }],
      requestId: req.id || null,
    });
  }

  // Payload too large error (413)
  if (err.status === 413 || err.type === 'entity.too.large') {
    return res.status(413).json({
      success: false,
      data: null,
      message: 'Payload too large. Maximum allowed size is 10kb',
      errors: [{ message: err.message }],
      requestId: req.id || null,
    });
  }

  next(err);
}

/**
 * Returns configured body parsing middleware stack with size limits and error conversion
 */
function createBodyParsers() {
  return [
    express.json({ limit: '10kb' }),
    express.urlencoded({ extended: true, limit: '10kb' }),
    handleBodyParserError,
  ];
}

module.exports = createBodyParsers;
module.exports.handleBodyParserError = handleBodyParserError;

const cacheService = require('../services/cache');

// In-flight request registry for single-flight / request coalescing (Cache Stampede Protection)
const inFlightRequests = new Map();

/**
 * Normalizes request URL into a deterministic cache key with sorted query parameters.
 * E.g. GET /api/products?limit=10&category=books -> cache:GET:/api/products?category=books&limit=10
 * @param {import('express').Request} req
 * @returns {string}
 */
function defaultKeyGenerator(req) {
  const method = req.method.toUpperCase();
  const urlParts = (req.originalUrl || req.url).split('?');
  const pathname = urlParts[0];
  const query = urlParts[1];

  if (!query) {
    return `cache:${method}:${pathname}`;
  }

  const params = new URLSearchParams(query);
  params.sort();
  return `cache:${method}:${pathname}?${params.toString()}`;
}

/**
 * Reusable Cache Middleware with Cache Stampede Protection (Single-Flight Coalescing)
 *
 * Cache Stampede Problem:
 * When a hot cache key expires or is first requested, multiple concurrent requests
 * simultaneously find a cache miss and all execute the slow database/service query at once.
 * This can spike CPU, exhaust database connections, and cause severe latency degradation.
 *
 * Solution:
 * We maintain an in-memory map of in-flight promises per cache key. If a request is already
 * computing data for that key, subsequent concurrent requests wait for that single operation
 * to resolve and share the identical result, hitting the database exactly ONCE.
 *
 * @param {number} ttlSeconds - Time-to-live in seconds
 * @param {Function} [keyFn] - Optional custom key generator (req) => string
 */
function cacheMiddleware(ttlSeconds = 60, keyFn = defaultKeyGenerator) {
  return async (req, res, next) => {
    // Only cache GET and HEAD requests
    if (req.method !== 'GET' && req.method !== 'HEAD') {
      return next();
    }

    // Never cache responses for requests carrying an Authorization header unless bound to user
    if (req.headers.authorization && !req.user?.id) {
      return next();
    }

    let cacheKey = keyFn(req);
    if (req.user?.id) {
      cacheKey += `:user=${req.user.id}`;
    }

    // 1. Check if item already exists in cache (Cache Hit)
    try {
      const cached = await cacheService.get(cacheKey);
      if (cached) {
        res.setHeader('X-Cache', 'HIT');
        return res.status(cached.status || 200).json(cached.body);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      // Fail-open: proceed to origin if cache read encounters an error
    }

    // 2. Cache Stampede Protection: check if another request is currently computing this key
    if (inFlightRequests.has(cacheKey)) {
      try {
        const result = await inFlightRequests.get(cacheKey);
        res.setHeader('X-Cache', 'HIT');
        return res.status(result.status).json(result.body);
      } catch (err) {
        // If the in-flight request failed, proceed to try fresh
      }
    }

    // 3. Initiate single-flight computation
    let resolveInFlight;
    let rejectInFlight;
    const inFlightPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      resolveInFlight = resolve;
      rejectInFlight = reject;
    });
    // Attach no-op catch handler to prevent unhandledRejection if no secondary caller is waiting
    inFlightPromise.catch(() => {});
    inFlightRequests.set(cacheKey, inFlightPromise);

    // 4. Intercept res.json to capture response body and status
    const originalJson = res.json.bind(res);

    res.json = function (body) {
      const statusCode = res.statusCode || 200;

      // Only cache successful 2xx responses (never cache error responses 4xx, 5xx)
      if (statusCode >= 200 && statusCode < 300) {
        cacheService.set(cacheKey, { status: statusCode, body }, ttlSeconds).catch(() => {});
        resolveInFlight({ status: statusCode, body });
        res.setHeader('X-Cache', 'MISS');
      } else {
        rejectInFlight(new Error(`Non-cacheable status: ${statusCode}`));
      }

      inFlightRequests.delete(cacheKey);
      return originalJson(body);
    };

    // Clean up if connection closes prematurely
    res.on('close', () => {
      if (inFlightRequests.has(cacheKey)) {
        inFlightRequests.delete(cacheKey);
      }
    });

    next();
  };
}

module.exports = cacheMiddleware;
module.exports.defaultKeyGenerator = defaultKeyGenerator;
module.exports.inFlightRequests = inFlightRequests;

/**
 * Central Error Handling Middleware
 * Ensures all errors conform to the standard response shape:
 * { success: false, data: null, message, errors: [], requestId }
 * Prevents stack trace leakage to clients while logging details for debugging.
 */
function errorHandler(err, req, res, next) {
  // If response has already started streaming, delegate to Express default handler
  if (res.headersSent) {
    return next(err);
  }

  const statusCode = Number.isInteger(err.statusCode)
    ? err.statusCode
    : (typeof err.status === 'number' ? err.status : 500);

  const message = err.message || 'An internal server error occurred';
  const errors = Array.isArray(err.errors) ? err.errors : [];
  const reqId = req.id || null;

  // Log server errors (5xx)
  if (statusCode >= 500 && process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'test') {
    console.error(`[Server Error] [${reqId || 'N/A'}] ${err.stack || err.message}`);
  }

  return res.status(statusCode).json({
    success: false,
    data: null,
    message,
    errors,
    requestId: reqId,
  });
}

module.exports = errorHandler;

const crypto = require('crypto');

const UUID_REGEX = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

/**
 * Middleware: requestId
 * Attaches a unique request identifier (UUID v4) to req.id and the X-Request-Id response header.
 * Reuses incoming X-Request-Id if valid UUID format to preserve distributed tracing.
 */
function requestIdMiddleware(req, res, next) {
  const incomingId = req.headers['x-request-id'];
  const requestId = (incomingId && UUID_REGEX.test(incomingId))
    ? incomingId
    : crypto.randomUUID();

  req.id = requestId;
  res.setHeader('X-Request-Id', requestId);

  next();
}

module.exports = requestIdMiddleware;

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const logDir = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../logs');
const logFile = path.join(logDir, 'access.log');

// Ensure log directory exists
try {
  if (!fs.existsSync(logDir)) {
    fs.mkdirSync(logDir, { recursive: true });
  }
} catch (err) {
  console.error('[Logger] Failed to create log directory:', err.message);
}

// Dedicated append stream for high-performance non-blocking writes
const accessLogStream = fs.createWriteStream(logFile, { flags: 'a' });

/**
 * Strips sensitive query parameter values (e.g. token, password, apiKey) from the URL
 * @param {string} originalUrl
 * @returns {string} Sanitized URL
 */
function sanitizeUrl(originalUrl) {
  try {
    const urlObj = new URL(originalUrl, 'http://localhost');
    const sensitiveKeys = ['token', 'secret', 'password', 'key', 'apikey', 'auth', 'access_token'];

    urlObj.searchParams.forEach((value, key) => {
      if (sensitiveKeys.some((s) => key.toLowerCase().includes(s))) {
        urlObj.searchParams.set(key, '[REDACTED]');
      }
    });

    return urlObj.pathname + (urlObj.search ? urlObj.search : '');
  } catch (_) {
    return originalUrl;
  }
}

/**
 * Middleware: requestLogger
 * Logs incoming requests to console and logs/access.log on response completion.
 * Never logs bodies, cookies, or authorization tokens.
 */
function requestLoggerMiddleware(req, res, next) {
  const start = req._startTime || process.hrtime.bigint();

  res.on('finish', () => {
    const end = process.hrtime.bigint();
    const durationMs = (Number(end - start) / 1_000_000).toFixed(2);
    const ip = req.ip || req.headers['x-forwarded-for'] || req.socket?.remoteAddress || '-';
    const method = req.method;
    const cleanUrl = sanitizeUrl(req.originalUrl || req.url);
    const statusCode = res.statusCode;
    const reqId = req.id || '-';
    const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();

    const logEntry = `[${timestamp}] [${reqId}] ${ip} ${method} ${cleanUrl} ${statusCode} ${durationMs}ms`;

    // Console output (suppressed in test mode unless debug is set)
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'test') {
      console.log(logEntry);
    }

    // Append to access log file
    try {
      accessLogStream.write(logEntry + '\n');
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[Logger] Failed writing to access.log:', err.message);
    }
  });

  next();
}

/**
 * Middleware: responseTime
 * Accurately tracks response duration using process.hrtime.bigint()
 * Injects the X-Response-Time header before headers are sent to the client.
 */
function responseTimeMiddleware(req, res, next) {
  const start = process.hrtime.bigint();
  req._startTime = start;

  // Intercept writeHead to set header before it is transmitted
  const originalWriteHead = res.writeHead;
  let headerSet = false;

  res.writeHead = function (...args) {
    if (!headerSet && !res.headersSent) {
      const end = process.hrtime.bigint();
      const durationMs = Number(end - start) / 1_000_000;
      res.setHeader('X-Response-Time', `${durationMs.toFixed(2)}ms`);
      headerSet = true;
    }
    return originalWriteHead.apply(this, args);
  };

  next();
}

module.exports = responseTimeMiddleware;

const helmet = require('helmet');
const cors = require('cors');
const env = require('../config/env');

/**
 * Configures security headers (Helmet) and CORS
 */
function createSecurityMiddleware() {
  const helmetMiddleware = helmet({
    contentSecurityPolicy: {
      directives: {
        defaultSrc: ["'self'"],
        scriptSrc: ["'self'"],
        styleSrc: ["'self'", "'unsafe-inline'"],
        imgSrc: ["'self'", 'data:'],
        connectSrc: ["'self'"],
      },
    },
    crossOriginEmbedderPolicy: false,
  });

  const corsMiddleware = cors({
    origin: env.corsOrigin === '*' ? true : env.corsOrigin,
    methods: ['GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'DELETE', 'OPTIONS'],
    allowedHeaders: ['Content-Type', 'Authorization', 'X-Request-Id', 'Idempotency-Key'],
    exposedHeaders: ['X-Request-Id', 'X-Response-Time', 'X-Cache'],
  });

  return [helmetMiddleware, corsMiddleware];
}

module.exports = createSecurityMiddleware;

const { validationResult } = require('express-validator');

/**
 * Higher-order middleware that executes express-validator rules
 * and returns a standardized 400 response if validation fails.
 * @param {Array<import('express-validator').ValidationChain>} validations
 */
function validate(validations) {
  return async (req, res, next) => {
    // Execute all validation rules concurrently
    await Promise.all(validations.map((validation) => validation.run(req)));

    const errors = validationResult(req);
    if (errors.isEmpty()) {
      return next();
    }

    const formattedErrors = errors.array().map((err) => ({
      field: err.path || err.param || 'unknown',
      message: err.msg,
      value: err.value,
    }));

    return res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      data: null,
      message: 'Validation failed',
      errors: formattedErrors,
      requestId: req.id || null,
    });
  };
}

module.exports = validate;

/**
 * Email Service
 * Simulates asynchronous transactional email delivery.
 * Never sends real emails.
 */
class EmailService {
  /**
   * Simulates sending a welcome email with intentional failure trigger for retry demonstrations
   * @param {{ name: string, email: string }} params
   */
  async sendWelcomeEmail({ name, email }) {
    console.log(`[Email Service] Initiating delivery to ${email} (recipient: ${name})...`);

    // Simulated network transport latency (~1.5s, or shorter during test)
    const delay = process.env.TEST_FAST_DELAY ? 50 : 1500;
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delay));

    // Intentional failure trigger to showcase exponential backoff & retries
    if (email && email.toLowerCase().includes('fail')) {
      const err = new Error(`Simulated SMTP delivery error for "${email}": Connection timeout / mailbox unavailable.`);
      console.warn(`[Email Service] Delivery failed intentionally: ${err.message}`);
      throw err;
    }

    const receipt = {
      messageId: `msg_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9)}`,
      recipient: email,
      recipientName: name,
      subject: `Welcome to OpsDesk, ${name}!`,
      deliveredAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      provider: 'OpsDesk-Simulated-Mailer-v1',
    };

    console.log(`[Email Service] Successfully delivered welcome email to ${email}`);
    return receipt;
  }
}

/**
 * Service handling simulated slow database operations and cache invalidations
 */
class ProductsService {
  /**
   * Retrieves products with filtering, search, and pagination after a simulated 2-second DB delay
   */
  async getProducts({ category, search, page = 1, limit = 10 } = {}) {
    // Simulate slow database read
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, getDbDelay()));

    let items = [...productsDB];

    if (category) {
      const cat = category.toLowerCase();
      items = items.filter((p) => p.category.toLowerCase() === cat);
    }

    if (search) {
      const q = search.toLowerCase();
      items = items.filter((p) => p.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || p.description.toLowerCase().includes(q));
    }

    const total = items.length;
    const startIndex = (page - 1) * limit;
    const paginatedItems = items.slice(startIndex, startIndex + limit);

    return {
      products: paginatedItems,
      pagination: {
        total,
        page: Number(page),
        limit: Number(limit),
        totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit) || 1,
      },
    };
  }

  async getProductById(id) {
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 200));
    return productsDB.find((p) => p.id === String(id)) || null;
  }

  /**
   * Adds a new product and invalidates all cached product query results
   */
  async createProduct({ name, category, price, stock, description }) {
    const newProduct = {
      id: String(productsDB.length + 1),
      name,
      category,
      price: parseFloat(price),
      stock: parseInt(stock, 10) || 0,
      description: description || '',
    };

    productsDB.push(newProduct);

    // Invalidate product cache entries
    await this.invalidateProductsCache();

    return newProduct;
  }

  /**
   * Updates an existing product and invalidates cache
   */
  async updateProduct(id, updates) {
    const index = productsDB.findIndex((p) => p.id === String(id));
    if (index === -1) {
      return null;
    }

    productsDB[index] = {
      ...productsDB[index],
      ...updates,
      id: productsDB[index].id, // Prevent id modification
    };

    await this.invalidateProductsCache();
    return productsDB[index];
  }

  /**
   * Deletes a product and invalidates cache
   */
  async deleteProduct(id) {
    const index = productsDB.findIndex((p) => p.id === String(id));
    if (index === -1) {
      return false;
    }

    productsDB.splice(index, 1);
    await this.invalidateProductsCache();
    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Invalidates every cached product route key using prefix matching (SCAN in Redis, prefix in memory)
   */
  async invalidateProductsCache() {
    await cacheService.delByPrefix('cache:GET:/api/products');
  }

  /**
   * Resets products list (for test isolation)
   */
  reset(seed = null) {
    if (seed) {
      productsDB = [...seed];
    }
  }
}

module.exports = new ProductsService();

/**
 * Report Generation Service
 * Simulates multi-stage resource-intensive background calculation with progress reporting.
 * Does not write physical files to disk.
 */
class ReportService {
  /**
   * Generates a report in staged chunks, emitting incremental progress.
   * @param {{ type: 'sales' | 'users', rows: number }} params
   * @param {Function} [onProgress] - Callback (progress: number) => Promise<void>
   */
  async generateReport({ type, rows }, onProgress = () => {}) {
    const totalSteps = 5;
    const isTest = Boolean(process.env.TEST_FAST_DELAY);
    const stepDuration = isTest ? 20 : 1000; // ~5 seconds total in normal execution

    console.log(`[Report Service] Starting report computation: type=${type}, rows=${rows}`);

    for (let step = 1; step <= totalSteps; step++) {
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, stepDuration));
      const percentage = Math.round((step / totalSteps) * 100);

      try {
        await onProgress(percentage);
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[Report Service] Failed to emit progress:', err.message);
      }
    }

    const calculatedTotal = type === 'sales'
      ? (rows * 128.45).toFixed(2)
      : (rows * 0.88).toFixed(0);

    const reportSummary = {
      reportType: type,
      requestedRows: rows,
      processedRows: rows,
      calculatedMetric: type === 'sales' ? `Total Revenue: $${calculatedTotal}` : `Active Accounts: ${calculatedTotal}`,
      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      fileFormat: 'PDF/CSV Simulation',
    };

    console.log(`[Report Service] Finished generating ${type} report for ${rows} records.`);
    return reportSummary;
  }
}

module.exports = new ReportService();

const { detectRedisMode } = require('../../config/redis');
const MemoryCacheDriver = require('./memory.driver');
const RedisCacheDriver = require('./redis.driver');

let activeDriver = null;
let initPromise = null;

/**
 * Initializes and returns the active cache driver based on environment availability
 * @returns {Promise<MemoryCacheDriver | RedisCacheDriver>}
 */
async function initCacheService() {
  if (activeDriver) {
    return activeDriver;
  }
  if (initPromise) {
    return initPromise;
  }

  initPromise = (async () => {
    const { mode, client } = await detectRedisMode();
    if (mode === 'redis') {
      activeDriver = new RedisCacheDriver(client);
    } else {
      activeDriver = new MemoryCacheDriver();
    }
    return activeDriver;
  })();

  return initPromise;
}

/**
 * Synchronous proxy interface to the active cache driver.
 * Automatically ensures initialization.
 */
const cacheService = {
  async get(key) {
    const driver = await initCacheService();
    return driver.get(key);
  },

  async set(key, value, ttlSeconds) {
    const driver = await initCacheService();
    return driver.set(key, value, ttlSeconds);
  },

  async del(key) {
    const driver = await initCacheService();
    return driver.del(key);
  },

  async delByPrefix(prefix) {
    const driver = await initCacheService();
    return driver.delByPrefix(prefix);
  },

  async clear() {
    const driver = await initCacheService();
    return driver.clear();
  },

  async getStats() {
    const driver = await initCacheService();
    return driver.getStats();
  },

  async close() {
    if (activeDriver) {
      await activeDriver.close();
      activeDriver = null;
      initPromise = null;
    }
  },

  getDriver() {
    return activeDriver;
  },

  /**
   * For testing or forced driver swap
   */
  setDriver(customDriver) {
    activeDriver = customDriver;
  },
};

module.exports = cacheService;
module.exports.initCacheService = initCacheService;

/**
 * In-Memory Cache Driver
 * Provides TTL caching, key invalidation by prefix, and hit/miss statistics.
 * Acts as the zero-dependency fallback for environments without Redis.
 */
class MemoryCacheDriver {
  constructor() {
    this.store = new Map(); // key -> { value, expiresAt }
    this.hits = 0;
    this.misses = 0;
    this.mode = 'memory';

    // Periodic cleanup of expired keys every 30 seconds
    this.cleanupTimer = setInterval(() => this.purgeExpired(), 30000);
    if (this.cleanupTimer.unref) {
      this.cleanupTimer.unref();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves a cached item
   * @param {string} key
   * @returns {Promise<{ status: number, body: any } | null>}
   */
  async get(key) {
    const entry = this.store.get(key);
    if (!entry) {
      this.misses += 1;
      return null;
    }

    if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
      this.store.delete(key);
      this.misses += 1;
      return null;
    }

    this.hits += 1;
    return entry.value;
  }

  /**
   * Sets a cache entry with TTL
   * @param {string} key
   * @param {{ status: number, body: any }} value
   * @param {number} ttlSeconds
   */
  async set(key, value, ttlSeconds = 60) {
    const expiresAt = Date.now() + ttlSeconds * 1000;
    this.store.set(key, { value, expiresAt });
  }

  /**
   * Deletes a single key
   * @param {string} key
   */
  async del(key) {
    this.store.delete(key);
  }

  /**
   * Invalidates all keys matching a prefix (e.g. "cache:GET:/api/products")
   * @param {string} prefix
   */
  async delByPrefix(prefix) {
    for (const key of this.store.keys()) {
      if (key.startsWith(prefix)) {
        this.store.delete(key);
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Clears all cache entries and resets metrics
   */
  async clear() {
    this.store.clear();
    this.hits = 0;
    this.misses = 0;
  }

  /**
   * Purges expired keys from memory
   */
  purgeExpired() {
    const now = Date.now();
    for (const [key, entry] of this.store.entries()) {
      if (now > entry.expiresAt) {
        this.store.delete(key);
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Returns cache metrics
   */
  async getStats() {
    this.purgeExpired();
    const total = this.hits + this.misses;
    const hitRatio = total > 0 ? (this.hits / total).toFixed(2) : '0.00';

    return {
      mode: this.mode,
      hits: this.hits,
      misses: this.misses,
      hitRatio: parseFloat(hitRatio),
      keysCount: this.store.size,
    };
  }

  async close() {
    if (this.cleanupTimer) {
      clearInterval(this.cleanupTimer);
    }
    this.store.clear();
  }
}

module.exports = MemoryCacheDriver;

const { createRedisClient } = require('../../config/redis');

/**
 * Redis Cache Driver
 * Implements server-side caching backed by Redis / ioredis.
 * Includes fail-open semantics: if Redis goes down, operations fail open (serve from source)
 * without crashing, logging a single warning rather than spamming every request.
 */
class RedisCacheDriver {
  /**
   * @param {import('ioredis').Redis} [client]
   */
  constructor(client) {
    this.client = client || createRedisClient();
    this.mode = 'redis';
    this.hits = 0;
    this.misses = 0;
    this.offlineWarningLogged = false;

    // Reset warning flag when connection recovers
    this.client.on('connect', () => {
      this.offlineWarningLogged = false;
    });

    this.client.on('error', (err) => {
      this.logOfflineOnce(err);
    });
  }

  logOfflineOnce(err) {
    if (!this.offlineWarningLogged) {
      console.warn(`[Redis Cache Driver] Redis offline/unreachable: ${err.message}. Failing open (bypassing cache).`);
      this.offlineWarningLogged = true;
    }
  }

  /**
   * @param {string} key
   * @returns {Promise<{ status: number, body: any } | null>}
   */
  async get(key) {
    try {
      const raw = await this.client.get(key);
      if (!raw) {
        this.misses += 1;
        return null;
      }
      this.hits += 1;
      return JSON.parse(raw);
    } catch (err) {
      this.logOfflineOnce(err);
      this.misses += 1;
      return null; // Fail-open: treat as miss
    }
  }

  /**
   * @param {string} key
   * @param {{ status: number, body: any }} value
   * @param {number} ttlSeconds
   */
  async set(key, value, ttlSeconds = 60) {
    try {
      const serialized = JSON.stringify(value);
      await this.client.set(key, serialized, 'EX', ttlSeconds);
    } catch (err) {
      this.logOfflineOnce(err);
    }
  }

  /**
   * @param {string} key
   */
  async del(key) {
    try {
      await this.client.del(key);
    } catch (err) {
      this.logOfflineOnce(err);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Invalidate keys matching a prefix using SCAN (never KEYS in production)
   * @param {string} prefix
   */
  async delByPrefix(prefix) {
    try {
      let cursor = '0';
      do {
        const [nextCursor, keys] = await this.client.scan(
          cursor,
          'MATCH',
          `${prefix}*`,
          'COUNT',
          100
        );
        cursor = nextCursor;
        if (keys.length > 0) {
          await this.client.del(...keys);
        }
      } while (cursor !== '0');
    } catch (err) {
      this.logOfflineOnce(err);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Clears all cache-prefixed keys (leaves queue and other keys untouched)
   */
  async clear() {
    try {
      let cursor = '0';
      do {
        const [nextCursor, keys] = await this.client.scan(
          cursor,
          'MATCH',
          'cache:*',
          'COUNT',
          100
        );
        cursor = nextCursor;
        if (keys.length > 0) {
          await this.client.del(...keys);
        }
      } while (cursor !== '0');
      this.hits = 0;
      this.misses = 0;
    } catch (err) {
      this.logOfflineOnce(err);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Returns cache metrics
   */
  async getStats() {
    let keyCount = 0;
    try {
      let cursor = '0';
      do {
        const [nextCursor, keys] = await this.client.scan(
          cursor,
          'MATCH',
          'cache:*',
          'COUNT',
          100
        );
        cursor = nextCursor;
        keyCount += keys.length;
      } while (cursor !== '0');
    } catch (err) {
      this.logOfflineOnce(err);
    }

    const total = this.hits + this.misses;
    const hitRatio = total > 0 ? (this.hits / total).toFixed(2) : '0.00';

    return {
      mode: this.mode,
      hits: this.hits,
      misses: this.misses,
      hitRatio: parseFloat(hitRatio),
      keysCount: keyCount,
    };
  }

  async close() {
    try {
      await this.client.quit();
    } catch (_) {
      try {
        this.client.disconnect();
      } catch (__) {}
    }
  }
}

module.exports = RedisCacheDriver;

const { Queue, Worker } = require('bullmq');
const { createRedisClient } = require('../../config/redis');
const { executeJob } = require('../../jobs/processors');

const QUEUE_NAME = 'opsdesk-tasks';

/**
 * BullMQ Task Queue Driver
 * Manages distributed background job execution via Redis.
 */
class BullMQQueueDriver {
  constructor() {
    this.mode = 'redis';
    this.connection = createRedisClient();
    this.queue = new Queue(QUEUE_NAME, {
      connection: this.connection,
      defaultJobOptions: {
        attempts: 3,
        backoff: {
          type: 'exponential',
          delay: 1000,
        },
        removeOnComplete: { count: 100 },
        removeOnFail: { count: 100 },
      },
    });

    this.worker = null;
  }

  /**
   * Initializes standalone or embedded BullMQ Worker
   */
  async startWorker() {
    if (this.worker) return this;

    const workerConnection = createRedisClient();

    this.worker = new Worker(
      QUEUE_NAME,
      async (job) => {
        return executeJob(job.name, job.data, async (percent) => {
          await job.updateProgress(percent);
        });
      },
      {
        connection: workerConnection,
        concurrency: 2,
      }
    );

    this.worker.on('failed', (job, err) => {
      console.warn(
        `[BullMQ Worker] Job ${job?.id} (${job?.name}) failed on attempt ${job?.attemptsMade}: ${err.message}`
      );
    });

    this.worker.on('completed', (job) => {
      console.log(`[BullMQ Worker] Job ${job?.id} (${job?.name}) completed successfully.`);
    });

    this.worker.on('error', (err) => {
      console.error('[BullMQ Worker] Worker error:', err.message);
    });

    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Enqueues a job with idempotency and retry configuration
   */
  async addJob(name, data, opts = {}) {
    const jobId = opts.jobId ? String(opts.jobId) : undefined;

    // Idempotency check: if jobId exists, return existing job
    if (jobId) {
      const existing = await this.queue.getJob(jobId);
      if (existing) {
        const state = await existing.getState();
        return {
          id: existing.id,
          name: existing.name,
          status: state === 'waiting' ? 'queued' : state,
          isDuplicate: true,
        };
      }
    }

    const job = await this.queue.add(name, data, {
      jobId,
      attempts: opts.attempts || 3,
      backoff: opts.backoff || { type: 'exponential', delay: 1000 },
      removeOnComplete: { count: 100 },
      removeOnFail: { count: 100 },
    });

    return {
      id: job.id,
      name: job.name,
      status: 'queued',
    };
  }

  /**
   * Normalizes BullMQ job format to the standard interface
   */
  async normalizeJob(job) {
    if (!job) return null;
    const state = await job.getState();

    return {
      id: job.id,
      name: job.name,
      data: job.data,
      state: state || 'unknown',
      progress: typeof job.progress === 'number' ? job.progress : (job.progress?.percent || 0),
      attemptsMade: job.attemptsMade || 0,
      maxAttempts: job.opts?.attempts || 3,
      result: job.returnvalue || null,
      failedReason: job.failedReason || null,
      timestamp: job.timestamp,
      processedOn: job.processedOn || null,
      finishedOn: job.finishedOn || null,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Fetches single job by ID
   */
  async getJob(id) {
    try {
      const job = await this.queue.getJob(String(id));
      if (!job) return null;
      return await this.normalizeJob(job);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`[BullMQ] Error getting job ${id}:`, err.message);
      return null;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves recent jobs and aggregated state counts
   */
  async getJobs(limit = 20) {
    const states = ['waiting', 'active', 'completed', 'failed', 'delayed'];
    const counts = await this.queue.getJobCounts(...states);
    const total = Object.values(counts).reduce((acc, val) => acc + (val || 0), 0);

    const jobs = await this.queue.getJobs(states, 0, limit - 1, true);
    const normalized = await Promise.all(jobs.map((j) => this.normalizeJob(j)));

    return {
      jobs: normalized.filter(Boolean),
      counts: {
        waiting: counts.waiting || 0,
        active: counts.active || 0,
        completed: counts.completed || 0,
        failed: counts.failed || 0,
        delayed: counts.delayed || 0,
        total,
      },
      mode: this.mode,
    };
  }

  async close() {
    if (this.worker) {
      await this.worker.close();
      this.worker = null;
    }
    await this.queue.close();
    try {
      await this.connection.quit();
    } catch (_) {
      try {
        this.connection.disconnect();
      } catch (__) {}
    }
  }
}

module.exports = BullMQQueueDriver;

const { detectRedisMode } = require('../../config/redis');
const MemoryQueueDriver = require('./memory.driver');
const BullMQQueueDriver = require('./bullmq.driver');

let activeQueueDriver = null;
let initPromise = null;

/**
 * Initializes the appropriate queue driver depending on Redis availability
 */
async function initQueueService() {
  if (activeQueueDriver) {
    return activeQueueDriver;
  }
  if (initPromise) {
    return initPromise;
  }

  initPromise = (async () => {
    const { mode } = await detectRedisMode();
    if (mode === 'redis') {
      activeQueueDriver = new BullMQQueueDriver();
    } else {
      activeQueueDriver = new MemoryQueueDriver();
    }
    return activeQueueDriver;
  })();

  return initPromise;
}

const queueService = {
  async addJob(name, data, opts) {
    const driver = await initQueueService();
    return driver.addJob(name, data, opts);
  },

  async getJob(id) {
    const driver = await initQueueService();
    return driver.getJob(id);
  },

  async getJobs(limit) {
    const driver = await initQueueService();
    return driver.getJobs(limit);
  },

  async startWorker() {
    const driver = await initQueueService();
    return driver.startWorker();
  },

  async close() {
    if (activeQueueDriver) {
      await activeQueueDriver.close();
      activeQueueDriver = null;
      initPromise = null;
    }
  },

  getDriver() {
    return activeQueueDriver;
  },

  setDriver(customDriver) {
    activeQueueDriver = customDriver;
  },
};

module.exports = queueService;
module.exports.initQueueService = initQueueService;

const crypto = require('crypto');
const { executeJob } = require('../../jobs/processors');

/**
 * In-Memory Task Queue Driver
 * Provides exact BullMQ-compatible API semantics:
 * - Concurrency control (default 2 workers)
 * - Retries with exponential backoff
 * - Progress tracking (0 - 100%)
 * - Idempotent job submission via unique ID / Idempotency-Key
 * - Job cleanup limits
 */
class MemoryQueueDriver {
  constructor({ concurrency = 2, maxStoredJobs = 100 } = {}) {
    this.concurrency = concurrency;
    this.maxStoredJobs = maxStoredJobs;
    this.mode = 'memory';
    this.jobs = new Map(); // jobId -> job
    this.activeCount = 0;
    this.isWorkerRunning = false;
    this.scheduledTimers = new Set();
  }

  /**
   * Starts the in-process worker runner
   */
  async startWorker() {
    this.isWorkerRunning = true;
    this.processNext();
    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Enqueues a job with idempotency support and retry configuration
   * @param {string} name - Job type name
   * @param {object} data - Payload
   * @param {object} [opts={}]
   * @returns {Promise<{ id: string, name: string, status: string, isDuplicate?: boolean }>}
   */
  async addJob(name, data, opts = {}) {
    const id = opts.jobId ? String(opts.jobId) : crypto.randomUUID();

    // Idempotency: Return existing job if duplicate key received
    if (this.jobs.has(id)) {
      const existing = this.jobs.get(id);
      return {
        id: existing.id,
        name: existing.name,
        status: existing.state === 'waiting' ? 'queued' : existing.state,
        isDuplicate: true,
      };
    }

    const job = {
      id,
      name,
      data,
      state: 'waiting',
      progress: 0,
      attemptsMade: 0,
      maxAttempts: opts.attempts || 3,
      backoffDelay: opts.backoff?.delay || (process.env.TEST_FAST_DELAY ? 50 : 1000),
      result: null,
      failedReason: null,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      processedOn: null,
      finishedOn: null,
      updateProgress: async (progress) => {
        job.progress = progress;
      },
    };

    this.jobs.set(id, job);
    this.enforceStorageLimits();

    if (this.isWorkerRunning) {
      setImmediate(() => this.processNext());
    }

    return {
      id: job.id,
      name: job.name,
      status: 'queued',
    };
  }

  /**
   * Fetches single job with normalized status
   * @param {string} id
   */
  async getJob(id) {
    const job = this.jobs.get(String(id));
    if (!job) {
      return null;
    }

    return {
      id: job.id,
      name: job.name,
      data: job.data,
      state: job.state,
      progress: job.progress,
      attemptsMade: job.attemptsMade,
      maxAttempts: job.maxAttempts,
      result: job.result,
      failedReason: job.failedReason,
      timestamp: job.timestamp,
      processedOn: job.processedOn,
      finishedOn: job.finishedOn,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves list of recent jobs with aggregated state counts
   * @param {number} [limit=20]
   */
  async getJobs(limit = 20) {
    const all = Array.from(this.jobs.values()).sort((a, b) => b.timestamp - a.timestamp);

    const counts = {
      waiting: 0,
      active: 0,
      completed: 0,
      failed: 0,
      delayed: 0,
      total: all.length,
    };

    all.forEach((j) => {
      if (counts[j.state] !== undefined) {
        counts[j.state] += 1;
      }
    });

    const recent = all.slice(0, limit).map((j) => ({
      id: j.id,
      name: j.name,
      data: j.data,
      state: j.state,
      progress: j.progress,
      attemptsMade: j.attemptsMade,
      maxAttempts: j.maxAttempts,
      result: j.result,
      failedReason: j.failedReason,
      timestamp: j.timestamp,
      processedOn: j.processedOn,
      finishedOn: j.finishedOn,
    }));

    return { jobs: recent, counts, mode: this.mode };
  }

  /**
   * Worker concurrency loop: processes waiting jobs up to concurrency limit
   */
  processNext() {
    if (!this.isWorkerRunning) return;

    while (this.activeCount < this.concurrency) {
      // Find oldest waiting job
      const nextJob = Array.from(this.jobs.values())
        .filter((j) => j.state === 'waiting')
        .sort((a, b) => a.timestamp - b.timestamp)[0];

      if (!nextJob) break;

      this.executeJob(nextJob);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Runs single job execution with retry and exponential backoff
   * @param {object} job
   */
  async executeJob(job) {
    this.activeCount += 1;
    job.state = 'active';
    job.attemptsMade += 1;
    if (!job.processedOn) {
      job.processedOn = Date.now();
    }

    try {
      const output = await executeJob(job.name, job.data, async (percent) => {
        job.progress = percent;
      });

      job.result = output;
      job.progress = 100;
      job.state = 'completed';
      job.finishedOn = Date.now();
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn(`[Memory Worker] Job ${job.id} (${job.name}) attempt ${job.attemptsMade}/${job.maxAttempts} failed: ${err.message}`);

      if (job.attemptsMade < job.maxAttempts) {
        // Schedule retry with exponential backoff
        job.state = 'delayed';
        const delayMs = job.backoffDelay * Math.pow(2, job.attemptsMade - 1);

        const timer = setTimeout(() => {
          this.scheduledTimers.delete(timer);
          if (this.jobs.has(job.id)) {
            job.state = 'waiting';
            this.processNext();
          }
        }, delayMs);

        this.scheduledTimers.add(timer);
      } else {
        job.state = 'failed';
        job.failedReason = err.message;
        job.finishedOn = Date.now();
      }
    } finally {
      this.activeCount = Math.max(0, this.activeCount - 1);
      this.processNext();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Prevents uncontrolled memory growth
   */
  enforceStorageLimits() {
    if (this.jobs.size <= this.maxStoredJobs) return;

    const finished = Array.from(this.jobs.values())
      .filter((j) => j.state === 'completed' || j.state === 'failed')
      .sort((a, b) => a.timestamp - b.timestamp);

    while (this.jobs.size > this.maxStoredJobs && finished.length > 0) {
      const toRemove = finished.shift();
      this.jobs.delete(toRemove.id);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Graceful cleanup
   */
  async close() {
    this.isWorkerRunning = false;
    for (const timer of this.scheduledTimers) {
      clearTimeout(timer);
    }
    this.scheduledTimers.clear();
  }
}

module.exports = MemoryQueueDriver;

/**
 * Custom Operational Application Error
 * Used across controllers and middleware for operational (predictable) errors.
 */
class AppError extends Error {
  /**
   * @param {string} message - Human-readable error message
   * @param {number} statusCode - HTTP status code (default: 500)
   * @param {Array<object>} [errors=[]] - Optional validation error details
   */
  constructor(message, statusCode = 500, errors = []) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'AppError';
    this.statusCode = statusCode;
    this.status = `${statusCode}`.startsWith('4') ? 'fail' : 'error';
    this.isOperational = true;
    this.errors = errors;

    Error.captureStackTrace(this, this.constructor);
  }
}

module.exports = AppError;

/**
 * Wraps asynchronous Express handlers to automatically forward rejected promises to next()
 * @param {Function} fn - Async controller function (req, res, next)
 * @returns {Function} Express middleware handler
 */
const asyncHandler = (fn) => (req, res, next) => {
  Promise.resolve(fn(req, res, next)).catch(next);
};

const { describe, it, before, after } = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const request = require('supertest');
const app = require('../app');
const cacheService = require('../src/services/cache');

process.env.NODE_ENV = 'test';
process.env.TEST_FAST_DELAY = 'true';

describe('Step 3: Server-Side Caching & Stampede Protection Verification', () => {
  before(async () => {
    await cacheService.clear();
  });

  after(async () => {
    await cacheService.close();
  });

  it('should return MISS on first call and HIT on second call with faster latency', async () => {
    const testUrl = `/api/products?testRun=${Date.now()}`;

    // 1. Initial Call: Cache Miss
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const res1 = await request(app).get(testUrl);
    const t1 = performance.now();
    const latency1 = t1 - t0;

    assert.equal(res1.status, 200);
    assert.equal(res1.headers['x-cache'], 'MISS', 'First request must be a cache MISS');
    assert.ok(res1.body.data.products.length > 0);

    // 2. Subsequent Call: Cache Hit
    const t2 = performance.now();
    const res2 = await request(app).get(testUrl);
    const t3 = performance.now();
    const latency2 = t3 - t2;

    assert.equal(res2.status, 200);
    assert.equal(res2.headers['x-cache'], 'HIT', 'Second request must be a cache HIT');
    assert.deepEqual(res1.body, res2.body, 'Cached body must match original response');

    // Cache hit should be significantly faster than cache miss
    assert.ok(
      latency2 < latency1,
      `Cache hit (${latency2.toFixed(1)}ms) should be faster than cache miss (${latency1.toFixed(1)}ms)`
    );
  });

  it('should protect against cache stampede: 10 concurrent requests result in only 1 MISS', async () => {
    const stampedeKey = `/api/products?stampedeTestBatch=${Date.now()}`;

    // Launch 10 simultaneous requests
    const promises = Array.from({ length: 10 }, () => request(app).get(stampedeKey));
    const responses = await Promise.all(promises);

    const misses = responses.filter((r) => r.headers['x-cache'] === 'MISS');
    const hits = responses.filter((r) => r.headers['x-cache'] === 'HIT');

    assert.equal(responses.length, 10);
    assert.equal(misses.length, 1, 'Exactly one request should execute the database call (MISS)');
    assert.equal(hits.length, 9, 'All other 9 concurrent requests should receive coalesced response (HIT)');
  });

  it('should invalidate product cache when a new product is created', async () => {
    const listUrl = '/api/products?invalidationTest=true';

    // 1. Prime the cache
    const initialRes = await request(app).get(listUrl);
    assert.equal(initialRes.headers['x-cache'], 'MISS');

    const cachedRes = await request(app).get(listUrl);
    assert.equal(cachedRes.headers['x-cache'], 'HIT');

    // 2. Create new product (mutation triggers invalidation of cache:GET:/api/products*)
    const createRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/products')
      .send({
        name: 'Invalidator Test Device',
        category: 'electronics',
        price: 99.99,
        stock: 10,
        description: 'Verifies cache purging'
      });
    assert.equal(createRes.status, 201);

    // 3. Next GET request must be a fresh MISS
    const afterMutationRes = await request(app).get(listUrl);
    assert.equal(
      afterMutationRes.headers['x-cache'],
      'MISS',
      'Cache must be invalidated following product creation'
    );
  });

  it('should never cache error responses (4xx, 5xx)', async () => {
    const notFoundUrl = `/api/products/9999999?testErrorCache=${Date.now()}`;

    const res1 = await request(app).get(notFoundUrl);
    assert.equal(res1.status, 404);
    assert.equal(res1.headers['x-cache'], undefined, '404 must not set X-Cache');

    const res2 = await request(app).get(notFoundUrl);
    assert.equal(res2.status, 404);
    assert.equal(res2.headers['x-cache'], undefined, 'Subsequent 404 must still not be cached');
  });

  it('should expose metrics in GET /api/cache/stats and support DELETE /api/cache', async () => {
    const statsRes = await request(app).get('/api/cache/stats');
    assert.equal(statsRes.status, 200);
    assert.ok(statsRes.body.data.mode);
    assert.ok(typeof statsRes.body.data.hits === 'number');
    assert.ok(typeof statsRes.body.data.misses === 'number');

    const clearRes = await request(app).delete('/api/cache');
    assert.equal(clearRes.status, 200);
    assert.equal(clearRes.body.data.cleared, true);

    const postClearStats = await request(app).get('/api/cache/stats');
    assert.equal(postClearStats.body.data.keysCount, 0);
  });
});

    const jobId = res.body.data.jobId;

    // Poll until completed
    let completed = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 80));
      const statusRes = await request(app).get(`/api/jobs/${jobId}`);
      if (statusRes.body.data.state === 'completed') {
        completed = true;
        assert.ok(statusRes.body.data.result);

        break;
      }
    }
    assert.ok(completed, 'Job should complete successfully');
  });

  it('should support Idempotency-Key to prevent duplicate job creation', async () => {
    const idempotencyKey = 'idempotent-order-987654';

    // First request
    const res1 = await request(app)
      .post('/api/jobs/email')
      .set('Idempotency-Key', idempotencyKey)
      .send({ name: 'First Submission', email: 'user@example.com' });

    assert.equal(res1.status, 202);
    const firstJobId = res1.body.data.jobId;
    assert.equal(firstJobId, idempotencyKey);

    // Second request with identical Idempotency-Key
    const res2 = await request(app)
      .post('/api/jobs/email')
      .set('Idempotency-Key', idempotencyKey)
      .send({ name: 'Duplicate Submission', email: 'user@example.com' });

    assert.equal(res2.status, 202);
    assert.equal(res2.body.data.jobId, firstJobId);
    assert.equal(res2.body.data.isDuplicate, true);
  });

  it('should retry a failing job 3 times with backoff and mark failed without crashing', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/jobs/email')
      .send({ name: 'Failure Demo', email: 'should-fail-demo@example.com' });

    assert.equal(res.status, 202);
    const jobId = res.body.data.jobId;

    // Poll until all 3 attempts have been exhausted
    let finalState = null;
    for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100));
      const statusRes = await request(app).get(`/api/jobs/${jobId}`);
      finalState = statusRes.body.data;
      if (finalState.state === 'failed') {
        break;
      }
    }

    assert.equal(finalState.state, 'failed', 'Job should end in failed state after 3 attempts');
    assert.equal(finalState.attemptsMade, 3, 'Job should have made exactly 3 attempts');
    assert.ok(finalState.failedReason, 'Failed reason must be recorded');
  });

  it('should accept a report generation job and track staged progress', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/jobs/report')
      .send({ type: 'sales', rows: 500 });

    for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {

        assert.ok(statusRes.body.data.result.calculatedMetric);
        break;
      }
    }
    assert.ok(completed, 'Report job should complete and report 100% progress');
  });

    const res = await request(app).get('/api/jobs/nonexistent-id-999');
    assert.equal(res.status, 404);
    assert.equal(res.body.success, false);
  });

    const res = await request(app).get('/api/jobs');
    assert.equal(res.status, 200);
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(res.body.data.jobs));
    assert.ok(res.body.data.counts);
    assert.ok(res.body.data.counts.total >= 3);
  });

const { describe, it, before, after } = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const request = require('supertest');
const fs = require('fs');
const app = require('../app');
const { logFile } = require('../src/middleware/requestLogger');

process.env.NODE_ENV = 'test';

describe('Step 1: Middleware Pipeline Verification', () => {
  it('should generate and return X-Request-Id and X-Response-Time headers', async () => {
    const res = await request(app).get('/api/health');

    assert.equal(res.status, 200);
    assert.ok(res.headers['x-request-id'], 'Expected X-Request-Id header to be present');
    assert.match(
      res.headers['x-request-id'],
      /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i,
      'Expected valid UUID v4 format'
    );

    assert.ok(res.headers['x-response-time'], 'Expected X-Response-Time header to be present');
    assert.match(
      res.headers['x-response-time'],
      /^[0-9.]+ms$/,
      'Expected response time formatted with "ms"'
    );
  });

  it('should preserve and reuse incoming valid X-Request-Id', async () => {
    const customTraceId = '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000';
    const res = await request(app)
      .get('/api/health')
      .set('X-Request-Id', customTraceId);

    assert.equal(res.status, 200);
    assert.equal(res.headers['x-request-id'], customTraceId);
  });

  it('should log request to access.log without bodies, cookies, or secrets', async () => {
    const secretQuery = '/api/health?token=supersecret123&regularParam=allowed';
    await request(app)
      .get(secretQuery)
      .set('Cookie', 'session_id=confidential_cookie_value')
      .set('Authorization', 'Bearer secret-jwt-token')
      .send({ confidentialBodyField: 'must-not-be-logged' });

    // Allow I/O stream flush
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100));

    assert.ok(fs.existsSync(logFile), 'access.log file should exist');
    const logContent = fs.readFileSync(logFile, 'utf8');

    // Confirm that the log entry exists with sanitized query
    assert.ok(
      logContent.includes('[REDACTED]') || logContent.includes('/api/health'),
      'Log should contain the sanitized request line'
    );

    // Confirm sensitive data is NEVER logged
    assert.ok(!logContent.includes('supersecret123'), 'Secret query parameters must be redacted');
    assert.ok(!logContent.includes('confidential_cookie_value'), 'Cookies must never be logged');
    assert.ok(!logContent.includes('secret-jwt-token'), 'Authorization headers must never be logged');
    assert.ok(!logContent.includes('confidentialBodyField'), 'Request bodies must never be logged');
  });

  it('should cleanly handle malformed JSON payloads with HTTP 400', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/jobs/email')
      .set('Content-Type', 'application/json')
      .send('{"name": "Malformed", "email": bad_json_syntax}');

    assert.equal(res.status, 400);
    assert.equal(res.body.success, false);
    assert.ok(res.body.message.includes('Malformed JSON'));
    assert.ok(res.headers['x-request-id'], 'Error response must contain request ID header');
    assert.equal(res.body.requestId, res.headers['x-request-id']);
  });

  it('should reject payloads exceeding 10kb limit with HTTP 413', async () => {
    const massiveString = 'a'.repeat(15 * 1024); // 15kb payload
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/jobs/email')
      .set('Content-Type', 'application/json')
      .send(JSON.stringify({ name: 'Oversized', payload: massiveString }));

    assert.equal(res.status, 413);
    assert.equal(res.body.success, false);
    assert.ok(res.body.message.includes('Payload too large'));
    assert.equal(res.body.requestId, res.headers['x-request-id']);
  });

  it('should return consistent JSON 400 for input validation failures', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/jobs/email')
      .set('Content-Type', 'application/json')
      .send({ name: '', email: 'not-an-email' });

    assert.equal(res.status, 400);
    assert.equal(res.body.success, false);
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(res.body.errors));
    assert.ok(res.body.errors.length >= 2, 'Should report field errors for both name and email');
  });

  it('should return standardized JSON 404 for nonexistent routes', async () => {
    const res = await request(app).get('/api/nonexistent-route-xyz');

    assert.equal(res.status, 404);
    assert.equal(res.body.success, false);
    assert.ok(res.body.message.includes('Route not found'));
    assert.equal(res.body.requestId, res.headers['x-request-id']);
  });
});
